```text
## Design Decision

Field | Description
-- | --
Decision: | Stamp each element with the id of its page and route peers' elements to that page (hybrid). The visibility rule from #80 (the one that hides a hidden collaborator's elements) is kept only as a safety net, so an element tagged for another page can never be drawn or clicked on the open page.
Alternatives Considered: | 1. Filter model: keep every page's elements in one shared scene and hide elements from other pages with the #80 visibility rule, like hiding a collaborator. 2. Separate messages per page: a new message type that carries the page id with every element update. 3. Send the whole page list with its elements, the way a saved file stores pages (#165).
Rationale: | The page stamp works like the existing creator stamp and reuses the room's element sync, reconcile and storage almost unchanged. Routing keeps #157's model, where each page holds its own elements, so the merged page features (#158, #159, #160, #162, #165) keep working. The filter model would mean rewriting all of those; separate messages would rewrite reconcile and room storage; sending whole pages would make two users editing at the same time overwrite each other.
Consequences: | Every client receives every page's elements and has to sort them into pages. Any future code that creates elements on a page (duplication #161, cross-page transfer #163) must set the page tag. The room's stored size limit now covers all pages together.

# Issue Description

## Summary

A drawing has one canvas. Users who need several related diagrams must use separate files or put everything on one huge canvas. This feature adds pages: several canvases in one drawing.

The spec below is a starting point. The acceptance criteria are incomplete, and the open questions must be answered before implementation.

## User Story

**As a** user, **I want** several pages in one drawing **so that** I can keep related diagrams together without mixing them on one canvas.

## User Scenario

A developer makes a drawing for a system design with three pages: "Architecture," "Database," and "UI flow." She switches between them with tabs and sends the file to a teammate, who opens it with all three pages.

She sends the drawing to a teammate, who opens it and sees all three pages. The teammate can navigate between pages, make changes, and collaborate without affecting unrelated pages.

---

# Issue Classification

## Scope

**Generic:** Large
**Reason:** Pages change how a drawing is stored, edited, saved, exported, and shared in live collaboration. The feature requires changes to the underlying scene data model, page management UI, editing history, and file operations.

---

# Expectations

## Acceptance Criteria (draft, incomplete)

* [ ] Users can add a page and switch between pages with tabs.
* [ ] Each page shows only its own elements.
* [ ] Saving and reopening a drawing keeps all its pages.
* [ ] A file saved before this feature opens with all its content on a single page.
* [ ] More criteria needed, based on the open questions below.

Acceptance criteria should also cover invalid input, failures, conflicts, and permissions, not only the main path.

## Open Question

* How do undo and redo work across pages?
* What happens when a page is deleted? Can it be undone? Can the last page be deleted?
* What happens if an older version of Excalidraw opens a file with pages?
* In live collaboration, what happens when someone deletes or renames the page another user is on? What do users see of collaborators on other pages?
* How do copy, paste, and export work with pages?
* Does anything get slow with many pages or many elements?

---

# Extra

## Out of Scope

* Links between pages
* Presenting pages as slides
* Universal elements that appear on every page.

Note: pages are not frames. Frames group elements on the same canvas. Pages are separate canvases in the same file.
```

```text
# Issue Description

## Summary
Extend live collaboration to support multiple independently editable pages within a shared drawing.

Today pages (#157) and live collaboration don't know about each other: the room only syncs the elements of the page each user has open, so a peer's elements land on whatever page you are on, and page names, order and backgrounds never reach other users. This issue makes the room share the whole multi-page drawing, the way a team edits one shared PowerPoint deck: everyone sees the same pages, each person can work on any page, and changes to pages reach everyone.

## User Story
**As a** collaborator in a live session, **I want** every page of the shared drawing to stay in sync with my teammates while each of us works on any page, **so that** we can build a multi-page drawing together without our pages mixing or drifting apart.

## User Scenario
1. Alex has a drawing with three pages: "Architecture," "Database," and "UI flow." Alex starts a live session. All three pages go into the room.
2. Blair joins the room and sees the same three pages, in the same order, with the same names and backgrounds. Blair opens "Database"; Alex stays on "Architecture."
3. Alex draws a box on "Architecture." It doesn't appear on Blair's "Database" page, but the "Architecture" thumbnail updates on Blair's screen. Alex's avatar is shown on the "Architecture" tab, Blair's on "Database."
4. Blair renames "Database" to "Schema." Alex sees the new name right away.
5. Casey joins and opens "UI flow." Alex deletes "UI flow." Casey is moved to "Schema," the page before it, and a toast says the page was deleted.

---

# Issue Classification

## Scope

**Generic:** Large
**Specific:** Large (13 points)
**Reason:** Adds page awareness to live collaboration. It touches the collab layer (`excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx`, `Portal.tsx`: a page id stamp on elements, like the existing creator stamp, and one new message type for page data), room storage (`excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts`: page data stored with the room's scene), the page methods in `App.tsx` (create, delete, rename, reorder and clear send their change and apply peers' changes; incoming elements are routed to their page), and small UI additions in `Pages.tsx` and `PageInfoDialog.tsx` (avatars on tabs, an "Only you see this" note). On top of the sync itself, it adds conflict rules (deletion, duplicate names, simultaneous changes), failure handling (bad page data, reconnecting), presence and follow mode across pages, and permission and visibility rules, all without breaking the five merged page features. That is larger than the other page sub-issues, so it is scoped Large. The element sync and reconcile logic is reused, not rewritten. Folders, undo/redo and mixed-version support are left out.

---

# Expectations

## Acceptance Criteria

### 1. Sharing the drawing
- [ ] **Starting a room:** When the user who creates a room has several pages, all of them go into the room with their order, names, descriptions, backgrounds and elements.
- [ ] **Joining a room:** A user who joins sees exactly the room's pages: the same pages, order, names, descriptions and backgrounds. The pages they had open before joining are replaced, as Excalidraw already does with a single canvas. After leaving, the room's pages stay as their local drawing.
- [ ] **Room storage:** The page list and page data are stored with the room's scene. A user who joins or reloads while nobody else is online still gets every page.

### 2. Elements stay on their page
- [ ] **Page tag:** Every element is stamped once with the id of the page it was created on, the same way elements are stamped with their creator. Editing or moving the element, and reordering or deleting other pages, never changes its tag.
- [ ] **Routing:** An element from a peer appears only on its tagged page. If that page is open, it appears right away; otherwise it is stored on that page, and that page's preview is refreshed. It never appears on any other page.
- [ ] **Untagged elements:** An element that reaches the room with no page tag is stamped once with the id of the page that is first in the page list when it arrives.
- [ ] **Safety net:** If an element tagged for another page ever reaches the open page, it is not drawn and can't be selected, erased or bound to, using the same rule that hides a hidden collaborator's elements (#80).

### 3. Pages are shared, viewports are personal
- [ ] **Independent navigation:** Each user switches pages on their own. Switching pages never changes the page another user is on.
- [ ] **Shared page changes:** Creating a page, renaming it, changing its description, reordering pages (by drag or by typed position) and changing a page's background colour reach every collaborator. Background colour is per page.
- [ ] **Personal settings:** Scroll, zoom, grid settings and the show-thumbnail option are never sent to other users. In the page info dialog, the grid and thumbnail settings are marked "Only you see this."

### 4. Conflicts
- [ ] **Deleting a page someone is on:** Deleting a page deletes its elements for everyone. Anyone on that page is moved to the page before it (or the next one if it was first), sees a toast naming the deleted page, and an element they are drawing (pointer still down) is discarded and doesn't appear on any page.
- [ ] **Delete wins:** Edits to a deleted page that arrive after the deletion are discarded and don't bring the page back.
- [ ] **Deleting every page:** As in #158, deleting every page leaves one new blank page, and every collaborator gets that same page. It becomes the first page.
- [ ] **Duplicate names:** If two page changes cross in transit (each client sent its change before receiving the other's) and leave two pages with the same name, the page with the later change time is renamed to the next free default name ("Page N"), ties broken by page id. Both clients end with the same page names.
- [ ] **Simultaneous changes to one page:** If two changes to the same page's name, description, background or position cross in transit, the change with the later change time wins, ties broken by page id. Every client ends with the same result, whatever order the messages arrived in.
- [ ] **Clearing:** Clearing pages (#159), including pages that aren't open and "Clear canvas and all pages," removes those elements for every collaborator.

### 5. Failures
- [ ] **Bad page data from a peer:** A page message with an unknown page id, a duplicate page id or missing fields is ignored, and the existing pages are left unchanged.
- [ ] **Reconnecting:** After a user disconnects and reconnects, their pages match the room's, including changes made while they were offline.

### 6. Seeing collaborators
- [ ] **Other pages' cursors:** Cursors, selections and laser trails of collaborators on other pages are hidden. They show again when both users are on the same page.
- [ ] **Presence on tabs:** Each page tab shows the avatars of collaborators currently on that page. It updates when someone switches pages or leaves.
- [ ] **Follow mode:** When you follow a collaborator and they switch pages, you switch to that page too.

### 7. Permissions and visibility
- [ ] **View mode:** A user in view mode can switch pages and follow others, but can't create, rename, delete, clear or reorder pages or change a page's background, extending the view-mode rule from #158 and #162.
- [ ] **Hide and lock:** Hiding (#80) or locking (#81) a collaborator applies on every page, including page previews: a hidden collaborator's elements are not passed to any page preview.
- [ ] **Folders while collaborating:** Folder controls (#162) are disabled in a room, and pages are shown in the shared order without folders.

## Open Question

N/A

---

# Extra

## Out of Scope

- Syncing folders (#162); folders are disabled in a room
- Undo and redo with pages, including undo after a peer's change (#168)
- Opening rooms and files from before the multi-page feature, and older clients (#166)
- Exporting pages, including what hidden collaborators' elements do in exports (#164)
- Bringing your own local pages into a room you join (import, #164)
- Copying or moving elements between pages (#163) and duplicating pages (#161); when those land, new elements must get the right page tag
- Roles or permissions beyond view mode
- A limit on the number of pages, or performance work for very large rooms

## Head Issue

Issue (#149): Multiple pages in one drawing

## Dependencies
Issue (#157). Issue (#165).
Works with the merged page features: #158 (deletion), #159 (clearing), #160 (names and page info), #162 (order and folders). Builds on the collaborator stamp and visibility rule from #80 and #81.
```

```text
import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { getDefaultAppState } from "./appState";
import { t } from "./i18n";

import type { AppState } from "./types";

export type PageSettings = Pick<
  AppState,
  | "viewBackgroundColor"
  | "scrollX"
  | "scrollY"
  | "zoom"
  | "gridSize"
  | "gridStep"
  | "gridScale"
  | "gridSnapLinked"
  | "gridSnapScale"
  | "gridColor"
  | "gridOpacity"
  | "gridLayer"
  | "gridModeEnabled"
  | "gridSnapEnabled"
  | "frameRendering"
>;

export type DrawingPage = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  showThumbnail: boolean;
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[];
  settings: PageSettings;
}>;

export const PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 50;
export const PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH = 350;

export type PageGridSettings = Pick<
  PageSettings,
  "gridModeEnabled" | "gridSnapEnabled" | "gridSize"
>;

export type PageInfoPatch = {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  showThumbnail: boolean;
  grid: PageGridSettings;
};

export type PageInfoValidation = {
  nameError?: "empty" | "duplicate" | "tooLong";
  descriptionError?: "tooLong";
};

const normalizePageName = (name: string) => name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();

/**
 * Returns `${baseName} N` using the smallest N >= 1 whose name isn't already
 * taken (case-insensitively) by another page.
 */
export const getNextDefaultPageName = (
  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "name">[],
  baseName: string,
): string => {
  const taken = new Set(pages.map((page) => normalizePageName(page.name)));
  let index = 1;
  while (taken.has(normalizePageName(`${baseName} ${index}`))) {
    index++;
  }
  return `${baseName} ${index}`;
};

export const validatePageInfo = (
  info: { name: string; description: string },
  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "id" | "name">[],
  pageId: string,
): PageInfoValidation => {
  const result: PageInfoValidation = {};
  const trimmedName = info.name.trim();

  if (!trimmedName) {
    result.nameError = "empty";
  } else if (trimmedName.length > PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
    result.nameError = "tooLong";
  } else if (
    pages.some(
      (page) =>
        page.id !== pageId &&
        normalizePageName(page.name) === normalizePageName(trimmedName),
    )
  ) {
    result.nameError = "duplicate";
  }

  if (info.description.length > PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH) {
    result.descriptionError = "tooLong";
  }

  return result;
};

export const isPageInfoValid = (validation: PageInfoValidation) =>
  !validation.nameError && !validation.descriptionError;

export const getPageSettings = (appState: PageSettings): PageSettings => ({
  viewBackgroundColor: appState.viewBackgroundColor,
  scrollX: appState.scrollX,
  scrollY: appState.scrollY,
  zoom: appState.zoom,
  gridSize: appState.gridSize,
  gridStep: appState.gridStep,
  gridScale: appState.gridScale,
  gridSnapLinked: appState.gridSnapLinked,
  gridSnapScale: appState.gridSnapScale,
  gridColor: appState.gridColor,
  gridOpacity: appState.gridOpacity,
  gridLayer: appState.gridLayer,
  gridModeEnabled: appState.gridModeEnabled,
  gridSnapEnabled: appState.gridSnapEnabled,
  frameRendering: appState.frameRendering,
});

export const createPage = (id: string, name: string): DrawingPage => ({
  id,
  name,
  description: "",
  showThumbnail: true,
  elements: [],
  settings: getPageSettings(getDefaultAppState()),
});

/** The label shown for a page: its user-editable name (#160). */
export const getPageLabel = (page: DrawingPage) => page.name;

/**
 * Removes the given pages. If the active page is removed, the closest
 * surviving page before it becomes active (or the first one after it).
 * Removing every page leaves a single fresh blank page.
 */
export const deletePages = (
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
  pageIds: readonly string[],
  activePageId: string,
  generateId: () => string,
): { pages: readonly DrawingPage[]; activePageId: string } => {
  const toDelete = new Set(pageIds);
  if (!toDelete.size) {
    throw new Error("No pages selected for deletion");
  }
  for (const id of toDelete) {
    if (!pages.some((page) => page.id === id)) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot delete unknown page ${id}`);
    }
  }
  const activeIndex = pages.findIndex((page) => page.id === activePageId);
  if (activeIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error(`Active page ${activePageId} does not exist`);
  }

  const remaining = pages.filter((page) => !toDelete.has(page.id));
  if (!remaining.length) {
    const page = createPage(
      generateId(),
      getNextDefaultPageName([], t("labels.page")),
    );
    return { pages: [page], activePageId: page.id };
  }
  if (!toDelete.has(activePageId)) {
    return { pages: remaining, activePageId };
  }
  const previous = pages
    .slice(0, activeIndex)
    .reverse()
    .find((page) => !toDelete.has(page.id));
  // no survivor before the active page => remaining[0] is the first after it
  return { pages: remaining, activePageId: (previous ?? remaining[0]).id };
};

/**
 * Parses 1-based page positions like "2-4, 7" into page ids (in page order).
 * Returns null for anything invalid: empty input, non-numbers, zero,
 * out-of-range positions, or reversed ranges like "4-2".
 */
export const parsePageRange = (
  input: string,
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
): string[] | null => {
  const tokens = input.split(",").map((token) => token.trim());
  const positions = new Set<number>();
  for (const token of tokens) {
    const match = /^(\d+)(?:\s*-\s*(\d+))?$/.exec(token);
    if (!match) {
      return null;
    }
    const start = Number(match[1]);
    const end = match[2] === undefined ? start : Number(match[2]);
    if (start < 1 || end > pages.length || start > end) {
      return null;
    }
    for (let position = start; position <= end; position++) {
      positions.add(position);
    }
  }
  return pages
    .filter((_, index) => positions.has(index + 1))
    .map((page) => page.id);
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Page order and folders (#162)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type PageFolder = Readonly<{
  type: "folder";
  id: string;
  name: string;
  collapsed: boolean;
  pageIds: readonly string[];
}>;

export type PageNavNode =
  | Readonly<{ type: "page"; pageId: string }>
  | PageFolder;

/**
 * What the page navigation shows, top to bottom. Folders hold pages only
 * (never other folders). Flattening it gives the order of `pages`.
 */
export type PageTree = readonly PageNavNode[];

/** A page tab or a folder header in the page navigation. */
export type PageNavRef = Readonly<{ type: "page" | "folder"; id: string }>;

export type PageDropPlacement = "before" | "after";

export const createPageTree = (pages: readonly DrawingPage[]): PageTree =>
  pages.map((page) => ({ type: "page", pageId: page.id }));

/** Page ids in navigation order, with folder contents in place. */
export const getPageOrder = (tree: PageTree): string[] =>
  tree.flatMap((node) => (node.type === "page" ? [node.pageId] : node.pageIds));

/** Sorts `pages` into the tree's order. The tree must hold exactly these pages. */
export const orderPages = (
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
  tree: PageTree,
): DrawingPage[] => {
  const order = getPageOrder(tree);
  if (order.length !== pages.length) {
    throw new Error("Page tree and pages are out of sync");
  }
  const byId = new Map(pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));
  return order.map((id) => {
    const page = byId.get(id);
    if (!page) {
      throw new Error(`Page tree references unknown page ${id}`);
    }
    return page;
  });
};

const pruneEmptyFolders = (tree: PageTree): PageTree =>
  tree.filter((node) => node.type === "page" || node.pageIds.length > 0);

/**
 * Brings the tree in line with `pages`: drops pages that no longer exist
 * (and folders left empty), and appends new pages at the end.
 */
export const syncPageTree = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
): PageTree => {
  const pageIds = new Set(pages.map((page) => page.id));
  const kept = pruneEmptyFolders(
    tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] => {
      if (node.type === "page") {
        return pageIds.has(node.pageId) ? [node] : [];
      }
      return [
        { ...node, pageIds: node.pageIds.filter((id) => pageIds.has(id)) },
      ];
    }),
  );
  const inTree = new Set(getPageOrder(kept));
  return [
    ...kept,
    ...pages
      .filter((page) => !inTree.has(page.id))
      .map((page): PageNavNode => ({ type: "page", pageId: page.id })),
  ];
};

const assertPageInTree = (tree: PageTree, pageId: string) => {
  if (!getPageOrder(tree).includes(pageId)) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown page ${pageId}`);
  }
};

const findFolder = (tree: PageTree, folderId: string): PageFolder => {
  const folder = tree.find(
    (node): node is PageFolder =>
      node.type === "folder" && node.id === folderId,
  );
  if (!folder) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown page folder ${folderId}`);
  }
  return folder;
};

/** The folder holding the page, or null if the page is at the top level. */
export const getPageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
): PageFolder | null => {
  assertPageInTree(tree, pageId);
  return (
    tree.find(
      (node): node is PageFolder =>
        node.type === "folder" && node.pageIds.includes(pageId),
    ) ?? null
  );
};

/** Removes the page wherever it is, keeping any folder it leaves empty. */
const removePage = (tree: PageTree, pageId: string): PageTree =>
  tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] => {
    if (node.type === "page") {
      return node.pageId === pageId ? [] : [node];
    }
    return node.pageIds.includes(pageId)
      ? [{ ...node, pageIds: node.pageIds.filter((id) => id !== pageId) }]
      : [node];
  });

const insertAt = <T>(list: readonly T[], index: number, item: T): T[] => [
  ...list.slice(0, index),
  item,
  ...list.slice(index),
];

/**
 * Parses a 1-based target position. Zero is allowed (it means "first");
 * negatives, decimals, text and empty input are invalid and give null.
 */
export const parsePagePosition = (input: string): number | null => {
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  return /^\d+$/.test(trimmed) ? Number(trimmed) : null;
};

/**
 * The page's 1-based position within its own list (the top level, where a
 * folder takes one slot, or its folder), and that list's length.
 */
export const getPagePosition = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
): { position: number; count: number } => {
  const folder = getPageFolder(tree, pageId);
  if (folder) {
    return {
      position: folder.pageIds.indexOf(pageId) + 1,
      count: folder.pageIds.length,
    };
  }
  return {
    position:
      tree.findIndex((node) => node.type === "page" && node.pageId === pageId) +
      1,
    count: tree.length,
  };
};

/**
 * Moves the page to a 1-based position within its own list: the top level
 * (where a folder takes one slot) or the folder holding it. Positions below
 * 1 move it to the start, positions past the end move it to the end.
 */
export const movePageToPosition = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
  position: number,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = getPageFolder(tree, pageId);
  const clampIndex = (length: number) =>
    Math.min(Math.max(position, 1), length + 1) - 1;

  if (folder) {
    const rest = folder.pageIds.filter((id) => id !== pageId);
    const pageIds = insertAt(rest, clampIndex(rest.length), pageId);
    return tree.map((node) =>
      node === folder ? { ...folder, pageIds } : node,
    );
  }
  const node = tree.find(
    (candidate) => candidate.type === "page" && candidate.pageId === pageId,
  )!;
  const rest = tree.filter((candidate) => candidate !== node);
  return insertAt(rest, clampIndex(rest.length), node);
};

/**
 * Moves a page or folder next to the target, in the target's list. Pages can
 * move into and out of folders this way; folders stay at the top level (a
 * folder dropped next to a page in a folder lands next to that folder).
 * Folders left empty are removed.
 */
export const moveNavItem = (
  tree: PageTree,
  dragged: PageNavRef,
  target: PageNavRef,
  placement: PageDropPlacement,
): PageTree => {
  for (const ref of [dragged, target]) {
    if (ref.type === "page") {
      assertPageInTree(tree, ref.id);
    } else {
      findFolder(tree, ref.id);
    }
  }
  if (dragged.type === target.type && dragged.id === target.id) {
    return tree;
  }

  const offset = placement === "after" ? 1 : 0;
  const topLevelIndex = (nodes: PageTree, ref: PageNavRef) =>
    nodes.findIndex((node) =>
      ref.type === "page"
        ? node.type === "page" && node.pageId === ref.id
        : node.type === "folder" && node.id === ref.id,
    );

  if (dragged.type === "folder") {
    const folder = findFolder(tree, dragged.id);
    const targetFolder =
      target.type === "page" ? getPageFolder(tree, target.id) : null;
    const anchor: PageNavRef = targetFolder
      ? { type: "folder", id: targetFolder.id }
      : target;
    if (anchor.type === "folder" && anchor.id === folder.id) {
      return tree;
    }
    const rest = tree.filter((node) => node !== folder);
    return insertAt(rest, topLevelIndex(rest, anchor) + offset, folder);
  }

  const rest = removePage(tree, dragged.id);
  const targetFolder =
    target.type === "page" ? getPageFolder(rest, target.id) : null;

  let next: PageTree;
  if (targetFolder) {
    const index = targetFolder.pageIds.indexOf(target.id) + offset;
    next = rest.map((node) =>
      node === targetFolder
        ? {
            ...targetFolder,
            pageIds: insertAt(targetFolder.pageIds, index, dragged.id),
          }
        : node,
    );
  } else {
    next = insertAt<PageNavNode>(rest, topLevelIndex(rest, target) + offset, {
      type: "page",
      pageId: dragged.id,
    });
  }
  return pruneEmptyFolders(next);
};

/**
 * Groups the pages into a new, expanded folder at the end of the top level.
 * Pages keep their relative order and leave any folder they were in.
 */
export const createPageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageIds: readonly string[],
  folderId: string,
  name: string,
): PageTree => {
  const trimmedName = name.trim();
  if (!trimmedName) {
    throw new Error("Page folders need a name");
  }
  if (!pageIds.length) {
    throw new Error("No pages selected for the folder");
  }
  pageIds.forEach((id) => assertPageInTree(tree, id));

  const selected = new Set(pageIds);
  const orderedIds = getPageOrder(tree).filter((id) => selected.has(id));
  const rest = pruneEmptyFolders(
    orderedIds.reduce((nodes, id) => removePage(nodes, id), tree),
  );
  return [
    ...rest,
    {
      type: "folder",
      id: folderId,
      name: trimmedName,
      collapsed: false,
      pageIds: orderedIds,
    },
  ];
};

/**
 * Deletes the folder but keeps its pages: they take the folder's place at the
 * top level, in the same order.
 */
export const deletePageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  folderId: string,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = findFolder(tree, folderId);
  return tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] =>
    node === folder
      ? folder.pageIds.map((pageId) => ({ type: "page", pageId }))
      : [node],
  );
};

/**
 * Takes the page out of its folder and puts it at the top level, right after
 * that folder. A folder left empty is removed.
 */
export const removePageFromFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = getPageFolder(tree, pageId);
  if (!folder) {
    throw new Error(`Page ${pageId} is not in a folder`);
  }
  return pruneEmptyFolders(
    tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] =>
      node === folder
        ? [
            {
              ...folder,
              pageIds: folder.pageIds.filter((id) => id !== pageId),
            },
            { type: "page", pageId },
          ]
        : [node],
    ),
  );
};

export const togglePageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  folderId: string,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = findFolder(tree, folderId);
  return tree.map((node) =>
    node === folder ? { ...folder, collapsed: !folder.collapsed } : node,
  );
};
```

```text
  public focusContainer: AppClassProperties["focusContainer"] = () => {

    return this.scene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted();

  public getSceneElements = () => {
    return this.scene.getNonDeletedElements();
  };

  private saveActivePage = () => {
    const activePage = this.pages.find((page) => page.id === this.activePageId);
    if (!activePage) {
      throw new Error(`Active page ${this.activePageId} does not exist`);
    }

    this.pages = this.pages.map((page) =>
      page.id === this.activePageId
        ? {
            ...page,
            elements: this.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
            settings: getPageSettings(this.state),
          }
        : page,
    );
  };

  private getPagesForUI = (): readonly DrawingPage[] => {
    const elements = this.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted();
    const settings = getPageSettings(this.state);
    return this.pages.map((page) =>
      page.id === this.activePageId ? { ...page, elements, settings } : page,
    );
  };

  public getPagesForPersistence = (): readonly DrawingPage[] => {
    this.saveActivePage();
    return this.pages;
  };

  public getActivePageId = (): string => this.activePageId;

  private selectPage = (pageId: string) => {
    const page = this.pages.find((candidate) => candidate.id === pageId);
    if (!page) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot select unknown page ${pageId}`);
    }
    if (pageId === this.activePageId) {
      return;
    }

    this.saveActivePage();
    this.activePageId = pageId;
    this.history.clear();
    this.updateScene({
      elements: page.elements,
      appState: getPageActivationAppState(page.settings),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
  };

  public getPageForInfo = (pageId: string): DrawingPage | null =>
    this.getPagesForUI().find((page) => page.id === pageId) ?? null;

  public openPageInfo = (pageId: string) => {
    if (!this.pages.some((page) => page.id === pageId)) {
      return;
    }
    this.setState({ openDialog: { name: "pageInfo", pageId } });
  };

  public updatePageInfo = (pageId: string, patch: PageInfoPatch) => {
    const target = this.pages.find((page) => page.id === pageId);
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }

    const name = patch.name.trim();
    const validation = validatePageInfo(
      { name, description: patch.description },
      this.pages,
      pageId,
    );
    if (!isPageInfoValid(validation)) {
      return;
    }

    const isActive = pageId === this.activePageId;
    const currentSettings = isActive
      ? getPageSettings(this.state)
      : target.settings;
    const gridSettings = {
      ...patch.grid,
      // opacity 0 hid the grid, so showing it again starts fully visible
      gridOpacity:
        patch.grid.gridModeEnabled && currentSettings.gridOpacity === 0
          ? DEFAULT_GRID_OPACITY
          : currentSettings.gridOpacity,
    };

    this.pages = this.pages.map((page) =>
      page.id === pageId
        ? {
            ...page,
            name,
            description: patch.description,
            showThumbnail: patch.showThumbnail,
            // the active page's settings live in this.state and are written
            // back by saveActivePage(), so only inactive pages update here
            settings: isActive
              ? page.settings
              : { ...page.settings, ...gridSettings },
          }
        : page,
    );

    if (isActive) {
      this.setState({ ...gridSettings, openDialog: null });
    } else {
      this.setState({ openDialog: null });
    }
  };

  /** Applies a new page order/folder layout; scene and history are untouched. */
  private applyPageTree = (tree: PageTree) => {
    this.pages = orderPages(this.pages, tree);
    this.pageTree = tree;
    this.triggerRender();
  };

  public getPageTree = (): PageTree => this.pageTree;

  /** The page's 1-based position in its list (top level or its folder). */
  public getPagePosition = (pageId: string) =>
    getPagePosition(this.pageTree, pageId);

  /**
   * Moves the page to a typed 1-based position (#162). Zero means first and
   * too-high numbers mean last; negatives and non-numbers are rejected with
   * a toast and nothing moves. Returns whether the page moved.
   */
  public movePageToPosition = (pageId: string, input: string): boolean => {
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled) {
      return false;
    }
    const position = parsePagePosition(input);
    if (position === null) {
      this.setToast({ message: t("errors.invalidPagePosition") });
      return false;
    }
    this.applyPageTree(movePageToPosition(this.pageTree, pageId, position));
    return true;
  };

  private movePageNavItem = (
    dragged: PageNavRef,
    target: PageNavRef,
    placement: PageDropPlacement,
  ) => {
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled) {
      return;
    }
    this.applyPageTree(moveNavItem(this.pageTree, dragged, target, placement));
  };

  private createPageFolder = (pageIds: readonly string[], name: string) => {
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled || !pageIds.length || !name.trim()) {
      return;
    }
    this.applyPageTree(
      createPageFolder(this.pageTree, pageIds, nanoid(), name),
    );
  };

  private togglePageFolder = (folderId: string) => {
    this.applyPageTree(togglePageFolder(this.pageTree, folderId));
  };

  /** Deletes the folder only; its pages move back to the top level. */
  private deletePageFolder = (folderId: string) => {
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled) {
      return;
    }
    this.applyPageTree(deletePageFolder(this.pageTree, folderId));
  };

  public isPageInFolder = (pageId: string): boolean =>
    !!getPageFolder(this.pageTree, pageId);

  /** Moves the page out of its folder, right after that folder. */
  public removePageFromFolder = (pageId: string) => {
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled || !getPageFolder(this.pageTree, pageId)) {
      return;
    }
    this.applyPageTree(removePageFromFolder(this.pageTree, pageId));
  };

  private createPage = () => {
    const page = createPage(
      nanoid(),
      getNextDefaultPageName(this.pages, t("labels.page")),
    );
    this.saveActivePage();
    this.pages = [...this.pages, page];
    this.pageTree = syncPageTree(this.pageTree, this.pages);
    this.activePageId = page.id;
    this.history.clear();
    this.updateScene({
      elements: page.elements,
      appState: getPageActivationAppState(page.settings),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
  };

  private deletePages = (pageIds: readonly string[]) => {
    // shortcut: view mode is the only lock, revisit with real permissions
    if (this.state.viewModeEnabled) {
      return;
    }
    const previousActivePageId = this.activePageId;
    const result = deletePages(this.pages, pageIds, this.activePageId, nanoid);
    this.pages = [...result.pages];
    this.activePageId = result.activePageId;
    this.pageTree = syncPageTree(this.pageTree, this.pages);

    if (result.activePageId === previousActivePageId) {
      // scene unchanged; re-render so the page list drops the deleted pages
      this.triggerRender();
      return;
    }
    const page = this.pages.find(
      (candidate) => candidate.id === result.activePageId,
    )!;
    this.history.clear();
    this.updateScene({
      elements: page.elements,
      appState: getPageActivationAppState(page.settings),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
  };

  public getPageIds = (): string[] => this.pages.map((page) => page.id);

  /**
   * Removes all elements from the given pages, keeping the (now empty) pages
   * and their settings. Clearing the active page is undoable; clearing other
   * pages is not, since history only tracks the active page.
   */
  public clearPages = (pageIds: readonly string[]) => {
    const ids = new Set(pageIds);

    this.pages = this.pages.map((page) =>
      ids.has(page.id) && page.id !== this.activePageId
        ? { ...page, elements: [] }
        : page,
    );

    if (ids.has(this.activePageId)) {
      this.updateScene({
        elements: this.scene

            element.isDeleted

          ),
        appState: {
          selectedElementIds: {},
          selectedGroupIds: {},
          editingGroupId: null,
        },
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      });
    } else {
      // inactive pages live outside React state; re-render their previews
      this.forceUpdate();
    }
  };

  private enterPageClearingMode = () => {
    this.pageSelectionMode = "clear";
    this.setState({ pageClearingSelection: [] });
  };

  private enterPageDeletingMode = () => {
    this.pageSelectionMode = "delete";
    this.setState({ pageClearingSelection: [] });
  };

  private exitPageClearingMode = () => {
    this.setState({ pageClearingSelection: null });
  };

  private togglePageForClearing = (pageId: string) => {
    this.setState((state) => {
      if (!state.pageClearingSelection) {
        return null;
      }
      const selection = state.pageClearingSelection;

        pageClearingSelection: selection.includes(pageId)

  /** Replaces the page selection of the active page mode (clearing/deleting). */
  private setPageSelection = (pageIds: readonly string[]) => {
    this.setState((state) =>
      state.pageClearingSelection

  };

  private setAllPagesForClearing = (selected: boolean) => {
    this.setState({
      pageClearingSelection: selected ? this.getPageIds() : [],

  };

  private clearSelectedPages = () => {
    const selection = this.state.pageClearingSelection;
    if (!selection?.length) {
      return;
    }
    this.clearPages(selection);

    this.setState({ pageClearingSelection: [] });
  };

  private deleteSelectedPages = () => {
    const selection = this.state.pageClearingSelection;
    if (!selection?.length) {
      return;
    }
    this.deletePages(selection);
    // like clearing mode, stay in deleting mode until the user exits it
    this.setState({ pageClearingSelection: [] });
  };
```

```text
        return {
          savedFiles: savedFiles.reduce(
            (acc: Map<FileId, BinaryFileData>, id) => {
              const fileData = addedFiles.get(id);
              if (fileData) {
                acc.set(id, fileData);
              }
              return acc;
            },
            new Map(),
          ),
          erroredFiles: erroredFiles.reduce(
            (acc: Map<FileId, BinaryFileData>, id) => {
              const fileData = addedFiles.get(id);
              if (fileData) {
                acc.set(id, fileData);
              }
              return acc;
            },
            new Map(),
          ),
        };
      },
    });
    this.excalidrawAPI = props.excalidrawAPI;
    this.activeIntervalId = null;
    this.idleTimeoutId = null;
  }

  private onUmmount: (() => void) | null = null;

  componentDidMount() {
    window.addEventListener(EVENT.BEFORE_UNLOAD, this.beforeUnload);
    window.addEventListener("online", this.onOfflineStatusToggle);
    window.addEventListener("offline", this.onOfflineStatusToggle);
    window.addEventListener(EVENT.UNLOAD, this.onUnload);

    const unsubOnUserFollow = this.excalidrawAPI.onUserFollow((payload) => {
      this.portal.socket && this.portal.broadcastUserFollowed(payload);
    });
    const throttledRelayUserViewportBounds = throttleRAF(
      this.relayVisibleSceneBounds,
    );
    const unsubOnScrollChange = this.excalidrawAPI.onScrollChange(() =>
      throttledRelayUserViewportBounds(),
    );
    this.onUmmount = () => {
      unsubOnUserFollow();
      unsubOnScrollChange();
    };

    this.onOfflineStatusToggle();

    const collabAPI: CollabAPI = {
      isCollaborating: this.isCollaborating,
      onPointerUpdate: this.onPointerUpdate,
      startCollaboration: this.startCollaboration,
      syncElements: this.syncElements,
      saveCollaboratorSettings: this.saveCollaboratorSettings,
      fetchImageFilesFromFirebase: this.fetchImageFilesFromFirebase,
      stopCollaboration: this.stopCollaboration,
      setUsername: this.setUsername,
      getUsername: this.getUsername,
      getActiveRoomLink: this.getActiveRoomLink,
      setCollabError: this.setErrorDialog,
    };

    appJotaiStore.set(collabAPIAtom, collabAPI);

    if (isTestEnv() || isDevEnv()) {
      window.collab = window.collab || ({} as Window["collab"]);
      Object.defineProperties(window, {
        collab: {
          configurable: true,
          value: this,
        },
      });
    }
  }

  onOfflineStatusToggle = () => {
    appJotaiStore.set(isOfflineAtom, !window.navigator.onLine);
  };

  componentWillUnmount() {
    window.removeEventListener("online", this.onOfflineStatusToggle);
    window.removeEventListener("offline", this.onOfflineStatusToggle);
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT.BEFORE_UNLOAD, this.beforeUnload);
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT.UNLOAD, this.onUnload);
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT.POINTER_MOVE, this.onPointerMove);
    window.removeEventListener(
      EVENT.VISIBILITY_CHANGE,
      this.onVisibilityChange,
    );
    if (this.activeIntervalId) {
      window.clearInterval(this.activeIntervalId);
      this.activeIntervalId = null;
    }
    if (this.idleTimeoutId) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.idleTimeoutId);
      this.idleTimeoutId = null;
    }
    this.onUmmount?.();
  }

  isCollaborating = () => appJotaiStore.get(isCollaboratingAtom)!;

  private setIsCollaborating = (isCollaborating: boolean) => {
    appJotaiStore.set(isCollaboratingAtom, isCollaborating);
  };

  private onUnload = () => {
    this.destroySocketClient({ isUnload: true });
  };

  private beforeUnload = withBatchedUpdates((event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
    const syncableElements = getSyncableElements(
      this.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
    );

    if (
      this.isCollaborating() &&
      (this.fileManager.shouldPreventUnload(syncableElements) ||
        !isSavedToFirebase(this.portal, syncableElements))
    ) {
      // this won't run in time if user decides to leave the site, but
      //  the purpose is to run in immediately after user decides to stay
      this.saveCollabRoomToFirebase(syncableElements);

      if (import.meta.env.VITE_APP_DISABLE_PREVENT_UNLOAD !== "true") {
        preventUnload(event);
      } else {
        console.warn(
          "preventing unload disabled (VITE_APP_DISABLE_PREVENT_UNLOAD)",
        );
      }
    }
  });

  saveCollabRoomToFirebase = async (
    syncableElements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  ) => {
    syncableElements = cloneJSON(syncableElements);
    try {
      const storedElements = await saveToFirebase(
        this.portal,
        syncableElements,
        this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState(),
        this.isKnownToRoom,
      );

      this.resetErrorIndicator();

      if (this.isCollaborating() && storedElements) {
        for (const element of storedElements) {
          this.storedElementIds.add(element.id);
        }
        this.handleRemoteSceneUpdate(
          this._reconcileElements(storedElements, "storedScene"),
        );
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      const errorMessage = /is longer than.*?bytes/.test(error.message)
        ? t("errors.collabSaveFailed_sizeExceeded")
        : t("errors.collabSaveFailed");

      if (
        !this.state.dialogNotifiedErrors[errorMessage] ||
        !this.isCollaborating()
      ) {
        this.setErrorDialog(errorMessage);
        this.setState({
          dialogNotifiedErrors: {
            ...this.state.dialogNotifiedErrors,
            [errorMessage]: true,
          },
        });
      }

      if (this.isCollaborating()) {
        this.setErrorIndicator(errorMessage);
      }

      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  stopCollaboration = (keepRemoteState = true) => {
    this.queueBroadcastAllElements.cancel();
    this.queueSaveToFirebase.cancel();
    this.loadImageFiles.cancel();
    this.resetErrorIndicator(true);

    this.saveCollabRoomToFirebase(
      getSyncableElements(
        this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
      ),
    );

    if (this.portal.socket && this.fallbackInitializationHandler) {
      this.portal.socket.off(
        "connect_error",
        this.fallbackInitializationHandler,
      );
    }

    if (!keepRemoteState) {
      LocalData.fileStorage.reset();
      this.destroySocketClient();
    } else if (window.confirm(t("alerts.collabStopOverridePrompt"))) {
      // hack to ensure that we prefer we disregard any new browser state
      // that could have been saved in other tabs while we were collaborating
      resetBrowserStateVersions();

      window.history.pushState({}, APP_NAME, window.location.origin);
      this.destroySocketClient();

      LocalData.fileStorage.reset();

      const elements = this.excalidrawAPI
        .getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()
        .map((element) => {
          if (isImageElement(element) && element.status === "saved") {
            return newElementWith(element, { status: "pending" });
          }
          return element;
        });

      this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
        elements,
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
      });
    }
  };

  private destroySocketClient = (opts?: { isUnload: boolean }) => {
    this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = -1;
    this.remoteElementIds = new Set();
    this.storedElementIds = new Set();
    this.portal.close();
    this.fileManager.reset();
    if (!opts?.isUnload) {
      this.setIsCollaborating(false);
      this.setActiveRoomLink(null);
      this.collaborators = new Map();
      this.collaboratorDirectory = new Map();
      this.directoryRoomId = null;
      this.settingsRoomId = null;
      this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
        collaborators: this.collaborators,
        appState: {
          // back to solo: no directory (every creator its own bucket) and
          // nothing hidden
          collaboratorDirectory: null,
          hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(),
        },
      });
      LocalData.resumeSave("collaboration");
    }
  };
```

```text
  private fallbackInitializationHandler: null | (() => any) = null;

  startCollaboration = async (
    existingRoomLinkData: null | { roomId: string; roomKey: string },
  ) => {
    if (!this.state.username) {
      import("@excalidraw/random-username").then(({ getRandomUsername }) => {
        const username = getRandomUsername();
        this.setUsername(username);
      });
    }

    if (this.portal.socket) {
      return null;
    }

    // before the socket opens, so all our messages carry the id
    this.clientId = await getClientId();
    this.remoteElementIds = new Set();
    this.storedElementIds = new Set();

    let roomId;
    let roomKey;

    if (existingRoomLinkData) {
      ({ roomId, roomKey } = existingRoomLinkData);
    } else {
      ({ roomId, roomKey } = await generateCollaborationLinkData());
      window.history.pushState(
        {},
        APP_NAME,
        getCollaborationLink({ roomId, roomKey }),
      );
    }

    // "Previously seen" survives tab close (per room); include ourselves so
    // a future tab of ours that gets a different id can still name these
    // drawings
    this.directoryRoomId = roomId;
    this.collaboratorDirectory = loadCollaboratorDirectory(roomId);
    this.recordSighting(this.clientId, this.state.username);
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
      appState: {
        collaboratorDirectory: this.collaboratorDirectory,
        // this room's saved dropdown settings (#83), never another room's
        ...this.loadRoomSettings(roomId),
      },
    });

    // TODO: `ImportedDataState` type here seems abused
    const scenePromise = resolvablePromise<
      | (ImportedDataState & { elements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[] })
      | null
    >();

    this.setIsCollaborating(true);
    LocalData.pauseSave("collaboration");

    const { default: socketIOClient } = await import(
      /* webpackChunkName: "socketIoClient" */ "socket.io-client"
    );

    const fallbackInitializationHandler = () => {
      this.initializeRoom({
        roomLinkData: existingRoomLinkData,
        fetchScene: true,
      }).then((scene) => {
        scenePromise.resolve(scene);
      });
    };
    this.fallbackInitializationHandler = fallbackInitializationHandler;

    try {
      this.portal.socket = this.portal.open(
        socketIOClient(import.meta.env.VITE_APP_WS_SERVER_URL, {
          transports: ["websocket", "polling"],
        }),
        roomId,
        roomKey,
      );

      this.portal.socket.once("connect_error", fallbackInitializationHandler);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      this.setErrorDialog(error.message);
      return null;
    }

    if (existingRoomLinkData) {
      // when joining existing room, don't merge it with current scene data
      this.resetSceneKeepingSettings(roomId);
    } else {
      const elements = this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElements().map((element) => {
        if (isImageElement(element) && element.status === "saved") {
          return newElementWith(element, { status: "pending" });
        }
        return element;
      });
      // remove deleted elements from elements array to ensure we don't
      // expose potentially sensitive user data in case user manually deletes
      // existing elements (or clears scene), which would otherwise be persisted
      // to database even if deleted before creating the room.
      this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
        elements,
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
      });

      // a new room starts from our own canvas, so everything in it is ours.
      // Stamp now (syncElements only stamps once the socket is initialized)
      // so the room's stored scene carries the stamps from the first save
      this.stampLocallyCreatedElements(elements);

      this.saveCollabRoomToFirebase(getSyncableElements(elements));
    }

    // fallback in case you're not alone in the room but still don't receive
    // initial SCENE_INIT message
    this.socketInitializationTimer = window.setTimeout(
      fallbackInitializationHandler,
      INITIAL_SCENE_UPDATE_TIMEOUT,
    );

    // All socket listeners are moving to Portal
    this.portal.socket.on(
      "client-broadcast",
      async (encryptedData: ArrayBuffer, iv: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>) => {
        if (!this.portal.roomKey) {
          return;
        }

        const decryptedData = await this.decryptPayload(
          iv,
          encryptedData,
          this.portal.roomKey,
        );

        switch (decryptedData.type) {
          case WS_SUBTYPES.INVALID_RESPONSE:
            return;
          case WS_SUBTYPES.INIT: {
            if (!this.portal.socketInitialized) {
              this.initializeRoom({ fetchScene: false });
              const remoteElements = toBrandedType<
                readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[]
              >(decryptedData.payload.elements);
              const reconciledElements = this._reconcileElements(
                remoteElements,
                "initialScene",
              );
              this.handleRemoteSceneUpdate(reconciledElements);
              // noop if already resolved via init from firebase
              scenePromise.resolve({
                elements: reconciledElements,
                scrollToContent: true,
              });
            }
            break;
          }
          case WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE:
            this.handleRemoteSceneUpdate(
              this._reconcileElements(
                toBrandedType<readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[]>(
                  decryptedData.payload.elements,
                ),
                "update",
                decryptedData.payload.sentAt,
              ),
            );
            break;
          case WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION: {
            const { pointer, button, username, selectedElementIds, clientId } =
              decryptedData.payload;

            const socketId: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"]["payload"]["socketId"] =
              decryptedData.payload.socketId ||
              // @ts-ignore legacy, see #2094 (#2097)
              decryptedData.payload.socketID;

            this.updateCollaborator(socketId, {
              pointer,
              button,
              selectedElementIds,
              username,
              ...(clientId ? { id: clientId } : {}),
            });

            break;
          }

          case WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY: {
            const { socketId, clientId, username } = decryptedData.payload;
            this.updateCollaborator(socketId, { id: clientId, username });
            break;
          }

          case WS_SUBTYPES.USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS: {
            const { sceneBounds, socketId } = decryptedData.payload;

            const appState = this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState();

            // we're not following the user
            // (shouldn't happen, but could be late message or bug upstream)
            if (appState.userToFollow?.socketId !== socketId) {
              console.warn(
                `receiving remote client's (from ${socketId}) viewport bounds even though we're not subscribed to it!`,
              );
              return;
            }

            // cross-follow case, ignore updates in this case
            if (
              appState.userToFollow &&
              appState.followedBy.has(appState.userToFollow.socketId)
            ) {
              return;
            }

            this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
              appState: zoomToFitBounds({
                appState,
                bounds: sceneBounds,
                fit: "contain",
              }).appState,
            });

            break;
          }

          case WS_SUBTYPES.IDLE_STATUS: {
            const { userState, socketId, username, clientId } =
              decryptedData.payload;
            this.updateCollaborator(socketId, {
              userState,
              username,
              ...(clientId ? { id: clientId } : {}),
            });
            break;
          }

          default: {
            assertNever(decryptedData, null);
          }
        }
      },
    );

    this.portal.socket.on("first-in-room", async () => {
      if (this.portal.socket) {
        this.portal.socket.off("first-in-room");
      }
      const sceneData = await this.initializeRoom({
        fetchScene: true,
        roomLinkData: existingRoomLinkData,
      });
      scenePromise.resolve(sceneData);
    });

    this.portal.socket.on(
      WS_EVENTS.USER_FOLLOW_ROOM_CHANGE,
      (followedBy: SocketId[]) => {
        this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
          appState: { followedBy: new Set(followedBy) },
        });

        this.relayVisibleSceneBounds({ force: true });
      },
    );

    this.initializeIdleDetector();

    this.setActiveRoomLink(window.location.href);

    return scenePromise;
  };

  private initializeRoom = async ({
    fetchScene,
    roomLinkData,
  }:
    | {
        fetchScene: true;
        roomLinkData: { roomId: string; roomKey: string } | null;
      }
    | { fetchScene: false; roomLinkData?: null }) => {
    clearTimeout(this.socketInitializationTimer!);
    if (this.portal.socket && this.fallbackInitializationHandler) {
      this.portal.socket.off(
        "connect_error",
        this.fallbackInitializationHandler,
      );
    }
    if (fetchScene && roomLinkData && this.portal.socket) {
      this.resetSceneKeepingSettings(roomLinkData.roomId);

      try {
        const elements = await loadFromFirebase(
          roomLinkData.roomId,
          roomLinkData.roomKey,
          this.portal.socket,
        );
        if (elements) {
          this.setLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion(
            getSceneVersion(elements),
          );
          // the stored room scene is returned to the app directly (not via
          // _reconcileElements), so mark it here. The scene was just reset,
          // so all of it is remote.
          this.markRemoteElements(elements, null);

          return {
            elements,
            scrollToContent: true,
          };
        }
      } catch (error: any) {
        // log the error and move on. other peers will sync us the scene.
        console.error(error);
      } finally {
        this.portal.socketInitialized = true;
        this.portal.broadcastUserIdentity();
        // resetScene() above wiped it from appState
        this.publishCollaboratorDirectory();
      }
    } else {
      this.portal.socketInitialized = true;
      this.portal.broadcastUserIdentity();
      this.publishCollaboratorDirectory();
    }
    return null;
  };

  /**
   * @param source where the remote elements come from:
   * - `"update"`: a peer's incremental update
   * - `"initialScene"`: the room scene sent to us when joining
   * - `"storedScene"`: the room's stored scene (the reference for what the
   *   room has)
   */
  private _reconcileElements = (
    remoteElements: readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
    source: "update" | "initialScene" | "storedScene" = "update",
    /** for updates: the sender's clock when it sent them */
    senderNow?: number,
  ): ReconciledExcalidrawElement[] => {
    const appState = this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState();

    const existingElements = this.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted();

    // don't let a peer bring back elements whose deletion expired (see
    // expiredDeletions.ts)
    if (source === "update") {
      const expired = getExpiredResurrections(
        remoteElements,
        this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsMapIncludingDeleted(),
        senderNow,
      );
      if (expired.size) {
        remoteElements = remoteElements.filter((el) => !expired.has(el.id));
      }
    }

    // peers' new elements (INIT/UPDATE) + stored-scene echoes. Our own
    // elements are already in the scene, so they're never marked remote.
    this.markRemoteElements(
      remoteElements,
      this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsMapIncludingDeleted(),
    );

    // NOTE ideally we restore _after_ reconciliation but we can't do that
    // as we'd regenerate even elements such as appState.newElement which would
    // break the state
    remoteElements = restoreElements(remoteElements, existingElements);

    let reconciledElements = reconcileElements(
      existingElements,
      remoteElements,
      appState,
    );

    reconciledElements = bumpElementVersions(
      reconciledElements,
      existingElements,
    );

    // Avoid broadcasting to the rest of the collaborators the scene
    // we just received!
    // Note: this needs to be set before updating the scene as it
    // synchronously calls render.
    this.setLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion(
      getSceneVersion(reconciledElements),
    );

    // our live copies of elements the room deleted so long ago it forgot:
    // delete them here too. After the line above, so the fresh deletes are
    // broadcast (to other clients that may hold stale copies too).
    if (source === "storedScene") {
      const expired = new Set(
        getLocalElementsWithExpiredDeletion(
          reconciledElements,
          new Set(remoteElements.map((el) => el.id)),
          this.isKnownToRoom,
        ).map((el) => el.id),
      );
      if (expired.size) {
        reconciledElements = reconciledElements.map((el) =>
          expired.has(el.id)
            ? (newElementWith(el, {
                isDeleted: true,
              }) as ReconciledExcalidrawElement)
            : el,
        );
      }
    }

    return reconciledElements;
  };

  /**
   * Whether the element was ever in the room's scene as far as this client
   * knows: received from the room, or part of the stored scene after one of
   * our saves.
   */
  private isKnownToRoom = (elementId: string) =>
    this.remoteElementIds.has(elementId) ||
    this.storedElementIds.has(elementId);

  private loadImageFiles = throttle(async () => {
    const { loadedFiles, erroredFiles } =
      await this.fetchImageFilesFromFirebase({
        elements: this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
      });

    this.excalidrawAPI.addFiles(loadedFiles);

    updateStaleImageStatuses({
      excalidrawAPI: this.excalidrawAPI,
      erroredFiles,
      elements: this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
    });
  }, LOAD_IMAGES_TIMEOUT);

  private handleRemoteSceneUpdate = (
    elements: ReconciledExcalidrawElement[],
  ) => {
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
      elements,
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });

    this.loadImageFiles();
  };

  private onPointerMove = () => {
    if (this.idleTimeoutId) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.idleTimeoutId);
      this.idleTimeoutId = null;
    }

    this.idleTimeoutId = window.setTimeout(this.reportIdle, IDLE_THRESHOLD);

    if (!this.activeIntervalId) {
      this.activeIntervalId = window.setInterval(
        this.reportActive,
        ACTIVE_THRESHOLD,
      );
    }
  };

  private onVisibilityChange = () => {
    if (document.hidden) {
      if (this.idleTimeoutId) {
        window.clearTimeout(this.idleTimeoutId);
        this.idleTimeoutId = null;
      }
      if (this.activeIntervalId) {
        window.clearInterval(this.activeIntervalId);
        this.activeIntervalId = null;
      }
      this.onIdleStateChange(UserIdleState.AWAY);
    } else {
      this.idleTimeoutId = window.setTimeout(this.reportIdle, IDLE_THRESHOLD);
      this.activeIntervalId = window.setInterval(
        this.reportActive,
        ACTIVE_THRESHOLD,
      );
      this.onIdleStateChange(UserIdleState.ACTIVE);
    }
  };

  private reportIdle = () => {
    this.onIdleStateChange(UserIdleState.IDLE);
    if (this.activeIntervalId) {
      window.clearInterval(this.activeIntervalId);
      this.activeIntervalId = null;
    }
  };

  private reportActive = () => {
    this.onIdleStateChange(UserIdleState.ACTIVE);
  };

  private initializeIdleDetector = () => {
    document.addEventListener(EVENT.POINTER_MOVE, this.onPointerMove);
    document.addEventListener(EVENT.VISIBILITY_CHANGE, this.onVisibilityChange);
  };

  setCollaborators(sockets: SocketId[]) {
    const collaborators: InstanceType<typeof Collab>["collaborators"] =
      new Map();
    for (const socketId of sockets) {
      const isCurrentUser = socketId === this.portal.socket?.id;
      collaborators.set(
        socketId,
        Object.assign(
          {},
          this.collaborators.get(socketId),
          { isCurrentUser },
          // lets the editor tell which creator id is "you"
          isCurrentUser && this.clientId ? { id: this.clientId } : {},
        ),
      );
    }
    // collaborators who just left: refresh when we last saw them
    for (const [socketId, collaborator] of this.collaborators) {
      if (!collaborators.has(socketId) && collaborator.id) {
        this.recordSighting(collaborator.id, collaborator.username);
      }
    }
    this.collaborators = collaborators;
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
      collaborators,
      appState: { collaboratorDirectory: this.collaboratorDirectory },
    });
  }

  updateCollaborator = (socketId: SocketId, updates: Partial<Collaborator>) => {
    const collaborators = new Map(this.collaborators);
    const user: Mutable<Collaborator> = Object.assign(
      {},
      collaborators.get(socketId),
      updates,
      {
        isCurrentUser: socketId === this.portal.socket?.id,
      },
    );
    collaborators.set(socketId, user);
    this.collaborators = collaborators;

    // #83: seen for the first time (checked before recording the sighting)
    // → starts in the "New collaborators" default
    const newcomerState =
      user.id &&
      this.directoryRoomId &&
      !this.collaboratorDirectory.has(user.id)
        ? getNewcomerState(user.id, {
            ...this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState(),
            collaboratorDirectory: this.collaboratorDirectory,
          })
        : null;

    if (user.id) {
      this.recordSighting(user.id, user.username);
    }

    const appState: Pick<AppState, "collaboratorDirectory"> = {
      ...newcomerState,
      collaboratorDirectory: this.collaboratorDirectory,
    };
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({ collaborators, appState });
  };

  public setLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = (version: number) => {
    this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = version;
  };

  public getLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = () => {
    return this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion;
  };

  public getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted = () => {
    return this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted();
  };

  public getClientId = () => this.clientId;

  /**
   * Records a sighting of `clientId` in the current room's directory, saving
   * it when it changed. Returns whether it changed.
   */
  private recordSighting = (clientId: string, username?: string | null) => {
    if (!this.directoryRoomId) {
      return false;
    }
    const next = recordCollaboratorSighting(
      this.collaboratorDirectory,
      clientId,
      username,
    );
    if (!next) {
      return false;
    }
    this.collaboratorDirectory = next;
    saveCollaboratorDirectory(this.directoryRoomId, next);
    return true;
  };

  /**
   * (Re)publishes the directory to the editor. Also called after scene resets
   * (joining a room resets appState), so it's safe to call redundantly.
   */
  private publishCollaboratorDirectory = () => {
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
      appState: { collaboratorDirectory: this.collaboratorDirectory },
    });
  };

  /**
   * Loads `roomId`'s saved dropdown settings (#83) to put in the editor, and
   * from then on saves them when they change.
   */
  private loadRoomSettings = (roomId: string) => {
    this.savedSettings = loadCollaboratorSettings(roomId, this.clientId);
    this.settingsRoomId = roomId;
    return this.savedSettings;
  };

  /**
   * Resets the scene for joining `roomId`. The reset also resets appState,
   * so this room's saved settings (#83) are put back right away, and not
   * saved in between.
   */
  private resetSceneKeepingSettings = (roomId: string) => {
    this.settingsRoomId = null;
    this.excalidrawAPI.resetScene();
    this.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({ appState: this.loadRoomSettings(roomId) });
  };

  /**
   * Saves the dropdown's settings (#83) when they changed. Called on every
   * editor change, so it only compares references until something changed.
   */
  saveCollaboratorSettings = (appState: AppState) => {
    if (
      !this.settingsRoomId ||
      (this.savedSettings &&
        isSameCollaboratorSettings(this.savedSettings, appState))
    ) {
      return;
    }
    this.savedSettings = appState;
    saveCollaboratorSettings(this.settingsRoomId, appState, this.clientId);
  };

  private markRemoteElements = (
    elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
    existingElementsMap: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> | null,
  ) => {
    for (const element of elements) {
      // already in our scene → either ours (an echo) or already known
      if (!existingElementsMap?.has(element.id)) {
        this.remoteElementIds.add(element.id);
      }
    }
  };

  /**
   * One-time creator stamp for elements this client introduced to the room.
   * Mutates in place (safe during in-progress drawing) and bumps versions so
   * the stamp syncs.
   */
  private stampLocallyCreatedElements = (
    elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  ) => {
    if (!this.clientId) {
      return;
    }
    for (const element of getElementsToStamp(
      elements,
      this.remoteElementIds,
      this.clientId,
    )) {
      this.excalidrawAPI.mutateElement(
        element as Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>,
        { customData: getStampedCustomData(element, this.clientId) },
        // not a visual change → no re-render needed
        false,
      );
    }
  };

  onPointerUpdate = throttle(
    (payload: {
      pointer: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"]["payload"]["pointer"];
      button: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"]["payload"]["button"];
      pointersMap: Gesture["pointers"];
    }) => {
      payload.pointersMap.size < 2 &&
        this.portal.socket &&
        this.portal.broadcastMouseLocation(payload);
    },
    CURSOR_SYNC_TIMEOUT,
  );

  relayVisibleSceneBounds = (props?: { force: boolean }) => {
    const appState = this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState();

    if (this.portal.socket && (appState.followedBy.size > 0 || props?.force)) {
      this.portal.broadcastVisibleSceneBounds(
        {
          sceneBounds: getVisibleSceneBounds(appState),
        },
        `follow@${this.portal.socket.id}`,
      );
    }
  };

  onIdleStateChange = (userState: UserIdleState) => {
    this.portal.broadcastIdleChange(userState);
  };

  broadcastElements = (elements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[]) => {
    if (
      getSceneVersion(elements) >
      this.getLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion()
    ) {
      this.portal.broadcastScene(WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE, elements, false);
      this.lastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion = getSceneVersion(elements);
      this.queueBroadcastAllElements();
    }
  };

  syncElements = (elements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[]) => {
    // only once the room's scene has loaded, so every room element is already
    // marked remote and can't be mistaken for one of ours
    if (this.portal.socketInitialized) {
      this.stampLocallyCreatedElements(elements);
    }
    this.broadcastElements(elements);
    this.queueSaveToFirebase();
  };

  queueBroadcastAllElements = throttle(() => {
    this.portal.broadcastScene(
      WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
      this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
      true,
    );
    const currentVersion = this.getLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion();
    const newVersion = Math.max(
      currentVersion,
      getSceneVersion(this.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()),
    );
    this.setLastBroadcastedOrReceivedSceneVersion(newVersion);
  }, SYNC_FULL_SCENE_INTERVAL_MS);

  queueSaveToFirebase = throttle(
    () => {
      if (this.portal.socketInitialized) {
        this.saveCollabRoomToFirebase(
          getSyncableElements(
            this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
          ),
        );
      }
    },
    SYNC_FULL_SCENE_INTERVAL_MS,
    { leading: false },
  );

  setUsername = (username: string) => {
    this.setState({ username });
    saveUsernameToLocalStorage(username);
    // no-op unless in an initialized room
    this.portal.broadcastUserIdentity(username);
    if (this.clientId && this.recordSighting(this.clientId, username)) {
      this.publishCollaboratorDirectory();
    }
  };

  getUsername = () => this.state.username;

  setActiveRoomLink = (activeRoomLink: string | null) => {
    this.setState({ activeRoomLink });
    appJotaiStore.set(activeRoomLinkAtom, activeRoomLink);
  };

  getActiveRoomLink = () => this.state.activeRoomLink;

  setErrorIndicator = (errorMessage: string | null) => {
    appJotaiStore.set(collabErrorIndicatorAtom, {
      message: errorMessage,
      nonce: Date.now(),
    });
  };

  resetErrorIndicator = (resetDialogNotifiedErrors = false) => {
    appJotaiStore.set(collabErrorIndicatorAtom, { message: null, nonce: 0 });
    if (resetDialogNotifiedErrors) {
      this.setState({
        dialogNotifiedErrors: {},
      });
    }
  };

  setErrorDialog = (errorMessage: string | null) => {
    this.setState({
      errorMessage,
    });
  };

  render() {
    const { errorMessage } = this.state;

    return (
      <>
        {errorMessage != null && (
          <ErrorDialog onClose={() => this.setErrorDialog(null)}>
            {errorMessage}
          </ErrorDialog>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    collab: InstanceType<typeof Collab>;
  }
}

if (isTestEnv() || isDevEnv()) {
  window.collab = window.collab || ({} as Window["collab"]);
}

export default Collab;

export type TCollabClass = Collab;
```
