import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { trackEvent } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/analytics";
import { encryptData } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption";
import { newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import throttle from "lodash.throttle";

import type { UserIdleState } from "@excalidraw/common";
import type { OrderedExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";
import type {
  OnUserFollowedPayload,
  SocketId,
} from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

import { WS_EVENTS, FILE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT, WS_SUBTYPES } from "../app_constants";
import { isSyncableElement } from "../data";

import type {
  SocketUpdateData,
  SocketUpdateDataSource,
  SyncableExcalidrawElement,
} from "../data";
import type { TCollabClass } from "./Collab";
import type { Socket } from "socket.io-client";

class Portal {
  collab: TCollabClass;
  socket: Socket | null = null;
  socketInitialized: boolean = false; // we don't want the socket to emit any updates until it is fully initialized
  roomId: string | null = null;
  roomKey: string | null = null;
  broadcastedElementVersions: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  constructor(collab: TCollabClass) {
    this.collab = collab;
  }

  open(socket: Socket, id: string, key: string) {
    this.socket = socket;
    this.roomId = id;
    this.roomKey = key;

    // Initialize socket listeners
    this.socket.on("init-room", () => {
      if (this.socket) {
        this.socket.emit("join-room", this.roomId);
        trackEvent("share", "room joined");
      }
    });
    this.socket.on("new-user", async (_socketId: string) => {
      this.broadcastScene(
        WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
        this.collab.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        /* syncAll */ true,
      );
      // introduce ourselves so the newcomer knows our name/id right away
      // (otherwise it only learns them once we move the pointer)
      this.broadcastUserIdentity();
    });
    this.socket.on("room-user-change", (clients: SocketId[]) => {
      this.collab.setCollaborators(clients);
    });

    return socket;
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.socket) {
      return;
    }
    this.queueFileUpload.flush();
    this.socket.close();
    this.socket = null;
    this.roomId = null;
    this.roomKey = null;
    this.socketInitialized = false;
    this.broadcastedElementVersions = new Map();
  }

  isOpen() {
    return !!(
      this.socketInitialized &&
      this.socket &&
      this.roomId &&
      this.roomKey
    );
  }

  async _broadcastSocketData(
    data: SocketUpdateData,
    volatile: boolean = false,
    roomId?: string,
  ) {
    if (this.isOpen()) {
      const json = JSON.stringify(data);
      const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
      const { encryptedBuffer, iv } = await encryptData(this.roomKey!, encoded);

      this.socket?.emit(
        volatile ? WS_EVENTS.SERVER_VOLATILE : WS_EVENTS.SERVER,
        roomId ?? this.roomId,
        encryptedBuffer,
        iv,
      );
    }
  }

  queueFileUpload = throttle(async () => {
    try {
      await this.collab.fileManager.saveFiles({
        elements: this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        files: this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getFiles(),
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
        this.collab.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
          appState: {
            errorMessage: error.message,
          },
        });
      }
    }

    let isChanged = false;
    const newElements = this.collab.excalidrawAPI
      .getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()
      .map((element) => {
        if (this.collab.fileManager.shouldUpdateImageElementStatus(element)) {
          isChanged = true;
          // this will signal collaborators to pull image data from server
          // (using mutation instead of newElementWith otherwise it'd break
          // in-progress dragging)
          return newElementWith(element, { status: "saved" });
        }
        return element;
      });

    if (isChanged) {
      this.collab.excalidrawAPI.updateScene({
        elements: newElements,
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
      });
    }
  }, FILE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT);

  broadcastScene = async (
    updateType: WS_SUBTYPES.INIT | WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
    elements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[],
    syncAll: boolean,
  ) => {
    if (updateType === WS_SUBTYPES.INIT && !syncAll) {
      throw new Error("syncAll must be true when sending SCENE.INIT");
    }

    // sync out only the elements we think we need to to save bandwidth.
    // periodically we'll resync the whole thing to make sure no one diverges
    // due to a dropped message (server goes down etc).
    const syncableElements = elements.reduce((acc, element) => {
      if (
        (syncAll ||
          !this.broadcastedElementVersions.has(element.id) ||
          element.version > this.broadcastedElementVersions.get(element.id)!) &&
        isSyncableElement(element)
      ) {
        acc.push(element);
      }
      return acc;
    }, [] as SyncableExcalidrawElement[]);

    const data: SocketUpdateDataSource[typeof updateType] = {
      type: updateType,
      payload: {
        elements: syncableElements,
        ...(updateType === WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE ? { sentAt: Date.now() } : {}),
      },
    };

    for (const syncableElement of syncableElements) {
      this.broadcastedElementVersions.set(
        syncableElement.id,
        syncableElement.version,
      );
    }

    this.queueFileUpload();

    await this._broadcastSocketData(data as SocketUpdateData);
  };

  broadcastIdleChange = (userState: UserIdleState) => {
    if (this.socket?.id) {
      const data: SocketUpdateDataSource["IDLE_STATUS"] = {
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.IDLE_STATUS,
        payload: {
          socketId: this.socket.id as SocketId,
          userState,
          username: this.collab.state.username,
          clientId: this.collab.getClientId() ?? undefined,
        },
      };
      return this._broadcastSocketData(
        data as SocketUpdateData,
        true, // volatile
      );
    }
  };

  /**
   * Non-volatile, so it isn't dropped: collaborator visibility depends on
   * knowing every client's id.
   *
   * @param username pass when the name just changed (collab state may not
   * have updated yet)
   */
  broadcastUserIdentity = (username = this.collab.state.username) => {
    const clientId = this.collab.getClientId();
    if (this.socket?.id && this.socketInitialized && clientId) {
      const data: SocketUpdateDataSource["USER_IDENTITY"] = {
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
        payload: {
          socketId: this.socket.id as SocketId,
          clientId,
          username,
        },
      };
      return this._broadcastSocketData(data as SocketUpdateData);
    }
  };

  broadcastMouseLocation = (payload: {
    pointer: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"]["payload"]["pointer"];
    button: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"]["payload"]["button"];
  }) => {
    if (this.socket?.id) {
      const data: SocketUpdateDataSource["MOUSE_LOCATION"] = {
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION,
        payload: {
          socketId: this.socket.id as SocketId,
          pointer: payload.pointer,
          button: payload.button || "up",
          selectedElementIds:
            this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().selectedElementIds,
          username: this.collab.state.username,
          clientId: this.collab.getClientId() ?? undefined,
        },
      };

      return this._broadcastSocketData(
        data as SocketUpdateData,
        true, // volatile
      );
    }
  };

  broadcastVisibleSceneBounds = (
    payload: {
      sceneBounds: SocketUpdateDataSource["USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS"]["payload"]["sceneBounds"];
    },
    roomId: string,
  ) => {
    if (this.socket?.id) {
      const data: SocketUpdateDataSource["USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS"] = {
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS,
        payload: {
          socketId: this.socket.id as SocketId,
          username: this.collab.state.username,
          sceneBounds: payload.sceneBounds,
        },
      };

      return this._broadcastSocketData(
        data as SocketUpdateData,
        true, // volatile
        roomId,
      );
    }
  };

  broadcastUserFollowed = (payload: OnUserFollowedPayload) => {
    if (this.socket?.id) {
      this.socket.emit(WS_EVENTS.USER_FOLLOW_CHANGE, payload);
    }
  };
}

export default Portal;
// time constants (ms)
export const SAVE_TO_LOCAL_STORAGE_TIMEOUT = 300;
export const INITIAL_SCENE_UPDATE_TIMEOUT = 5000;
export const FILE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT = 300;

export const SYNC_FULL_SCENE_INTERVAL_MS = 20000;

export const CURSOR_SYNC_TIMEOUT = 33; // ~30fps
export const DELETED_ELEMENT_TIMEOUT = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 day

// should be aligned with MAX_ALLOWED_FILE_BYTES
export const FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024; // 4 MiB
// 1 year (https://stackoverflow.com/a/25201898/927631)
export const FILE_CACHE_MAX_AGE_SEC = 31536000;

export const WS_EVENTS = {

} as const;

export enum WS_SUBTYPES {

  INIT = "SCENE_INIT",
  UPDATE = "SCENE_UPDATE",
  MOUSE_LOCATION = "MOUSE_LOCATION",
  IDLE_STATUS = "IDLE_STATUS",

export const FIREBASE_STORAGE_PREFIXES = {

  LOCAL_STORAGE_ELEMENTS: "excalidraw",
  LOCAL_STORAGE_APP_STATE: "excalidraw-state",
  LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLAB: "excalidraw-collab",
  LOCAL_STORAGE_THEME: "excalidraw-theme",
  LOCAL_STORAGE_DEBUG: "excalidraw-debug",
  /** pool of this browser profile's collaborator client ids */
  LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS: "excalidraw-client-ids",
  /** the client id claimed by this tab (survives reloads) */
  SESSION_STORAGE_CLIENT_ID: "excalidraw-client-id",
  /** collaborators seen per room ("Previously seen"), keyed by room id */
  LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY: "excalidraw-collaborator-directory",
  /** the collaborator dropdown's saved settings (#83): global + per room */
  LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_SETTINGS: "excalidraw-collaborator-settings",

  IDB_LIBRARY: "excalidraw-library",
  IDB_TTD_CHATS: "excalidraw-ttd-chats",
  /** user-uploaded fonts (#140), kept across reloads for every drawing */

  // do not use apart from migrations

} as const;

export const COOKIES = {

export const isExcalidrawPlusSignedUser = document.cookie.includes(
  COOKIES.AUTH_STATE_COOKIE,

import { CREATOR_ID_KEY } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

/**
 * Elements this client introduced to the room that don't carry its creator
 * stamp yet: newly drawn, pasted or duplicated (new id, possibly with a
 * copied foreign stamp), or restored by undo/redo without the stamp.
 *
 * Elements first received from other clients are never (re)stamped, so edits
 * never transfer ownership.
 *
 * @param remoteElementIds ids of elements that first reached this client from
 * the room (other clients or the room's stored scene)
 */
export const getElementsToStamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  remoteElementIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
  clientId: string,
): T[] =>
  elements.filter(
    (element) =>
      !element.isDeleted &&
      !remoteElementIds.has(element.id) &&
      element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY] !== clientId,
  );

export const getStampedCustomData = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: clientId,
});

    `Error JSON parsing firebase config. Supplied value: ${
      import.meta.env.VITE_APP_FIREBASE_CONFIG
    }`,
  );
  FIREBASE_CONFIG = {};
}

let firebaseApp: ReturnType<typeof initializeApp> | null = null;
let firestore: ReturnType<typeof getFirestore> | null = null;
let firebaseStorage: ReturnType<typeof getStorage> | null = null;

const _initializeFirebase = () => {
  if (!firebaseApp) {
    firebaseApp = initializeApp(FIREBASE_CONFIG);
  }
  return firebaseApp;
};

const _getFirestore = () => {
  if (!firestore) {
    firestore = getFirestore(_initializeFirebase());
  }
  return firestore;
};

const _getStorage = () => {
  if (!firebaseStorage) {
    firebaseStorage = getStorage(_initializeFirebase());
  }
  return firebaseStorage;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const loadFirebaseStorage = async () => {
  return _getStorage();
};

type FirebaseStoredScene = {
  sceneVersion: number;
  iv: Bytes;
  ciphertext: Bytes;
};

const encryptElements = async (
  key: string,
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
): Promise<{ ciphertext: ArrayBuffer; iv: Uint8Array }> => {
  const json = JSON.stringify(elements);
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
  const { encryptedBuffer, iv } = await encryptData(key, encoded);

  return { ciphertext: encryptedBuffer, iv };
};

const decryptElements = async (
  data: FirebaseStoredScene,
  roomKey: string,
): Promise<readonly ExcalidrawElement[]> => {
  const ciphertext = data.ciphertext.toUint8Array() as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
  const iv = data.iv.toUint8Array() as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;

  const decrypted = await decryptData(iv, ciphertext, roomKey);
  const decodedData = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(
    new Uint8Array(decrypted),
  );
  return JSON.parse(decodedData);
};

class FirebaseSceneVersionCache {
  private static cache = new WeakMap<Socket, number>();
  static get = (socket: Socket) => {
    return FirebaseSceneVersionCache.cache.get(socket);
  };
  static set = (
    socket: Socket,
    elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  ) => {
    FirebaseSceneVersionCache.cache.set(socket, getSceneVersion(elements));
  };
}

export const isSavedToFirebase = (
  portal: Portal,
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
): boolean => {
  if (portal.socket && portal.roomId && portal.roomKey) {
    const sceneVersion = getSceneVersion(elements);

    return FirebaseSceneVersionCache.get(portal.socket) === sceneVersion;
  }
  // if no room exists, consider the room saved so that we don't unnecessarily
  // prevent unload (there's nothing we could do at that point anyway)
  return true;
};

export const saveFilesToFirebase = async ({
  prefix,
  files,
}: {
  prefix: string;
  files: { id: FileId; buffer: Uint8Array }[];
}) => {
  const storage = await loadFirebaseStorage();

  const erroredFiles: FileId[] = [];
  const savedFiles: FileId[] = [];

  await Promise.all(
    files.map(async ({ id, buffer }) => {
      try {
        const storageRef = ref(storage, `${prefix}/${id}`);
        await uploadBytes(storageRef, buffer, {
          cacheControl: `public, max-age=${FILE_CACHE_MAX_AGE_SEC}`,
        });
        savedFiles.push(id);
      } catch (error: any) {
        erroredFiles.push(id);
      }
    }),
  );

  return { savedFiles, erroredFiles };
};

const createFirebaseSceneDocument = async (
  elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  roomKey: string,
) => {
  const sceneVersion = getSceneVersion(elements);
  const { ciphertext, iv } = await encryptElements(roomKey, elements);
  return {
    sceneVersion,
    ciphertext: Bytes.fromUint8Array(new Uint8Array(ciphertext)),
    iv: Bytes.fromUint8Array(iv),
  } as FirebaseStoredScene;
};

/**
 * @param isKnownToRoom whether an element was ever in the room's scene as
 * far as this client knows. Local elements the stored scene no longer has
 * because their deletion expired aren't saved (see expiredDeletions.ts).
 */
export const saveToFirebase = async (
  portal: Portal,
  elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: AppState,
  isKnownToRoom?: (elementId: string) => boolean,
) => {
  const { roomId, roomKey, socket } = portal;
  if (
    // bail if no room exists as there's nothing we can do at this point
    !roomId ||
    !roomKey ||
    !socket ||
    isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements)
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const firestore = _getFirestore();
  const docRef = doc(firestore, "scenes", roomId);

  const storedScene = await runTransaction(firestore, async (transaction) => {
    const snapshot = await transaction.get(docRef);

    if (!snapshot.exists()) {
      const storedScene = await createFirebaseSceneDocument(elements, roomKey);

      transaction.set(docRef, storedScene);

      return storedScene;
    }

    const prevStoredScene = snapshot.data() as FirebaseStoredScene;
    const prevStoredElements = getSyncableElements(
      restoreElements(await decryptElements(prevStoredScene, roomKey), null),
    );
    // don't save our live copies of elements whose deletion expired
    const expiredIds = isKnownToRoom
      ? new Set(
          getLocalElementsWithExpiredDeletion(
            elements,
            new Set(prevStoredElements.map((el) => el.id)),
            isKnownToRoom,
          ).map((el) => el.id),
        )
      : new Set<string>();
    const reconciledElements = getSyncableElements(
      reconcileElements(
        elements.filter((el) => !expiredIds.has(el.id)),
        prevStoredElements as OrderedExcalidrawElement[] as RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
        appState,
      ),
    );

    const storedScene = await createFirebaseSceneDocument(
      reconciledElements,
      roomKey,
    );

    transaction.update(docRef, storedScene);

    // Return the stored elements as the in memory `reconciledElements` could have mutated in the meantime
    return storedScene;
  });

  const storedElements = getSyncableElements(
    restoreElements(await decryptElements(storedScene, roomKey), null),
  );

  FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, storedElements);

  return toBrandedType<RemoteExcalidrawElement[]>(storedElements);
};

export const loadFromFirebase = async (
  roomId: string,
  roomKey: string,
  socket: Socket | null,
): Promise<readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[] | null> => {
  const firestore = _getFirestore();
  const docRef = doc(firestore, "scenes", roomId);
  const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);
  if (!docSnap.exists()) {
    return null;
  }
  const storedScene = docSnap.data() as FirebaseStoredScene;
  const elements = getSyncableElements(
    restoreElements(await decryptElements(storedScene, roomKey), null, {
      deleteInvisibleElements: true,
    }),
  );

  if (socket) {
    FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, elements);
  }

  return elements;
};

export const loadFilesFromFirebase = async (
  prefix: string,
  decryptionKey: string,
  filesIds: readonly FileId[],
) => {
  const loadedFiles: BinaryFileData[] = [];
  const erroredFiles = new Map<FileId, true>();

  await Promise.all(
    [...new Set(filesIds)].map(async (id) => {
      try {
        const url = `https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/${
          FIREBASE_CONFIG.storageBucket
        }/o/${encodeURIComponent(prefix.replace(/^\//, ""))}%2F${id}`;
        const response = await fetch(`${url}?alt=media`);
        if (response.status < 400) {
          const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();

          const { data, metadata } = await decompressData<BinaryFileMetadata>(
            new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer),
            {
              decryptionKey,
            },
          );

          const dataURL = new TextDecoder().decode(data) as DataURL;

          loadedFiles.push({
            mimeType: metadata.mimeType || MIME_TYPES.binary,
            id,
            dataURL,
            created: metadata?.created || Date.now(),
            lastRetrieved: metadata?.created || Date.now(),
          });
        } else {
          erroredFiles.set(id, true);
        }
      } catch (error: any) {
        erroredFiles.set(id, true);
        console.error(error);
      }
    }),
  );

  return { loadedFiles, erroredFiles };
};

import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { isBoundToContainer } from "./typeChecks";

import type { ElementsMap, ExcalidrawElement } from "./types";

/** `customData` key holding the id of the client that created the element */
export const CREATOR_ID_KEY = "creatorId";

/**
 * `customData` key holding the ids of the clients that edited an element they
 * didn't create (co-owners). The element follows the least restrictive
 * visibility/lock setting among its creator and co-owners.
 */
export const EDITOR_IDS_KEY = "editorIds";

/**
 * `customData` key holding, per client that ever co-owned the element, a
 * counter bumped each time that client is added or removed. It turns the
 * co-owner list into a mergeable set: every client only ever changes its own
 * entry, so when copies disagree the higher counter is the newer state. Ids
 * listed here but not in `editorIds` were removed (kept so a stale copy can't
 * bring them back).
 */
export const EDITOR_SEQS_KEY = "editorSeqs";

/** bucket for elements without (valid) creator metadata, e.g. legacy rooms */
export const UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID = "__unknown__";

const getStampedCreatorId = (element: ExcalidrawElement): string | null => {
  const creatorId = element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY];
  return typeof creatorId === "string" && creatorId ? creatorId : null;
};

/** the element's current co-owners: valid, de-duplicated ids */
/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorVisibility = {
  /**
   * creator ids hidden on this client. `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` hides the
   * miscellaneous bucket.
   */
  hiddenCollaboratorIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /**
   * creators this client can name (seen at some point). Stamped creators
   * missing from it are treated as unknown (miscellaneous). `null`/omitted
   * (e.g. outside of a room) → every stamped creator is its own bucket.
   */
  collaboratorDirectory?: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> | null;
};

/** an owner's bucket: `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` if this client never saw them */
const toVisibilityBucket = (
  ownerId: string,
  collaboratorDirectory: CreatorVisibility["collaboratorDirectory"],
): string =>
  collaboratorDirectory &&
  ownerId !== UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID &&
  !collaboratorDirectory.has(ownerId)

 * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` for untagged elements and creators this client has

export const getElementVisibilityBucket = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  collaboratorDirectory: CreatorVisibility["collaboratorDirectory"],
): string =>
  toVisibilityBucket(
    getElementCreatorId(element, elementsMap),
    collaboratorDirectory,

/**
 * Every visibility bucket the element belongs to: its creator's and each
 * co-owner's (de-duplicated, so several unknown owners share one bucket).
 */
export const getElementVisibilityBuckets = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  collaboratorDirectory: CreatorVisibility["collaboratorDirectory"],

    getElementOwnerIds(element, elementsMap).map((ownerId) =>
      toVisibilityBucket(ownerId, collaboratorDirectory),

 * elements without depending on the editor package.

export const isElementByHiddenCreator = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, collaboratorDirectory }: CreatorVisibility,
): boolean => {
  if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) {
    return false;
  }
  return getElementVisibilityBuckets(
    element,
    elementsMap,
    collaboratorDirectory,
  ).every((bucketId) => hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(bucketId));
};

export type CreatorInteractivity = CreatorVisibility & {
  /**

   * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` locks the miscellaneous bucket.

};

/**

  bucketId: string,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, lockedCollaboratorIds }: CreatorInteractivity,
  selfId: string | null,

  if (hiddenCollaboratorIds?.has(bucketId)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (bucketId === selfId) {
    return true;
  }
  return !lockedCollaboratorIds?.has(bucketId);

export const getSelfCreatorId = ({
  collaborators,
}: CreatorSelf): string | null => {
  for (const collaborator of collaborators?.values() ?? []) {
    if (collaborator.isCurrentUser && collaborator.id) {
      return collaborator.id;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * Whether this client may interact with the element (select, move, resize,
 * rotate, delete, erase, text-edit): when ANY of its visibility buckets is
 * interactive per `isCollaboratorInteractive`, i.e. it follows its least

 *
 * @param selfId defaults to the current user's id from `state.collaborators`;
 * pass it when checking many elements.
 */
export const isElementInteractive = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  state: CreatorInteractivity & CreatorSelf,
  selfId: string | null = getSelfCreatorId(state),

    element,
    elementsMap,
    state.collaboratorDirectory,

/**
 * Filters out elements this client may not interact with (hidden or locked
 * collaborators'). Returns the input array as-is when nobody is hidden or

 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to a map
 * of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const excludeNonInteractiveElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  state: CreatorInteractivity & CreatorSelf,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,

    !state.hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size &&
    !state.lockedCollaboratorIds?.size

  const map = elementsMap ?? arrayToMap(elements);
  const selfId = getSelfCreatorId(state);

    isElementInteractive(element, map, state, selfId),

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorLayering = CreatorVisibility &
  CreatorSelf & {

import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";
import {
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  excludeElementsByHiddenCreators,
  getElementVisibilityBuckets,
  getElementsInGroup,
  getSelfCreatorId,
  isCollaboratorInteractive,
  isElementByHiddenCreator,
  isElementInteractive,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ElementsMap, ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { AppState } from "../types";

export type LocalVisibilityState = Pick<
  AppState,
  "hiddenCollaboratorIds" | "collaboratorDirectory"
>;

/**
 * Whether the element is hidden on this client by the collaborator
 * visibility controls. Purely a local view filter — scene data is untouched.
 *
 * Creators missing from `collaboratorDirectory` (never seen by this client)
 * share the miscellaneous bucket with untagged elements.
 */
export const isElementHiddenLocally = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  appState: LocalVisibilityState,
): boolean => isElementByHiddenCreator(element, elementsMap, appState);

export type LocalInteractivityState = LocalVisibilityState &
  Partial<Pick<AppState, "lockedCollaboratorIds" | "collaborators">>;

/**
 * Whether this client may interact with the element (#81): not hidden and
 * not locked by the collaborator controls. See `isCollaboratorInteractive`.
 */
export const isElementInteractiveLocally = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  appState: LocalInteractivityState,
): boolean => isElementInteractive(element, elementsMap, appState);

/**
 * Returns only the elements visible on this client (e.g. for export).
 * Returns the input array as-is when nothing is hidden.
 *
 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to
 * a map of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const getLocallyVisibleElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  appState: LocalVisibilityState,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,
): readonly T[] =>
  excludeElementsByHiddenCreators(elements, appState, elementsMap);

/**
 * Selection safety net: hidden or locked (non-interactive) elements must
 * never stay selected, otherwise actions (delete, ungroup, move…) would
 * modify them for every collaborator.
 *
 * Returns the selection-related appState to apply, or `null` if the
 * selection contains no non-interactive elements.
 */
export const getSelectionWithoutHiddenElements = (
  appState: LocalInteractivityState &
    Pick<
      AppState,
      "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
    >,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
): Pick<
  AppState,
  "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
> | null => {
  if (
    !appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size &&
    !appState.lockedCollaboratorIds?.size
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const selfId = getSelfCreatorId(appState);
  // (named `isHidden` since #116; covers locked elements too since #81)
  const isHidden = (id: string) => {
    const element = elementsMap.get(id);
    return (
      !!element && !isElementInteractive(element, elementsMap, appState, selfId)
    );
  };

  const hiddenSelectedIds = Object.keys(appState.selectedElementIds).filter(
    isHidden,
  );
  // a group containing hidden members can't stay selected as a group, or
  // group actions (ungroup, group bbox…) would reach the hidden members
  const groupIdsWithHiddenMembers = Object.keys(
    appState.selectedGroupIds,
  ).filter((groupId) =>
    getElementsInGroup(elementsMap, groupId).some((el) => isHidden(el.id)),
  );
  const isLinearElementHidden =
    !!appState.selectedLinearElement &&
    isHidden(appState.selectedLinearElement.elementId);

  if (
    !hiddenSelectedIds.length &&
    !groupIdsWithHiddenMembers.length &&
    !isLinearElementHidden
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const selectedElementIds = { ...appState.selectedElementIds };
  for (const id of hiddenSelectedIds) {
    delete selectedElementIds[id];
  }

  const selectedGroupIds = { ...appState.selectedGroupIds };
  for (const groupId of groupIdsWithHiddenMembers) {
    delete selectedGroupIds[groupId];
  }

  return {
    selectedElementIds,
    selectedGroupIds,
    selectedLinearElement: isLinearElementHidden
      ? null
      : appState.selectedLinearElement,
  };
};

/** this client's creator id (set by the host app on the current user's entry) */
export const getSelfCollaboratorId = (
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators">,
): string | null => getSelfCreatorId(appState);

/**
 * Whether the user hid their own drawings. Anything they'd draw would be
 * hidden immediately, so the editor is locked to view mode meanwhile.
 */
export const isOwnDrawingsHidden = (
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds">,
): boolean => {
  const selfId = getSelfCollaboratorId(appState);
  return !!selfId && appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(selfId);
};

/**
 * Every visibility bucket currently known on this client: live
 * collaborators, previously seen ones, creators of the scene's elements and
 * the miscellaneous bucket. "Hide all" hides all of these.
 */
export const getVisibilityBuckets = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory">,
): Set<string> => {
  const buckets = new Set<string>([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);

  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    if (collaborator.id) {
      buckets.add(collaborator.id);
    }
  }
  for (const clientId of appState.collaboratorDirectory?.keys() ?? []) {
    buckets.add(clientId);
  }

  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (!element.isDeleted) {
      // co-owners too, or "Hide all" would leave co-owned elements visible
      for (const bucket of getElementVisibilityBuckets(
        element,
        elementsMap,
        appState.collaboratorDirectory,
      )) {
        buckets.add(bucket);
      }
    }
  }

  return buckets;
};

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRow = {
  /** visibility bucket id (client id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
  id: string;
  username: string | null;
  isCurrentUser: boolean;
  isHidden: boolean;
  /** shown as locked: non-interactive (always true while hidden) */
  isLocked: boolean;
  /** the lock can't be changed: hidden, or your own row */
  isLockDisabled: boolean;
  /**
   * non-deleted elements in this bucket (bound text counts with its shape;
   * a co-owned element counts for each of its owners)
   */
  drawingsCount: number;
  avatarUrl?: string;
};

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRows = {
  inRoom: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  previouslySeen: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  miscellaneous: CollaboratorVisibilityRow;
};

/** a row while layering is on, labelled with its #116 section */
export type CollaboratorLayerRow = CollaboratorVisibilityRow & {
  section: keyof CollaboratorVisibilityRows;
};

/**
 * The rows while layering is on (#82): a single list in layer order (top
 * row = drawn on top), each row keeping its #116 section as a label.
 *
 * @param order the layer order, see `getCollaboratorLayerOrder`
 */
export const getCollaboratorLayerRows = (
  { inRoom, previouslySeen, miscellaneous }: CollaboratorVisibilityRows,
  order: readonly string[],
): CollaboratorLayerRow[] => {
  const rowsById = new Map<string, CollaboratorLayerRow>();
  for (const row of inRoom) {
    rowsById.set(row.id, { ...row, section: "inRoom" });
  }
  for (const row of previouslySeen) {
    rowsById.set(row.id, { ...row, section: "previouslySeen" });
  }
  rowsById.set(miscellaneous.id, {
    ...miscellaneous,
    section: "miscellaneous",
  });
  return order.flatMap((id) => rowsById.get(id) ?? []);
};

/**
 * Whether "Lock all" / "Unlock all" would change anything (#81). Only rows
 * whose lock can change count: hidden collaborators (always locked) and
 * your own row (never locked) are skipped, so after "Hide all" neither
 * button applies.
 */
export const getBulkLockAvailability = ({
  inRoom,
  previouslySeen,
  miscellaneous,
}: CollaboratorVisibilityRows): {
  canLockAll: boolean;
  canUnlockAll: boolean;
} => {
  const changeable = [...inRoom, ...previouslySeen, miscellaneous].filter(
    (row) => !row.isLockDisabled,
  );
  return {
    canLockAll: changeable.some((row) => !row.isLocked),
    canUnlockAll: changeable.some((row) => row.isLocked),
  };
};

/**
 * Rows for the collaborator visibility menu:
 * - in the room: live collaborators (you first)
 * - previously seen: directory entries no longer live (most recent first)
 * - miscellaneous: untagged elements + creators this client never saw
 */
export const getCollaboratorVisibilityRows = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<
    AppState,
    "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds"
  > &
    Partial<Pick<AppState, "lockedCollaboratorIds">>,
): CollaboratorVisibilityRows => {
  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  const selfId = getSelfCollaboratorId(appState);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (
      element.isDeleted ||
      // labels count as part of their shape
      (element.type === "text" && element.containerId)
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    // a co-owned element counts for each of its owners
    for (const bucket of getElementVisibilityBuckets(
      element,
      elementsMap,
      appState.collaboratorDirectory,
    )) {
      counts.set(bucket, (counts.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }

  const toRow = (
    id: string,
    username: string | null,
    extra?: Partial<CollaboratorVisibilityRow>,
  ): CollaboratorVisibilityRow => ({
    id,
    username,
    isCurrentUser: false,
    isHidden: appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
    isLocked: !isCollaboratorInteractive(id, appState, selfId),
    isLockDisabled: id === selfId || appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
    drawingsCount: counts.get(id) ?? 0,
    ...extra,
  });

  const inRoom = new Map<string, CollaboratorVisibilityRow>();
  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    // several tabs can't share an id, but guard against duplicates anyway
    if (collaborator.id && !inRoom.has(collaborator.id)) {
      inRoom.set(
        collaborator.id,
        toRow(
          collaborator.id,
          collaborator.username ??
            appState.collaboratorDirectory?.get(collaborator.id)?.username ??
            null,
          {
            isCurrentUser: !!collaborator.isCurrentUser,
            avatarUrl: collaborator.avatarUrl,
          },
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  const previouslySeen = [...(appState.collaboratorDirectory ?? [])]
    .filter(([id]) => !inRoom.has(id))
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
    .map(([id, entry]) => toRow(id, entry.username));

  return {
    inRoom: [...inRoom.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(b.isCurrentUser) - Number(a.isCurrentUser) ||
        (a.username ?? "").localeCompare(b.username ?? ""),
    ),
    previouslySeen,
    miscellaneous: toRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, null),
  };
};

A new `excalidraw-app/collab/pageStamp.ts` mirrors [creatorStamp.ts](excalidraw-app/collab/creatorStamp.ts) and stamps elements only when they have no tag yet. `syncElements` stamps the scene in place with `activePageId`. `startCollaboration` stamps every page.
- **New editor API on `excalidrawAPI`:**
  - `getPages()`
  - `getAllPageElementsIncludingDeleted()`
  - `applyRemotePageElements(elements)`, which splits by tag: the open page goes through `updateScene`, other pages get their stored elements updated and their preview re-rendered.
  - `applySharedPages(pages)`, which creates, removes, renames, reorders and sets backgrounds. If the open page is removed it uses the `deletePages` rule, shows a toast and discards the element being drawn.
  - a public `selectPage`, for follow mode.
- **Element stream.** `broadcastElements`, the full resync, INIT on `new-user`, `_reconcileElements` and `saveCollabRoomToFirebase` all switch from the scene to every page's elements. Reconcile runs against all pages' elements, and the result goes to `applyRemotePageElements`.
- **Page data.** There's one new `WS_SUBTYPES.PAGE_DATA` message and the same data in the Firebase room document. It's a full snapshot: per page `{id, name, description, viewBackgroundColor, position}`, plus `deletedPageIds: {id: deletedAt}`. Each field has its own change time, and later wins with ties broken by page id. A reorder doesn't renumber every page; the moved page gets a new position key between its neighbours, the same way elements are ordered. Collab spots local changes by comparing the shared fields from `onChange` against what it last sent. That means App's page methods mostly stay as they are, and background changes are picked up without extra code.
- **Pure logic** in `excalidraw-app/collab/pageSync.ts`: merge, tombstones, name-collision renaming, message validation and splitting elements by page.
- **Open page in AppState.** A new local-only field `openPageId`, never saved or sent, used by:
  - the **safety net**: `isElementByHiddenCreator` also returns true for elements tagged with another page, so render, hit-testing, selection, binding, the eraser and export all apply it automatically;
  - **cursor filtering**: `InteractiveCanvas` and `laserTrails` skip collaborators whose `pageId` is a different page.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-25 19:49:45Z)**_

Here's what I'm asking.

**Background.** Peers have to tell each other about page changes (rename, reorder, create, delete). There are two ways to build that message, and AC 5.1 ("a page message with an unknown page id … is ignored") means something different in each.

**Option A: full list (my plan).** Each message carries the sender's whole page list, for example:

```
pages: [ {id: "p1", name: "Architecture", …}, {id: "p2", name: "Schema", …} ]
deleted: { "p3": <time> }
```

- The receiver merges this into its own list.
- If the list contains a page id the receiver has never seen, that's simply a page the sender created, so it gets added. In this design there's no "unknown page id" to reject.
- I'd still ignore the whole message if it's broken: two pages share an id, a page is missing its name, a field has the wrong type, and so on.
- "Unknown page id" would then cover presence: if a peer says "I'm on page p9" and you have no p9, no tab shows their avatar and follow mode doesn't jump there.

**Option B: one change per message.** Each message is a single action, for example `{type: "rename", pageId: "p2", name: "Schema", time: …}`.

- Here "unknown page id" means exactly what the spec says: a rename for a page you don't have is ignored.
- The downside is that a lost or out-of-order message leaves pages out of sync until something resends everything. So B ends up needing A's full list anyway for the periodic resync and for joining.

**My recommendation is A:** one message format that also works for join, resync and room storage. AC 5.1 is still covered: broken messages are ignored with the pages left unchanged, and an unknown page id in presence is ignored.

Can I go with A and that reading of "unknown page id"?

```typescript
import { PAGE_ID_KEY, getElementPageId } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

/**
 * Page tags (#167), like the creator stamp (see creatorStamp.ts): every
 * element in a room carries the id of the page it was created on. The tag is
 * set once and never changed, so editing or moving the element, or
 * reordering or deleting other pages, never moves it to another page.
 */

/** elements without a page tag yet (new, or from before the tag existed) */
export const getElementsToPageStamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
): T[] => elements.filter((element) => getElementPageId(element) === null);

export const getPageStampedCustomData = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  pageId: string,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [PAGE_ID_KEY]: pageId,
});
```

const createRect = (id: string, x: number) =>
  API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id, x, y: 0, width: 10 });

describe("collaborator visibility (rendering)", () => {
  const aliceRect = stamp(createRect("alice-rect", 0), "alice");
  const bobRect = stamp(createRect("bob-rect", 20), "bob");
  const legacyRect = createRect("legacy-rect", 40);

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw />);
    API.setElements([aliceRect, bobRect, legacyRect]);
  });

  it("renders everything by default", () => {
    expect(h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size).toBe(0);
    expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "bob-rect", "legacy-rect"]);
  });

  it("hides only the hidden collaborator's elements", () => {
    setHidden(["bob"]);
    expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "legacy-rect"]);
  });

  it("re-renders hidden elements when shown again", () => {
    setHidden(["bob"]);
    setHidden([]);
    expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "bob-rect", "legacy-rect"]);
  });

  it("hides untagged elements via the unknown bucket", () => {
    setHidden([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
    expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "bob-rect"]);
  });

describe("collaborator visibility (interaction safety)", () => {
  // solid fill so clicking the interior counts as a hit
  const createSolidRect = (id: string, x: number, groupIds: string[] = []) =>
    API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      id,
      x,
      y: 0,
      width: 100,
      height: 100,
      backgroundColor: "red",
      fillStyle: "solid",
      groupIds,
    });

  const isDeleted = (id: string) =>
    h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)!.isDeleted;

  const getSelectedIds = () =>
    API.getSelectedElements()
      .map((el) => el.id)
      .sort();

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createSolidRect("alice-rect", 0), "alice"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("bob-rect", 200), "bob"),
    ]);
  });

  it("clicking a hidden element doesn't select it", () => {
    setHidden(["bob"]);

    mouse.clickAt(250, 50);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual([]);

    mouse.clickAt(50, 50);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
  });

  // same gesture as selection.test.tsx (intermediate move past the drag threshold)
  const boxSelectBoth = () => {
    mouse.downAt(-50, -50);
    mouse.move(-1000, -1000);
    mouse.moveTo(350, 150);
    mouse.up();
  };

  it("(control) box-selecting selects all covered elements", () => {
    boxSelectBoth();
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "bob-rect"]);
  });

  it("box-selecting skips hidden elements", () => {
    setHidden(["bob"]);

    boxSelectBoth();
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("select all + delete never deletes hidden elements", () => {
    setHidden(["bob"]);

    Keyboard.withModifierKeys({ ctrl: true }, () => {
      Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.A);
    });
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);

    Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.DELETE);
    expect(isDeleted("alice-rect")).toBe(true);
    expect(isDeleted("bob-rect")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("hiding a selected element deselects it", () => {
    API.setSelectedElements([...h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements()]);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect", "bob-rect"]);

    setHidden(["bob"]);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
  });

  describe("mixed-collaborator groups", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      API.setElements([
        stamp(createSolidRect("alice-rect", 0, ["group"]), "alice"),
        stamp(createSolidRect("bob-rect", 200, ["group"]), "bob"),
      ]);
    });

    it("selecting a visible member never selects hidden members", () => {
      setHidden(["bob"]);

      mouse.clickAt(50, 50);
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
      expect(h.state.selectedGroupIds).not.toHaveProperty("group");

      Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.DELETE);
      expect(isDeleted("alice-rect")).toBe(true);
      expect(isDeleted("bob-rect")).toBe(false);
    });

    const eraseThroughAliceRect = () => {
      UI.clickTool("eraser");
      mouse.downAt(-20, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(20, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(60, 50);
      mouse.upAt(60, 50);
    };

    it("(control) erasing a member erases the whole group", () => {
      eraseThroughAliceRect();
      expect(isDeleted("alice-rect")).toBe(true);
      expect(isDeleted("bob-rect")).toBe(true);
    });

    it("erasing a visible member never erases hidden members", () => {
      setHidden(["bob"]);

      eraseThroughAliceRect();
      expect(isDeleted("alice-rect")).toBe(true);
      expect(isDeleted("bob-rect")).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});

describe("collaborator visibility (chokepoints)", () => {
  // solid fill so pointer hits/bindings work on the interior
  const createSolidRect = (id: string, x: number, groupIds: string[] = []) =>
    API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      id,
      x,
      y: 0,
      width: 100,
      height: 100,
      backgroundColor: "red",
      fillStyle: "solid",
      groupIds,
    });

  const getArrow = () =>
    h.elements.find(
      (el): el is ExcalidrawArrowElement =>
        el.type === "arrow" && !el.isDeleted,
    )!;

  const drawArrowFromAliceToBob = () => {
    UI.clickTool("arrow");
    mouse.downAt(50, 50);
    mouse.moveTo(200, 50);
    mouse.moveTo(350, 50);
    mouse.upAt(350, 50);
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createSolidRect("alice-rect", 0), "alice"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("bob-rect", 300), "bob"),
    ]);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    mouse.reset();
  });

  describe("selection (selectGroupsForSelectedElements)", () => {
    it("never returns hidden elements, even without the App safety net", () => {
      API.setElements([
        stamp(createSolidRect("alice-rect", 0, ["group"]), "alice"),
        stamp(createSolidRect("bob-rect", 300, ["group"]), "bob"),
      ]);
      setHidden(["bob"]);

      const result = selectGroupsForSelectedElements(
        {
          selectedElementIds: { "alice-rect": true, "bob-rect": true },
          editingGroupId: null,
        },
        h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),
        h.state,
        null,
      );

      expect(Object.keys(result.selectedElementIds)).toEqual(["alice-rect"]);
      // with its hidden member excluded the group has a single member, so it
      // isn't selected as a group
      expect(result.selectedGroupIds.group).toBeFalsy();
    });

    it("(control) selects the whole group when nothing is hidden", () => {
      API.setElements([
        stamp(createSolidRect("alice-rect", 0, ["group"]), "alice"),
        stamp(createSolidRect("bob-rect", 300, ["group"]), "bob"),
      ]);

      const result = selectGroupsForSelectedElements(
        { selectedElementIds: { "alice-rect": true }, editingGroupId: null },
        h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements(),
        h.state,
        null,
      );

      expect(Object.keys(result.selectedElementIds).sort()).toEqual([
        "alice-rect",
        "bob-rect",
      ]);
      expect(result.selectedGroupIds.group).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe("arrow binding", () => {
    it("(control) a new arrow binds to both shapes", () => {
      drawArrowFromAliceToBob();

      expect(getArrow().startBinding?.elementId).toBe("alice-rect");
      expect(getArrow().endBinding?.elementId).toBe("bob-rect");
    });

    it("a new arrow can't bind to a hidden shape", () => {
      setHidden(["bob"]);
      drawArrowFromAliceToBob();

      expect(getArrow().startBinding?.elementId).toBe("alice-rect");
      expect(getArrow().endBinding).toBeNull();
      // and the hidden shape's data is untouched
      expect(
        h.elements.find((el) => el.id === "bob-rect")!.boundElements ?? [],
      ).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("existing bindings to a hidden shape are kept", () => {
      drawArrowFromAliceToBob();
      expect(getArrow().endBinding?.elementId).toBe("bob-rect");

      setHidden(["bob"]);

      // move the visible, bound shape

      mouse.moveTo(50, 130);
      mouse.moveTo(50, 180);
      mouse.upAt(50, 180);

      expect(getArrow().startBinding?.elementId).toBe("alice-rect");
      expect(getArrow().endBinding?.elementId).toBe("bob-rect");
    });
  });
});

) => {
  fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Pages" }));

    const { getByRole } = await render(

/**
 * Editor side of multi-page live collaboration (#167). The room side (what's
 * sent and received) is tested in excalidraw-app/tests/collabPages.test.tsx.
 */
import React from "react";
import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";
import { PAGE_ID_KEY, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { vi } from "vitest";

import type {
  ExcalidrawArrowElement,
  ExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { actionSaveFileToDisk } from "../actions/actionExport";
import { saveAsJSON } from "../data";
import { serializeAsJSON } from "../data/json";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Keyboard, Pointer, UI } from "./helpers/ui";
import { act, render, unmountComponent, waitFor } from "./test-utils";

import type { JSONExportData } from "../data/json";
import type { DrawingPage } from "../pages";

vi.mock("../data", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("../data")>()),
  saveAsJSON: vi.fn(async ({ data }) => ({
    fileHandle: null,
    data: await data,
  })),
}));

unmountComponent();

const { h } = window;
const mouse = new Pointer("mouse");

/** App's private page methods (#157, #160) */
type PageInternals = {
  createPage: () => void;
  selectPage: (pageId: string) => void;
};
const pageInternals = () => h.app as unknown as PageInternals;

const tag = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, pageId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: pageId },
  }) as T;

// solid fill so pointer hits and bindings work on the interior
const createSolidRect = (id: string, x: number) =>
  API.createElement({
    type: "rectangle",
    id,
    x,
    y: 0,
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    backgroundColor: "red",
    fillStyle: "solid",
  });

// the jsdom viewport is 0x0, so query the renderer with an explicit viewport
// (same approach as collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx)
const getVisibleIds = () =>
  h.app.renderer
    .getRenderableElements({
      zoom: h.state.zoom,
      offsetLeft: 0,
      offsetTop: 0,
      scrollX: 0,
      scrollY: 0,
      height: 1000,
      width: 1000,
      editingTextElement: h.state.editingTextElement,
      newElement: h.state.newElement,
      selectedElements: [],
      selectedElementsAreBeingDragged: false,
      frameToHighlight: null,
      hiddenCollaboratorIds: h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds,
      collaboratorDirectory: h.state.collaboratorDirectory,
      openPageId: h.state.openPageId,
    })
    .visibleElements.map((el) => el.id)
    .sort();

const getSelectedIds = () =>
  API.getSelectedElements()
    .map((el) => el.id)
    .sort();

const isDeleted = (id: string) =>
  h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)!.isDeleted;

describe("multi-page collaboration (editor)", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    mouse.reset();
  });

  // AC 2.4: an element tagged for another page that reaches the open page
  // is treated like a hidden collaborator's element (#80)
  describe("safety net: elements tagged for another page", () => {
    const setUp = async ({ isCollaborating = true } = {}) => {
      await render(
        <Excalidraw
          isCollaborating={isCollaborating}
          handleKeyboardGlobally={true}
        />,
      );
      const openPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      API.setElements([
        tag(createSolidRect("here", 0), openPageId),
        tag(createSolidRect("elsewhere", 300), "another-page"),
      ]);
      return { openPageId };
    };

    it("knows the open page only while collaborating", async () => {
      const { openPageId } = await setUp();
      expect(h.state.openPageId).toBe(openPageId);

      unmountComponent();
      await setUp({ isCollaborating: false });
      expect(h.state.openPageId).toBeNull();
    });

    it("follows page switches", async () => {
      await setUp();
      act(() => pageInternals().createPage());
      expect(h.state.openPageId).toBe(h.app.getActivePageId());
    });

    it("is not drawn", async () => {
      await setUp();
      expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["here"]);
    });

    it("(control) outside a room nothing is hidden", async () => {
      await setUp({ isCollaborating: false });
      expect(getVisibleIds()).toEqual(["elsewhere", "here"]);
    });

    it("can't be selected by clicking, box-selecting or select all", async () => {
      await setUp();

      mouse.clickAt(350, 50);
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual([]);

      mouse.downAt(-50, -50);
      mouse.move(-1000, -1000);
      mouse.moveTo(450, 150);
      mouse.up();
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["here"]);

      Keyboard.withModifierKeys({ ctrl: true }, () => {
        Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.A);
      });
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["here"]);

      // and so delete never reaches it
      Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.DELETE);
      expect(isDeleted("here")).toBe(true);
      expect(isDeleted("elsewhere")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("can't be erased", async () => {
      await setUp();

      UI.clickTool("eraser");
      mouse.downAt(-20, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(200, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(450, 50);
      mouse.upAt(450, 50);

      expect(isDeleted("here")).toBe(true);
      expect(isDeleted("elsewhere")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("can't be bound to", async () => {
      await setUp();

      UI.clickTool("arrow");
      mouse.downAt(50, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(200, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(350, 50);
      mouse.upAt(350, 50);

      const arrow = h.elements.find(
        (el): el is ExcalidrawArrowElement => el.type === "arrow",
      )!;
      expect(arrow.startBinding?.elementId).toBe("here");
      expect(arrow.endBinding).toBeNull();
      expect(
        h.elements.find((el) => el.id === "elsewhere")!.boundElements ?? [],
      ).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("saving a file while collaborating keeps every page's elements", async () => {
      let exportData: JSONExportData | undefined;
      await render(
        <Excalidraw
          isCollaborating={true}
          onExport={(_type, data) => {
            exportData = data;
          }}
        />,
      );
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      API.setElements([tag(createSolidRect("first", 0), firstPageId)]);
      act(() => pageInternals().createPage());
      const secondPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      API.setElements([tag(createSolidRect("second", 0), secondPageId)]);

      act(() => h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionSaveFileToDisk));
      await waitFor(() => expect(exportData).toBeDefined());

      const saved = JSON.parse(
        serializeAsJSON(
          exportData!.elements,
          exportData!.appState,
          exportData!.files,
          "local",
        ),
      );
      expect(
        saved.appState.pages.map((page: DrawingPage) =>
          page.elements.map(({ id }) => id),
        ),
      ).toEqual([["first"], ["second"]]);
      expect(vi.mocked(saveAsJSON)).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  // AC 2.2: elements reconciled from the room go to their own page
  describe("setPageElements", () => {
    it("updates the open page through the scene and other pages in place", async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      act(() => pageInternals().createPage());
      const secondPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();

      act(() => {
        h.app.setPageElements(
          new Map([
            [firstPageId, [tag(createSolidRect("on-first", 0), firstPageId)]],
            [
              secondPageId,
              [tag(createSolidRect("on-second", 0), secondPageId)],
            ],
          ]),
        );
      });

      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["on-second"]);
      const pages = h.app.getPages();
      expect(pages.map((page) => page.elements.map((el) => el.id))).toEqual([
        ["on-first"],
        ["on-second"],
      ]);
    });

    it("doesn't add history entries", async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      const pageId = h.app.getActivePageId();

      act(() => {
        h.app.setPageElements(
          new Map([[pageId, [tag(createSolidRect("remote", 0), pageId)]]]),
        );
      });

      expect(API.getUndoStack().length).toBe(0);
    });

    it("ignores unknown pages", async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      const pagesBefore = h.app.getPages();

      act(() => {
        h.app.setPageElements(
          new Map([["unknown-page", [createSolidRect("lost", 0)]]]),
        );
      });

      expect(h.app.getPages()).toEqual(pagesBefore);
    });
  });
});

import { CREATOR_ID_KEY, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  getElementsToStamp,
  getStampedCustomData,
} from "../collab/creatorStamp";

const ME = "me";

const createRect = (id: string, creatorId?: string) =>
  newElementWith(API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id }), {
    customData: creatorId ? { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId } : undefined,
  }) as ExcalidrawElement;

const getIdsToStamp = (
  elements: ExcalidrawElement[],
  remoteIds: string[] = [],
) => getElementsToStamp(elements, new Set(remoteIds), ME).map((el) => el.id);

describe("getElementsToStamp", () => {
  it("stamps elements this client introduced", () => {
    expect(getIdsToStamp([createRect("new")])).toEqual(["new"]);
  });

  it("never stamps elements received from the room (edits don't transfer ownership)", () => {
    expect(getIdsToStamp([createRect("theirs", "alice")], ["theirs"])).toEqual(
      [],
    );
    // untagged legacy elements stay untagged (→ Miscellaneous)

import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  PAGE_ID_KEY,
  getElementPageId,
  isElementOnOtherPage,
  newElementWith,
} from "@excalidraw/element";
import { groupElementsByPageTag } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/pages";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  getElementsToPageStamp,
  getPageStampedCustomData,
} from "../collab/pageStamp";

const createRect = (id: string, customData?: ExcalidrawElement["customData"]) =>
  newElementWith(API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id }), {
    customData,
  }) as ExcalidrawElement;

const onPage = (id: string, pageId: string) =>
  createRect(id, { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: pageId });

// AC 2.1 (page tag) and 2.3 (untagged elements)
describe("page tag (#167)", () => {
  describe("getElementsToPageStamp", () => {
    it("stamps only elements without a page tag", () => {
      expect(
        getElementsToPageStamp([
          createRect("new"),
          onPage("tagged", "page-1"),
        ]).map((el) => el.id),
      ).toEqual(["new"]);
    });

    it("never restamps a tagged element, whatever page is open", () => {
      // e.g. an element that was edited or moved: its tag stays
      expect(getElementsToPageStamp([onPage("moved", "page-2")])).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("treats an invalid tag as no tag", () => {
      expect(
        getElementsToPageStamp([
          createRect("empty", { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: "" }),
          createRect("number", { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: 7 }),
        ]).map((el) => el.id),
      ).toEqual(["empty", "number"]);
    });
  });

  describe("getPageStampedCustomData", () => {
    it("adds the page id and keeps the rest of customData", () => {
      expect(
        getPageStampedCustomData(
          createRect("a", { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: "alice", keep: true }),
          "page-1",
        ),
      ).toEqual({
        [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: "alice",
        keep: true,
        [PAGE_ID_KEY]: "page-1",
      });
    });

    it("works without customData", () => {
      expect(getPageStampedCustomData(createRect("a"), "page-1")).toEqual({
        [PAGE_ID_KEY]: "page-1",
      });
    });
  });

  describe("getElementPageId", () => {
    it("reads a valid tag, null otherwise", () => {
      expect(getElementPageId(onPage("a", "page-1"))).toBe("page-1");
      expect(getElementPageId(createRect("b"))).toBeNull();
      expect(getElementPageId(createRect("c", { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: "" }))).toBe(
        null,
      );
    });
  });

  // AC 2.4 (safety net)
  describe("isElementOnOtherPage", () => {
    it("is true only for elements tagged for another page than the open one", () => {
      expect(isElementOnOtherPage(onPage("a", "page-2"), "page-1")).toBe(true);
      expect(isElementOnOtherPage(onPage("a", "page-1"), "page-1")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("never hides untagged elements (they're stamped before routing)", () => {
      expect(isElementOnOtherPage(createRect("a"), "page-1")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("is off when no page is open (outside a room)", () => {
      expect(isElementOnOtherPage(onPage("a", "page-2"), null)).toBe(false);
      expect(isElementOnOtherPage(onPage("a", "page-2"), undefined)).toBe(
        false,
      );
    });
  });

  // AC 2.2 (routing)
  describe("groupElementsByPageTag", () => {
    it("groups by tag, keeping order, untagged under null", () => {
      const groups = groupElementsByPageTag([
        onPage("a1", "page-a"),
        onPage("b1", "page-b"),
        createRect("untagged"),
        onPage("a2", "page-a"),
      ]);
      expect(
        [...groups].map(([pageId, elements]) => [
          pageId,
          elements.map((el) => el.id),
        ]),
      ).toEqual([
        ["page-a", ["a1", "a2"]],
        ["page-b", ["b1"]],
        [null, ["untagged"]],
      ]);
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Multi-page live collaboration (#167), driven through the real Collab/Portal
 * classes with a socket that records what's sent and lets tests deliver
 * peers' messages (encryption is a passthrough). Same harness as
 * collabVisibility.test.tsx.
 *
 * Editor-only behaviour (safety net, toasts, view mode…) is tested in
 * packages/excalidraw/tests/pagesCollab.test.tsx.
 */
import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";
import { act, render, waitFor } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils";
import {
  PAGE_ID_KEY,
  getElementPageId,
  newElementWith,
} from "@excalidraw/element";
import { vi } from "vitest";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { WS_EVENTS, WS_SUBTYPES } from "../app_constants";
import ExcalidrawApp from "../App";

import type { SocketUpdateDataSource } from "../data";

const { h } = window;

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  handlers: new Map<string, (...args: any[]) => any>(),
  emitted: [] as any[][],
  storedRoomElements: null as readonly any[] | null,
}));

vi.mock("socket.io-client", () => ({
  default: () => ({
    id: "my-socket",
    on: (event: string, handler: (...args: any[]) => any) => {
      mocks.handlers.set(event, handler);
    },
    once: () => {},
    off: () => {},
    emit: (...args: any[]) => {
      mocks.emitted.push(args);
    },
    close: () => {},
  }),
}));

// all exports mocked explicitly: spreading `importOriginal()` here deadlocks
// the app's module initialization
vi.mock("@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption", () => ({
  IV_LENGTH_BYTES: 12,
  createIV: () => new Uint8Array(12),
  getCryptoKey: async () => ({}),
  generateEncryptionKey: async () => "test-room-key",
  encryptData: async (_key: string, data: Uint8Array) => ({
    encryptedBuffer: data,
    iv: new Uint8Array(12),
  }),
  decryptData: async (_iv: Uint8Array, data: ArrayBuffer) => data,
}));

vi.mock("../data/firebase", () => ({
  loadFromFirebase: async () => mocks.storedRoomElements,
  saveToFirebase: async () => null,
  isSavedToFirebase: () => true,
  loadFilesFromFirebase: async () => ({ loadedFiles: [], erroredFiles: [] }),
  saveFilesToFirebase: async () => ({
    savedFiles: new Map(),
    erroredFiles: new Map(),
  }),
}));

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** App's private page methods (#157, #158) */
type PageInternals = {
  createPage: () => void;
  selectPage: (pageId: string) => void;
  deletePages: (pageIds: readonly string[]) => void;
};
const pageInternals = () => h.app as unknown as PageInternals;

const getPageIds = () => h.app.getPages().map((page) => page.id);

const getPageElementIds = () =>
  h.app.getPages().map((page) => page.elements.map((el) => el.id));

const tag = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, pageId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { ...element.customData, [PAGE_ID_KEY]: pageId },
  }) as T;

const createRect = (id: string) =>
  API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id, x: 0, y: 0 });

/** messages this client broadcast (decoded) */
const getSentMessages = () =>
  mocks.emitted
    .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER)
    .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)));

const getSentElements = (): ExcalidrawElement[] =>
  getSentMessages()
    .filter(
      (message) =>
        message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE ||
        message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
    )
    .flatMap((message) => message.payload.elements);

/** the last copy of the element this client sent */
const getLastSent = (id: string) =>
  getSentElements()
    .filter((el) => el.id === id)
    .at(-1);

// NOTE: server events are awaited directly (not inside an async `act`), which
// would also wait for the room's 5s initialization fallback timer. Callers
// assert through `waitFor`.

/** simulates a message from another client arriving through the room */
const deliver = async (
  message: SocketUpdateDataSource[keyof SocketUpdateDataSource],
) => {
  await mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")!(
    new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(message)),
    new Uint8Array(12),
  );
};

/** a peer's UPDATE carrying `elements` */
const deliverUpdate = (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) =>
  deliver({
    type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
    payload: { elements: elements as any, sentAt: Date.now() },
  });

const triggerServerEvent = async (event: string, ...args: any[]) => {
  await mocks.handlers.get(event)!(...args);
};

/** local changes reach Collab through onChange → syncElements */
const sync = () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.syncElements(h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted());
  });
};

/** start a new room and finish initialization (we're alone in it) */
const startNewRoom = async () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.startCollaboration(null);
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true));
  await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
  );
};

/** adds a page (it becomes the open page) and returns its id */
const addPage = () => {
  act(() => pageInternals().createPage());
  return h.app.getActivePageId();
};

const selectPage = (pageId: string) => {
  act(() => pageInternals().selectPage(pageId));
};

/** draws an (untagged) element on the open page, as the user would */
const drawOnOpenPage = (element: ExcalidrawElement) => {
  API.updateScene({
    elements: [...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(), element],
    captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
  });
};

describe("multi-page collaboration (room)", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    mocks.handlers.clear();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    mocks.storedRoomElements = null;
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
    // a previous test's room link would make the app auto-join that room
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Elements stay on their page
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  describe("AC 2.1: page tag", () => {
    it("stamps an element with the page it was drawn on when it syncs", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      addPage();
      const secondPageId = addPage();

      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("drawn"));
      sync();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getLastSent("drawn")?.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY]).toBe(
          secondPageId,
        ),
      );
      expect(getElementPageId(h.elements[0])).toBe(secondPageId);
    });

    it("never changes the tag when the element is edited or moved", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const pageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("drawn"));
      sync();

      API.updateScene({
        elements: [newElementWith(h.elements[0], { x: 500, y: 300 })],
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      });
      sync();

      await waitFor(() => expect(getLastSent("drawn")?.x).toBe(500));
      expect(getLastSent("drawn")?.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY]).toBe(pageId);
    });

    it("never changes the tag when other pages are reordered or deleted", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      const thirdPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("drawn"));
      sync();

      act(() => {
        h.app.movePageToPosition(thirdPageId, "1");
      });
      act(() => pageInternals().deletePages([secondPageId]));
      sync();

      expect(getPageIds()).toEqual([thirdPageId, firstPageId]);
      expect(getElementPageId(h.elements[0])).toBe(firstPageId);
    });

    it("leaves a peer's tag alone when the element lands on the open page", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const pageId = h.app.getActivePageId();

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("theirs"), pageId)]);
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["theirs"]),
      );
      const versionBefore = h.elements[0].version;
      sync();

      expect(getElementPageId(h.elements[0])).toBe(pageId);
      expect(h.elements[0].version).toBe(versionBefore);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 2.2: routing", () => {
    it("shows a peer's element on the open page right away", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const pageId = h.app.getActivePageId();

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("theirs"), pageId)]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["theirs"]),
      );
    });

    it("stores a peer's element for another page on that page only", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      addPage();
      const thirdPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("theirs"), thirdPageId)]);

      // the page list (what the page previews are drawn from) has it on the
      // third page; the open page and the second page don't
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([[], [], ["theirs"]]),
      );
      expect(h.elements).toEqual([]);

      // and it's there when that page is opened
      selectPage(thirdPageId);
      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["theirs"]);
    });

    it("updates the stored copy when the peer edits it later", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      const theirs = tag(createRect("theirs"), secondPageId);

      await deliverUpdate([theirs]);
      await deliverUpdate([newElementWith(theirs, { x: 123 })]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(h.app.getPages()[1].elements.map((el) => el.x)).toEqual([123]),
      );
    });

    it("splits one update across pages", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);

      await deliverUpdate([
        tag(createRect("for-first"), firstPageId),
        tag(createRect("for-second"), secondPageId),
      ]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["for-first"], ["for-second"]]),
      );
      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["for-first"]);
    });

    it("doesn't put an element for a page it doesn't have on any page", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("lost"), "unknown-page")]);
      // a later update proves the first one was processed
      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("marker"), h.app.getActivePageId())]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["marker"]),
      );
      expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["marker"]]);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 2.3: untagged elements", () => {
    it("stamps an untagged element once with the first page and puts it there", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      addPage(); // the second page stays open
      const untagged = createRect("untagged");

      await deliverUpdate([untagged]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["untagged"], []]),
      );
      const stored = h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0];
      expect(getElementPageId(stored)).toBe(firstPageId);
      // a new version, so the tag syncs to the room
      expect(stored.version).toBeGreaterThan(untagged.version);
      expect(h.elements).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("uses the first page in the page list, not the first created", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      act(() => {
        h.app.movePageToPosition(secondPageId, "1");
      });

      await deliverUpdate([createRect("untagged")]);

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["untagged"], []]),
      );
      expect(getElementPageId(h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0])).toBe(
        secondPageId,
      );
    });
  });
});

```text
   * @param source where the remote elements come from:
   * - `"update"`: a peer's incremental update
   * - `"initialScene"`: the room scene sent to us when joining
   * - `"storedScene"`: the room's stored scene (the reference for what the
   *   room has)
   */
  private _reconcileElements = (
    remoteElements: readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
    source: "update" | "initialScene" | "storedScene" = "update",
    /** for updates: the sender's clock when it sent them */
    senderNow?: number,
  ): Map<string, ReconciledExcalidrawElement[]> => {
    const appState = this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState();

    // every page's elements (#167): the room holds the whole drawing
    const pages = this.excalidrawAPI.getPages();
    const existingElements = pages.flatMap((page) => page.elements);
    const existingElementsMap = arrayToMap(existingElements);

    // don't let a peer bring back elements whose deletion expired (see
    // expiredDeletions.ts)
    if (source === "update") {
      const expired = getExpiredResurrections(
        remoteElements,
        existingElementsMap,
        senderNow,
      );
      if (expired.size) {
        remoteElements = remoteElements.filter((el) => !expired.has(el.id));
      }
    }

    // peers' new elements (INIT/UPDATE) + stored-scene echoes. Our own
    // elements are already on our pages, so they're never marked remote.
    this.markRemoteElements(remoteElements, existingElementsMap);

    // NOTE ideally we restore _after_ reconciliation but we can't do that
    // as we'd regenerate even elements such as appState.newElement which would
    // break the state
    remoteElements = restoreElements(
      // untagged elements go to the first page (#167)
      this.pageStampRemoteElements(remoteElements),
      existingElements,
    );
```

On this Windows machine, `packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/export.test.ts` fails 3 snapshots (`exportToSvg` › default arguments / CJK font / exportEmbedScene) on master and every branch. CI (ubuntu-latest) passes.

Root cause: `setupTests.ts` sets `EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH = file://${__dirname}/`; on Windows Vite resolves fonts to `/@fs/C:/…`, giving `file:///c:/…/@fs/C:/…` → ENOENT → SVG falls back to font URLs instead of inlined base64.

**Why:** user pushed back when I first called it "probably the recent font feature" — CI must pass, so claims about unrelated failures need proof.
**How to apply:** to prove a branch matches CI, temporarily patch `fetchFont` in setupTests.ts to read `decodeURIComponent(url.pathname).split("/@fs/")[1]`, run the suite (expect 159/159 with committed snapshots unchanged), then `git checkout -- setupTests.ts`. Never commit the patch or regenerate the snapshots on Windows. Related: [[collaborator-layering-feature]].
