Step 1 (page tag and routing) is finished and passing, nothing is committed yet, and I need your "Approved" before starting step 2.

**What works now:**

- **Page tag:** every element is stamped once with the id of the page it was drawn on when it syncs in a room. The tag is a `customData` key (`pageId`) next to `creatorId`. Editing or moving the element, or reordering or deleting other pages, never changes it.
- **Routing:** a peer's element goes only to its tagged page. If that page is open it appears straight away; otherwise it's stored on that page, which is what the page preview is drawn from. An element for a page you don't have lands on no page.
- **Untagged elements:** stamped once with the first page in the page list and put there.
- **Safety net:** an element tagged for another page that somehow reaches the open page isn't drawn and can't be selected, erased or bound to. It goes through the same rule that hides a hidden collaborator's elements (#80).

**Things you should know:**

- **Reconcile runs per page, not over all pages at once.** Element order keys repeat across pages, and reconciling them together would renumber them (and in tests, throw). This was a real risk the plan didn't foresee.
- **`openPageId` is only set while you're in a room, and is `null` otherwise.** Page ids are random, so a real id in appState would have broken the snapshot tests; tags only matter in a room anyway. The history test's snapshot helper now drops `openPageId`, the same way it already drops `scrolledOutside`.
- **Saving a file while collaborating** now checks each page against itself. Otherwise the safety net would have emptied every inactive page in the saved file. There's a test for this.
- **Two merged tests needed updating, both as a direct result of #167:**
  - `collab.test`: the room creator's elements now carry `pageId` as well as `creatorId`.
  - `collabNewcomer` AC-H (#83): its fixture was an untagged room element, which #167 now stamps (a version change). I tagged it with the joiner's page. I'll revisit it in step 3, when the room carries its own pages.
- **In step 1 only the open page is broadcast**, same as before; it changes to all pages in step 2.

**Tests:**

- 31 new tests:
  - [pageStamp.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/pageStamp.test.ts): 10 unit tests.
  - [collabPages.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collabPages.test.tsx): 11 multi-client tests for AC 2.1–2.3.
  - [pagesCollab.test.tsx](packages/excalidraw/tests/pagesCollab.test.tsx): 12 editor tests for AC 2.4 and `setPageElements`.
- I broke the code on purpose to check the tests catch it. With the safety net turned off, 4 tests fail. With untagged elements going to the open page, 2 fail. With routing skipped, 5 fail.
- Full suite: 173 files and 2935 tests pass. After the later snapshot fix I reran the 21 affected files (414 tests), and they pass. Typecheck, ESLint and Prettier are clean on all changed files.
- I reverted the Windows-only CJK font snapshot change.

I'm reading your question as: App.tsx keeps getting page code added to it, so when does that code move out into something easier to manage, given that the safety net is only a fallback? Tell me if you meant something else.

**Current plan: App stays a thin adapter, and the decisions live in separate modules.**

- **Pure logic lives outside App and can be tested on its own:**
  - `pages.ts` holds the page rules, including `groupElementsByPageTag`.
  - `pageStamp.ts` holds stamping.
  - In step 3, a new `excalidraw-app/collab/pageSync.ts` will hold merging, change times, tombstones, name-collision renaming and message validation.
- **App only does what needs its private state.** That's `pages`, `activePageId` and the scene. Step 1 added two small methods: `getPages`, which only reads, and `setPageElements`, which writes elements to pages. Later steps add a few more of the same size:
  - `applySharedPages`, for create, remove, rename, reorder and background (step 3/4);
  - making `selectPage` public, for follow mode (step 5);
  - view-mode guards on page actions (step 6).
- **Collab decides; App applies.** Collab works out what changed and what wins, then hands App a finished result.
- **The safety net isn't something that grows.** It's one check inside the existing #80 rule. Routing is what keeps pages separate; the safety net only catches a bug.

**What I'm not planning to do** is move the page state (`pages`, `activePageId`, `pageTree`) out of App into its own store or class. That would mean rewriting how #157–#165 hold pages, and your instructions say not to rewrite the merged page features.

**If App's size is the worry, there's a middle option.** I could group the new methods in one clearly marked "#167 collaboration" section of App, with each method only a few lines that call into `pages.ts` or `pageSync.ts`. The rules then stay out of App without touching the merged code.

Which do you want: carry on as planned, use that middle option, or a bigger extraction? A bigger extraction would change merged features, so it's your call. I'll wait for your answer and an "Approved" before starting step 2.

```typescript
import { reconcileElements } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { groupElementsByPageTag } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/pages";

import type { RemoteExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/reconcile";
import type { OrderedExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";
import type { AppState } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

/**
 * Multi-page live collaboration (#167): pure helpers for keeping every
 * page of a room in sync.
 */

/**
 * Reconciles two copies of a room's elements (every page's), page by page.
 * Each page orders its elements on its own (fractional indices repeat across
 * pages), so reconciling them together would reorder them. An element's
 * copies always have the same page tag, since tags never change.
 */
export const reconcileElementsByPage = (
  localElements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[],
  remoteElements: readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: AppState,
): OrderedExcalidrawElement[] => {
  const localByPage = groupElementsByPageTag(localElements);
  const remoteByPage = groupElementsByPageTag(remoteElements);
  const pageIds = new Set([...localByPage.keys(), ...remoteByPage.keys()]);
  return [...pageIds].flatMap((pageId) =>
    reconcileElements(
      localByPage.get(pageId) ?? [],
      remoteByPage.get(pageId) ?? [],
      appState,
    ),
  );
};
```

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // every page's elements go through the room (page data: see AC 3.2)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** two local pages with one element each; the first page stays open */
  const setUpTwoPages = () => {
    const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
    drawOnOpenPage(createRect("on-first"));
    const secondPageId = addPage();
    drawOnOpenPage(createRect("on-second"));
    selectPage(firstPageId);
    return { firstPageId, secondPageId };
  };

  const describeElements = (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) =>
    elements.map((el) => [
      el.id,
      el.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY],
      el.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY],
    ]);

  describe("AC 1.1: starting a room (elements)", () => {
    it("puts every page's elements into the room, tagged with their page and creator", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = setUpTwoPages();

      await startNewRoom();

      const clientId = window.collab.getClientId();
      expect(describeElements(mocks.savedRoomElements[0])).toEqual([
        ["on-first", firstPageId, clientId],
        ["on-second", secondPageId, clientId],
      ]);
      // the pages hold the stamped copies too
      expect(describeElements(h.app.getPages()[1].elements)).toEqual([
        ["on-second", secondPageId, clientId],
      ]);
    });

    it("leaves deleted elements of every page out of the room", async () => {
      setUpTwoPages();
      selectPage(addPage());
      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("deleted"));
      API.updateScene({
        elements: [newElementWith(h.elements[0], { isDeleted: true })],
        captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
      });
      selectPage(getPageIds()[0]);

      await startNewRoom();

      expect(mocks.savedRoomElements[0].map((el) => el.id)).toEqual([
        "on-first",
        "on-second",
      ]);
      expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["on-first"], ["on-second"], []]);
    });

    it("sends every page's elements to a newcomer (INIT)", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await triggerServerEvent("new-user", "peer-socket");

      await waitFor(() => {
        const [init] = getSentMessages().filter(
          (message) => message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
        );
        expect(
          init.payload.elements.map((el: ExcalidrawElement) => [
            el.id,
            el.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY],
          ]),
        ).toEqual([
          ["on-first", firstPageId],
          ["on-second", secondPageId],
        ]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("broadcasts, full resync and storage cover every page", () => {
    it("an update carries only what changed", async () => {
      setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("new"));
      sync();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getSentElements().map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["new"]),
      );
    });

    it("the periodic full resync sends every page", async () => {
      setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      act(() => {
        window.collab.queueBroadcastAllElements.cancel();
        // throttled: the first call runs right away
        window.collab.queueBroadcastAllElements();
      });

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getSentElements().map((el) => el.id)).toEqual([
          "on-first",
          "on-second",
        ]),
      );
    });

    it("saves every page to room storage", async () => {
      setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.savedRoomElements.length = 0;

      drawOnOpenPage(createRect("new"));
      sync();
      act(() => {
        window.collab.queueSaveToFirebase.flush();
      });

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(mocks.savedRoomElements.at(-1)!.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual([
          "on-first",
          "new",
          "on-second",
        ]),
      );
    });

    it("doesn't send a peer's element for another page back to the room", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("theirs"), secondPageId)]);
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()[1]).toEqual(["on-second", "theirs"]),
      );
      sync();

      expect(getLastSent("theirs")).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe("AC 2.2: reconciling with another page's elements", () => {
    it("keeps the newer copy, whichever side has it", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();
      const local = h.app.getPages()[1].elements[0];

      await deliverUpdate([
        newElementWith(local, { x: 111 }, true) && {
          ...local,
          x: 111,
          version: local.version - 1,
        },
      ]);
      await deliverUpdate([
        tag(createRect("marker"), secondPageId),
      ]);
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()[1]).toEqual(["on-second", "marker"]),
      );
      // older: ours stays
      expect(h.app.getPages()[1].elements[0].x).toBe(local.x);

      await deliverUpdate([{ ...local, x: 222, version: local.version + 1 }]);
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(h.app.getPages()[1].elements[0].x).toBe(222),
      );
    });

    it("keeps each page's own element order keys", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = setUpTwoPages();
      await startNewRoom();

      // the same order key on two pages is fine: each page orders its own
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
        payload: {
          elements: [
            { ...tag(createRect("first-a5"), firstPageId), index: "a5" },
            { ...tag(createRect("second-a5"), secondPageId), index: "a5" },
          ] as any,
        },
      });

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(
          h.app
            .getPages()
            .map((page) => page.elements.map((el) => `${el.id}@${el.index}`)),
        ).toEqual([
          [`on-first@a0`, "first-a5@a5"],
          [`on-second@a0`, "second-a5@a5"],
        ]),
      );
    });
  });

  describe("AC 1.3: room storage (elements)", () => {
    /** joins the room as if by its link, while nobody else is online */
    const joinRoomAlone = async () => {
      act(() => {
        window.collab.startCollaboration({
          roomId: "room-id",
          roomKey: "room-key-0000000000000",
        });
      });
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true),
      );
      await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
      );
    };

    it("routes every stored element to its page", async () => {
      // the joiner's pages stand in for the room's (sharing page data: AC 1.2)
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        tag(createRect("stored-first"), firstPageId),
        tag(createRect("stored-second"), secondPageId),
        tag(createRect("stored-elsewhere"), "unknown-page"),
      ]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([
          ["stored-first"],
          ["stored-second"],
        ]),
      );
      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["stored-first"]);
    });

    it("puts untagged stored elements on the first page, stamped once", async () => {
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      selectPage(addPage());
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        createRect("stored-untagged"),
      ]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["stored-untagged"], []]),
      );
      expect(getElementPageId(h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0])).toBe(
        firstPageId,
      );
      // and the new stamp is sent to the room
      sync();
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getLastSent("stored-untagged")?.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY]).toBe(
          firstPageId,
        ),
      );
    });
  });
});

      // the same order key on two pages is fine: each page orders its own
      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
        payload: {
          elements: [
            { ...tag(createRect("first-a5"), firstPageId), index: "a5" },
            { ...tag(createRect("second-a5"), secondPageId), index: "a5" },
          ] as any,
        },
      });

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(
          h.app
            .getPages()
            .map((page) => page.elements.map((el) => `${el.id}@${el.index}`)),
        ).toEqual([
          ["on-first@a0", "first-a5@a5"],
          ["on-second@a0", "second-a5@a5"],
        ]),
      );
    });
  });

  describe("AC 1.3: room storage (elements)", () => {
    /** joins the room as if by its link, while nobody else is online */
    const joinRoomAlone = async () => {
      act(() => {
        window.collab.startCollaboration({
          roomId: "room-id",
          roomKey: "room-key-0000000000000",
        });
      });
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true),
      );
      await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
      );
    };

    it("routes every stored element to its page", async () => {
      // the joiner's pages stand in for the room's (sharing page data: AC 1.2)
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        tag(createRect("stored-first"), firstPageId),
        tag(createRect("stored-second"), secondPageId),
        tag(createRect("stored-elsewhere"), "unknown-page"),
      ]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([
          ["stored-first"],
          ["stored-second"],
        ]),
      );
      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["stored-first"]);
    });

    it("puts untagged stored elements on the first page, stamped once", async () => {
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      addPage();
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        createRect("stored-untagged"),
      ]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["stored-untagged"], []]),
      );
      expect(getElementPageId(h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0])).toBe(
        firstPageId,
      );
      // and the new stamp is sent to the room
      sync();
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getLastSent("stored-untagged")?.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY]).toBe(
          firstPageId,
        ),
      );
    });
  });
});

import { PAGE_ID_KEY, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { getDefaultAppState } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/appState";
import { restoreElements } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/restore";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";

import type { RemoteExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/reconcile";
import type {
  ExcalidrawElement,
  FractionalIndex,
  OrderedExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";
import type { AppState } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

import {
  reconcileElementsByPage,
  restoreElementsByPage,
} from "../collab/pageSync";

const appState = {
  ...getDefaultAppState(),
  width: 1000,
  height: 1000,
} as AppState;

/** an element on `pageId` with order key `index` */
const onPage = (
  id: string,
  pageId: string,
  index: string,
  updates: Partial<ExcalidrawElement> = {},
) =>
  ({
    ...newElementWith(API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id }), {
      customData: { [PAGE_ID_KEY]: pageId },
    }),
    index: index as FractionalIndex,
    ...updates,
  } as OrderedExcalidrawElement);

const describe_ = (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) =>
  elements.map((el) => `${el.id}@${el.index}`);

// every page's elements go through the room together (#167); each page
// orders its own, so order keys repeat across pages
describe("pages in one room (#167)", () => {
  describe("restoreElementsByPage", () => {
    it("(control) restoring two pages together renumbers repeated order keys", () => {
      expect(
        describe_(
          restoreElements(
            [onPage("p1-a", "p1", "a0"), onPage("p2-a", "p2", "a0")],
            null,
          ),
        ),
      ).not.toEqual(["p1-a@a0", "p2-a@a0"]);
    });

    it("keeps each page's order keys", () => {
      expect(
        describe_(
          restoreElementsByPage(
            [
              onPage("p1-a", "p1", "a0"),
              onPage("p2-a", "p2", "a0"),
              onPage("p1-b", "p1", "a1"),
            ],
            null,
          ),
        ),
      ).toEqual(["p1-a@a0", "p1-b@a1", "p2-a@a0"]);
    });

    it("still repairs order keys within a page", () => {
      expect(
        describe_(
          restoreElementsByPage(
            [onPage("p1-a", "p1", "a0"), onPage("p1-b", "p1", "a0")],
            null,
          ),
        ),
      ).not.toEqual(["p1-a@a0", "p1-b@a0"]);
    });
  });

  describe("reconcileElementsByPage", () => {
    it("keeps each page's order keys when merging", () => {
      expect(
        describe_(
          reconcileElementsByPage(
            [onPage("p1-a", "p1", "a0")],
            [
              onPage("p2-a", "p2", "a0"),
              onPage("p2-b", "p2", "a1"),
            ] as RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
            appState,
          ),
        ),
      ).toEqual(["p1-a@a0", "p2-a@a0", "p2-b@a1"]);
    });

    it("keeps the newer copy of each element", () => {
      const reconciled = reconcileElementsByPage(
        [
          onPage("newer-here", "p1", "a0", { version: 5, x: 1 }),
          onPage("newer-there", "p2", "a0", { version: 2, x: 1 }),
        ],
        [
          onPage("newer-here", "p1", "a0", { version: 3, x: 2 }),
          onPage("newer-there", "p2", "a0", { version: 4, x: 2 }),
        ] as RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
        appState,
      );
      expect(reconciled.map((el) => [el.id, el.x])).toEqual([
        ["newer-here", 1],
        ["newer-there", 2],
      ]);
    });

    it("keeps elements only one side has", () => {
      expect(
        reconcileElementsByPage(
          [onPage("only-here", "p1", "a0")],
          [onPage("only-there", "p2", "a0")] as RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
          appState,
        ).map((el) => el.id),
      ).toEqual(["only-here", "only-there"]);
    });
  });
});

Step 2 is done and passing; nothing is committed. Please reply "Approved" to start step 3, or tell me what to change.

**What works now:**

- **Starting a room** puts every page's elements into the room, each tagged with its page and creator. Deleted elements from any page are left out, as before for the single canvas.
- **Broadcasts** send what changed on any page, so a change to a page you don't have open is sent too.
- **The 20-second full resync**, the INIT sent to a newcomer, room storage and image upload/download now all cover every page.
- **The room's stored elements** are routed to their pages when you join or reload alone. The scene gets the open page's elements.
- **Incoming elements aren't echoed back**, whichever page they're on: the "already received" version now covers every page.

**A second bug the tests caught: `restoreElements` also renumbers order keys.** Like reconcile in step 1, it renumbers order keys that repeat across pages. It runs on incoming updates and in both Firebase load and save, so a peer's element on page 2 could quietly change position. A new helper restores per page, and all four places now use it. The tests include a check showing the old single call does renumber, and a multi-client test that fails if the per-page restore is removed.

**Things you should know:**

- **Joining with someone else's pages isn't complete until step 3.** The joiner doesn't receive the room's page list yet, so elements for pages it doesn't have land on no page. The room-storage tests use the joiner's own pages to stand in for the room's.
- **The #83 AC-H fixture needed one more interim change.** The test app remounts when it joins, so it gets a new random page id. I added a small hook to that file's Firebase mock that tags the stored element with the page the joiner actually opened. Step 3 replaces this with real room page data.
- **Noted for step 4:** the "already sent" check is a sum of element versions. Deleting a page removes its elements, so the total drops, and later changes might not be broadcast until it climbs back up. I'll reset the count when pages are deleted.

**Tests:**

- 17 new tests:
  - [collabPages.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collabPages.test.tsx): 11 multi-client tests covering room start, INIT, updates, resync, storage, no echo, newer copy wins, order keys, and stored-scene routing.
  - [pageSync.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/pageSync.test.ts): 6 unit tests.
- Full suite: 173 of 174 files pass, with 3 failures in `export.test.ts`. Those are the known Windows font-path snapshots. With the temporary font patch from my notes, all 18 tests in that file pass, and I reverted the patch (`setupTests.ts` is untouched).
- Typecheck, ESLint and Prettier are clean.

**Changed in this step:**

| File | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [Collab.tsx](excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx) | `getAllPageElementsIncludingDeleted`; room start covers all pages; broadcast, resync, save, images and unload all use every page; stored scene routed on join; per-page restore |
| [Portal.tsx](excalidraw-app/collab/Portal.tsx) | INIT to newcomers and image upload use every page |
| [pageSync.ts](excalidraw-app/collab/pageSync.ts) (new) | `restoreElementsByPage`, `reconcileElementsByPage`. Step 3's page-data logic will go here too |
| [firebase.ts](excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts) | Save reconciles per page; load and save restore per page |
| [collabNewcomer.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collabNewcomer.test.tsx) | Load-time hook for the AC-H fixture (interim, see above) |

**Next, step 3** is the page-data message and conflicts: one `PAGE_DATA` message, kept in the room's Firebase document as well. It carries the page list with names, descriptions, backgrounds, positions, change times and deleted pages. Joining replaces your pages with the room's; later change wins, ties broken by page id; and duplicate names get renamed.

Here's a test-by-test walkthrough, followed by where each acceptance criterion stands.

One correction first: I said step 1 added 31 tests. The real count is 33, so with step 2's 17 there are **50 new tests** in total.

## Tests, one line each

### [pageStamp.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/pageStamp.test.ts): 10 unit tests (step 1)

Pure functions only: no editor, no room. They're fast, and when one fails it points at the exact rule.

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| stamps only elements without a page tag | One untagged and one tagged element; only the untagged one gets stamped | Core of "stamped once" (AC 2.1) |
| never restamps a tagged element, whatever page is open | A page-2 element isn't restamped | Stops edits or moves from moving an element to another page |
| treats an invalid tag as no tag | `""` and a number count as untagged | Bad data from a peer can't create a fake page |
| adds the page id and keeps the rest of customData | `creatorId` and other keys survive stamping | Stamping must not wipe the creator stamp (#80) |
| works without customData | Stamps an element that has no `customData` | Most new elements have none |
| reads a valid tag, null otherwise | `getElementPageId` on valid, missing and empty tags | Every other rule relies on this reader |
| is true only for elements tagged for another page | The safety-net check, both outcomes | The rule behind AC 2.4 |
| never hides untagged elements | Untagged elements stay visible | Local elements are untagged until they sync; hiding them would make new drawings vanish |
| is off when no page is open (outside a room) | `null` or `undefined` means nothing is hidden | Tags in a saved file must not hide anything when you're solo |
| groups by tag, keeping order, untagged under null | Splits a mixed list by page | Routing is built on this; order must be kept for layering |

### [pageSync.test.ts](excalidraw-app/tests/pageSync.test.ts): 6 unit tests (step 2)

These cover the per-page helpers that fixed the renumbering bug.

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (control) restoring two pages together renumbers repeated order keys | The _old_ single call changes `a0`/`a0` | Shows the bug is real, so the next test means something |
| keeps each page's order keys | Per-page restore leaves both `a0` keys alone | Peers' elements keep their position on each page |
| still repairs order keys within a page | Duplicate keys on the _same_ page still get fixed | The per-page version doesn't lose the existing repair |
| keeps each page's order keys when merging | Reconcile across pages leaves keys unchanged | Same protection for room storage and saves |
| keeps the newer copy of each element | Higher version wins, in each direction | Existing conflict rule still holds per page |
| keeps elements only one side has | Local-only and stored-only elements both survive | A save never drops another client's elements |

### [collabPages.test.tsx](excalidraw-app/tests/collabPages.test.tsx): 22 multi-client tests (steps 1 and 2)

These run the real Collab and Portal with a fake socket. They check what this client _sends_, or deliver a peer's message and check which page each element lands on.

**AC 2.1, page tag**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| stamps an element with the page it was drawn on when it syncs | Draw on page 2; the sent copy is tagged with page 2 | Checks the tag in the actual network payload |
| never changes the tag when the element is edited or moved | Move it; the sent copy keeps its tag | Spec: "editing or moving never changes its tag" |
| never changes the tag when other pages are reordered or deleted | Reorder and delete other pages; the tag stays | Spec names these two cases directly |
| leaves a peer's tag alone when the element lands on the open page | Receive, then sync; no restamp and no version bump | Prevents a re-send storm where every client restamps |

**AC 2.2, routing**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| shows a peer's element on the open page right away | Element for the open page is in the scene | "If that page is open, it appears right away" |
| stores a peer's element for another page on that page only | Lands on page 3 only; also checked after opening page 3 | The core bug from the issue: elements landing on whatever page you have open |
| updates the stored copy when the peer edits it later | Second update changes the stored copy | Inactive pages don't go stale |
| splits one update across pages | One message with two pages goes to both | Real updates mix pages |
| doesn't put an element for a page it doesn't have on any page | Unknown page goes nowhere | "Never appears on any other page" |
| keeps the newer copy, whichever side has it | Older remote copy ignored, newer applied (on page 2) | Normal conflict rules on inactive pages |
| keeps each page's own element order keys | `a5` on two pages stays `a5` | **Caught the `restoreElements` bug** |

**AC 2.3, untagged elements**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| stamps an untagged element once with the first page and puts it there | Lands on page 1, gets a new version, isn't in the scene (page 2 open) | Spec rule, plus "the stamp syncs" |
| uses the first page in the page list, not the first created or the open one | Open page, first page and first-created page all differ | Mutation testing showed an earlier version couldn't tell them apart |

**AC 1.1, starting a room (elements)**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| puts every page's elements into the room, tagged with their page and creator | First Firebase save contains both pages, tagged | "All of them go into the room" |
| leaves deleted elements of every page out of the room | Deleted element on page 3 isn't saved | Keeps the existing privacy rule (deleted content never uploaded) for every page |
| sends every page's elements to a newcomer (INIT) | INIT payload has both pages | Otherwise joiners only get the open page |

**Broadcast, resync, storage**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| an update carries only what changed | Only the new element is sent | Sending every page mustn't mean sending everything each time |
| the periodic full resync sends every page | 20-second resync includes page 2 | Recovers dropped messages on any page |
| saves every page to room storage | Throttled Firebase save has every page | AC 1.3 groundwork |
| doesn't send a peer's element for another page back to the room | No echo | Prevents loops and wasted traffic |

**AC 1.3, room storage (elements)**

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| routes every stored element to its page | Joining alone gets each page's stored elements; unknown page dropped | Reload with nobody online |
| puts untagged stored elements on the first page, stamped once | Old rooms' elements go to page 1, and the stamp is sent | Old rooms keep working |

### [pagesCollab.test.tsx](packages/excalidraw/tests/pagesCollab.test.tsx): 12 editor tests (step 1)

No network here. These check that the editor enforces the safety net.

| Test | What it checks | Why it's useful |
| --- | --- | --- |
| knows the open page only while collaborating | `openPageId` is set in a room and `null` solo | The safety net is room-only by design |
| follows page switches | Updated after creating a page | A stale id would hide the whole new page |
| is not drawn | Foreign-tagged element isn't rendered | AC 2.4 "not drawn" |
| (control) outside a room nothing is hidden | Same setup, solo: both drawn | Proves the next tests aren't passing by accident |
| can't be selected by clicking, box-selecting or select all | All three selection paths, plus Delete | AC 2.4 "can't be selected" |
| (control) outside a room the eraser reaches both | Solo eraser erases both | Without it, the eraser test passed even with the safety net off |
| can't be erased | In a room, only the open page's element is erased | AC 2.4 "erased" |
| can't be bound to | An arrow won't bind to it | AC 2.4 "bound to" |
| saving a file while collaborating keeps every page's elements | Saved file has both pages' elements | Guards the regression I found in `actionExport` (the safety net would have emptied inactive pages) |
| updates the open page through the scene and other pages in place | `setPageElements` sends each page's elements to the right place | Tests the new editor API directly |
| doesn't add history entries | Remote elements aren't undoable | Undo must never undo a peer's work (#168 is out of scope) |
| ignores unknown pages | Unknown id leaves pages unchanged | API stays safe against bad input |

### Existing tests I changed (3)

- **`collab.test.tsx`:** the room creator's elements now also carry `pageId`. That's a direct consequence of AC 2.1.
- **`collabNewcomer.test.tsx` AC-H (#83):** the fixture is now tagged with the joiner's page. It's an interim fix until step 3, when the room's own pages will drive the fixture.
- **`history.test.tsx`:** its snapshot helper drops `openPageId`, because the id is random. It already drops other fields that vary between runs.

**I checked that the tests can fail.** I broke the code on purpose five ways: safety net off, untagged elements going to the open page, routing skipped, a single restore across pages, and an eraser control. Each time the matching tests failed.

 * @param {string} key
 * @param {string} digits

export function validateOrderKey(
  key: string,
  digits: string = BASE_62_DIGITS,
): void {
  const validChars = key.split("").every((char) => digits.includes(char));
  if (key === `A${digits[0].repeat(26)}` || !validChars) {
    throw new Error(`invalid order key: ${key}`);
  }
  // getIntegerPart will throw if the first character is bad,

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// page data: what the room shares about each page
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * A shared page value with the time it last changed, by the clock of the
 * client that changed it. Each field has its own time, so changes to
 * different fields of a page never overwrite each other.
 */
export type PageField = Readonly<{ value: string; updated: number }>;

/**
 * The page fields everyone in a room shares. Everything else about a page
 * (scroll, zoom, grid, `showThumbnail`) is personal and never sent.
 * `position` is a fractional order key: pages are ordered by it, ties broken
 * by page id.
 */
export const SHARED_PAGE_FIELDS = [
  "name",
  "description",
  "viewBackgroundColor",
  "position",
] as const;
export type SharedPageField = (typeof SHARED_PAGE_FIELDS)[number];

export type SharedPage = Readonly<
  { id: string } & Record<SharedPageField, PageField>
>;

/** the PAGE_DATA message payload, also kept in the room's stored document */
export type SharedPageData = Readonly<{
  /** live pages, in page order */
  pages: readonly SharedPage[];
  /**
   * deleted page ids → when they were deleted. Kept so deletion wins: a
   * page deleted here never comes back, whatever arrives later.
   */
  deletedPageIds: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
}>;

/** a page as the editor shows it to the room */
export type SharedPageInfo = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  viewBackgroundColor: string;
}>;

export const EMPTY_PAGE_DATA: SharedPageData = {
  pages: [],
  deletedPageIds: {},
};

const compareStrings = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

/** page order: by position, ties broken by page id */
const comparePages = (a: SharedPage, b: SharedPage) =>
  compareStrings(a.position.value, b.position.value) ||
  compareStrings(a.id, b.id);

const isDeleted = (data: Pick<SharedPageData, "deletedPageIds">, id: string) =>
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data.deletedPageIds, id);

/**
 * The later change wins. Two changes to the same field of the same page at
 * the same time can't be told apart by page id, so the larger value wins:
 * every client picks the same one, whatever order they arrive in.
 */
const pickNewerField = (a: PageField, b: PageField): PageField =>
  a.updated !== b.updated
    ? a.updated > b.updated
      ? a
      : b
    : a.value >= b.value
    ? a
    : b;

const mergePage = (a: SharedPage, b: SharedPage): SharedPage => ({
  id: a.id,
  name: pickNewerField(a.name, b.name),
  description: pickNewerField(a.description, b.description),
  viewBackgroundColor: pickNewerField(
    a.viewBackgroundColor,
    b.viewBackgroundColor,
  ),
  position: pickNewerField(a.position, b.position),
});

/**
 * Pages whose names collide (case-insensitive, trimmed) after changes crossed
 * in transit: the page whose name changed later is renamed to the next free
 * default name ("Page N"), ties broken by page id (the larger id is
 * renamed). The new name's time is one after the renamed change, so every
 * client computes the same field.
 */
export const resolvePageNameCollisions = (
  data: SharedPageData,
  baseName: string,
): SharedPageData => {
  const byNameTime = [...data.pages].sort(
    (a, b) => a.name.updated - b.name.updated || compareStrings(a.id, b.id),
  );
  const names = new Map(data.pages.map((page) => [page.id, page.name]));
  const taken = new Set<string>();
  const renamed = new Map<string, PageField>();
  for (const page of byNameTime) {
    const name = normalizePageName(page.name.value);
    if (!taken.has(name)) {
      taken.add(name);
      continue;
    }
    const value = getNextDefaultPageName(
      [...names.values()].map((field) => ({ name: field.value })),
      baseName,
    );
    const field = { value, updated: page.name.updated + 1 };
    names.set(page.id, field);
    renamed.set(page.id, field);
    taken.add(normalizePageName(value));
  }
  if (!renamed.size) {
    return data;
  }
  return {
    ...data,
    pages: data.pages.map((page) =>
      renamed.has(page.id) ? { ...page, name: renamed.get(page.id)! } : page,
    ),
  };
};

/**
 * When concurrent deletions leave no page at all, every client adds the same
 * blank page (same id, name and position), so they still agree.
 */
const getBlankPageAfterDeletions = (
  deletedPageIds: SharedPageData["deletedPageIds"],
  baseName: string,
): SharedPage => {
  const [id, updated] = Object.entries(deletedPageIds).sort(
    ([idA, a], [idB, b]) => b - a || compareStrings(idA, idB),
  )[0];
  const field = (value: string): PageField => ({ value, updated });
  return {
    id: `${id}-blank`,
    name: field(getNextDefaultPageName([], baseName)),
    description: field(""),
    viewBackgroundColor: field(getDefaultAppState().viewBackgroundColor),
    position: field(generateFractionalIndexBetween(null, null)),
  };
};

/**
 * Merges two copies of a room's page data (#167). The result is the same
 * whatever order changes arrive in:
 * - each field of each page: the later change wins (`pickNewerField`)
 * - deletion wins: a deleted page never comes back, even if edited later
 * - colliding names are resolved (`resolvePageNameCollisions`)
 *
 * @param baseName the default page name, e.g. "Page"
 */
export const mergePageData = (
  local: SharedPageData,
  remote: SharedPageData,
  baseName: string,
): SharedPageData => {
  const deletedPageIds: Record<string, number> = { ...local.deletedPageIds };
  for (const [id, deletedAt] of Object.entries(remote.deletedPageIds)) {
    deletedPageIds[id] = Math.max(deletedPageIds[id] ?? deletedAt, deletedAt);
  }

  const byId = new Map(local.pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));
  for (const page of remote.pages) {
    const ours = byId.get(page.id);
    byId.set(page.id, ours ? mergePage(ours, page) : page);
  }
  let pages = [...byId.values()].filter(
    (page) => !isDeleted({ deletedPageIds }, page.id),
  );
  if (!pages.length && Object.keys(deletedPageIds).length) {
    pages = [getBlankPageAfterDeletions(deletedPageIds, baseName)];
  }

  return resolvePageNameCollisions(
    { pages: pages.sort(comparePages), deletedPageIds },
    baseName,
  );
};

/**
 * Indices (into `values`) of a longest strictly increasing subsequence. The
 * pages at these indices kept their relative order, so only the others moved.
 */
const getLongestIncreasingRun = (values: readonly number[]): Set<number> => {
  const lengths = values.map(() => 1);
  const previous = values.map(() => -1);
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
      if (values[j] < values[i] && lengths[j] + 1 > lengths[i]) {
        lengths[i] = lengths[j] + 1;
        previous[i] = j;
      }
    }
  }
  const kept = new Set<number>();
  let i = lengths.indexOf(Math.max(0, ...lengths));
  while (i !== -1) {
    kept.add(i);
    i = previous[i];
  }
  return kept;
};

/**
 * Order keys for `pages` in their local order: pages that kept their
 * relative order keep their keys, the others (moved or new) get new keys
 * between their neighbours. Returns null for pages whose key doesn't change.
 */
const getPositions = (
  shared: SharedPageData,
  pages: readonly SharedPageInfo[],
): (string | null)[] => {
  const sharedIndex = new Map(shared.pages.map((page, i) => [page.id, i]));
  const known = pages
    .map((page, i) => ({ i, sharedIndex: sharedIndex.get(page.id) }))
    .filter(
      (entry): entry is { i: number; sharedIndex: number } =>
        entry.sharedIndex !== undefined,
    );
  const keptRun = getLongestIncreasingRun(
    known.map((entry) => entry.sharedIndex),
  );
  const keepsKey = new Set(
    known.filter((_, k) => keptRun.has(k)).map((entry) => entry.i),
  );
  const keyOf = (i: number) =>
    shared.pages[sharedIndex.get(pages[i].id)!].position.value;

  // new pages before every kept page go before every known page, e.g. the
  // blank page left by deleting every page becomes the first page
  const firstKnownKey = shared.pages[0]?.position.value ?? null;
  const positions: (string | null)[] = [];
  let lower: string | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
    if (keepsKey.has(i)) {
      positions.push(null);
      lower = keyOf(i);
      continue;
    }
    let next = i + 1;
    while (next < pages.length && !keepsKey.has(next)) {
      next++;
    }
    const upper =
      next < pages.length ? keyOf(next) : lower === null ? firstKnownKey : null;
    const key = generateFractionalIndexBetween(
      lower as FractionalIndex | null,
      upper as FractionalIndex | null,
    );
    positions.push(key);
    lower = key;
  }
  return positions;
};

/** fresh keys for every page, in order (fallback when keys can't fit) */
const getFreshPositions = (pages: readonly SharedPageInfo[]) => {
  let lower: string | null = null;
  return pages.map(() => {
    lower = generateFractionalIndexBetween(
      lower as FractionalIndex | null,
      null,
    );
    return lower;
  });
};

/**
 * Turns the editor's pages into page data, given the last shared copy (#167):
 * pages that are new, changed, moved or gone are recorded as changed `now`.
 * Returns null when nothing shared changed (personal settings never count).
 *
 * @param pages the editor's pages, in order
 */
export const getLocalPageChanges = (
  shared: SharedPageData,
  pages: readonly SharedPageInfo[],
  now: number,
): SharedPageData | null => {
  const sharedById = new Map(shared.pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));
  const localIds = new Set(pages.map((page) => page.id));
  let changed = false;

  const deletedPageIds: Record<string, number> = { ...shared.deletedPageIds };
  for (const page of shared.pages) {
    if (!localIds.has(page.id)) {
      deletedPageIds[page.id] = now;
      changed = true;
    }
  }

  let positions: (string | null)[];
  try {
    positions = getPositions(shared, pages);
  } catch {
    // e.g. two pages with the same key around a moved page: renumber all
    positions = getFreshPositions(pages);
  }

  const toField = (
    previous: PageField | undefined,
    value: string,
  ): PageField => {
    if (previous && previous.value === value) {
      return previous;
    }
    changed = true;
    return { value, updated: now };
  };

  const sharedPages = pages.map((page, i): SharedPage => {
    const previous = sharedById.get(page.id);
    return {
      id: page.id,
      name: toField(previous?.name, page.name),
      description: toField(previous?.description, page.description),
      viewBackgroundColor: toField(
        previous?.viewBackgroundColor,
        page.viewBackgroundColor,
      ),
      position:
        positions[i] === null

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

  isRecord(value) &&
  typeof value.value === "string" &&
  typeof value.updated === "number" &&

    value: field.value,
    updated: field.updated,

    id: page.id,
    name: pick(page.name),
    description: pick(page.description),
    viewBackgroundColor: pick(page.viewBackgroundColor),
    position: pick(page.position),

 * (ignore it all, keep the pages as they are) for a page with missing or
 * invalid fields, two pages with the same id, no live page, or an invalid

    !Array.isArray(value.pages) ||
    !value.pages.length ||
    !isRecord(value.deletedPageIds)

/**
 * `restoreElements` for a room's elements (every page's), page by page:
 * restoring also repairs order keys, which repeat across pages, so restoring
 * them together would reorder them.
 *
 * @param existingElements context for each page (e.g. repairing bindings):
 * our elements with the same page tag

export const restoreElementsByPage = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  existingElements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] | null,
  opts?: Parameters<typeof restoreElements>[2],
) => {
  const existingByPage = groupElementsByPageTag(existingElements ?? []);
  return [...groupElementsByPageTag(elements)].flatMap(
    ([pageId, pageElements]) =>
      restoreElements(
        pageElements,
        existingElements ? existingByPage.get(pageId) ?? [] : null,
        opts,
      ),
  );
};

/**
 * Reconciles two copies of a room's elements (every page's), page by page.
 * Each page orders its elements on its own (fractional indices repeat across
 * pages), so reconciling them together would reorder them. An element's
 * copies always have the same page tag, since tags never change.
 */
export const reconcileElementsByPage = (
  localElements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[],
  remoteElements: readonly RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: AppState,
): OrderedExcalidrawElement[] => {
  const localByPage = groupElementsByPageTag(localElements);
  const remoteByPage = groupElementsByPageTag(remoteElements);
  const pageIds = new Set([...localByPage.keys(), ...remoteByPage.keys()]);
  return [...pageIds].flatMap((pageId) =>
    reconcileElements(
      localByPage.get(pageId) ?? [],
      remoteByPage.get(pageId) ?? [],
      appState,
    ),
  );

 * The page fields everyone in a room shares. Everything else about a page

  "name",
  "description",
  "viewBackgroundColor",
  "position",

export type SharedPageField = typeof SHARED_PAGE_FIELDS[number];

export type SharedPage = Readonly<
  { id: string } & Record<SharedPageField, PageField>

  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;

 * the same time can't be told apart by page id, so the larger value wins:
 * every client picks the same one, whatever order they arrive in.

  a.updated !== b.updated
    ? a.updated > b.updated
      ? a
      : b
    : a.value >= b.value

  name: pickNewerField(a.name, b.name),
  description: pickNewerField(a.description, b.description),

  ),
  position: pickNewerField(a.position, b.position),

 * client computes the same field.

export const resolvePageNameCollisions = (
  data: SharedPageData,
  baseName: string,

  const byNameTime = [...data.pages].sort(
    (a, b) => a.name.updated - b.name.updated || compareStrings(a.id, b.id),

  const renamed = new Map<string, PageField>();

    const name = normalizePageName(page.name.value);
    if (!taken.has(name)) {
      taken.add(name);
      continue;
    }
    const value = getNextDefaultPageName(
      [...names.values()].map((field) => ({ name: field.value })),
      baseName,

    const field = { value, updated: page.name.updated + 1 };
    names.set(page.id, field);
    renamed.set(page.id, field);

  local: SharedPageData,

  for (const [id, deletedAt] of Object.entries(remote.deletedPageIds)) {
    deletedPageIds[id] = Math.max(deletedPageIds[id] ?? deletedAt, deletedAt);

 */
const getLongestIncreasingRun = (values: readonly number[]): Set<number> => {
  const lengths = values.map(() => 1);
  const previous = values.map(() => -1);
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
      if (values[j] < values[i] && lengths[j] + 1 > lengths[i]) {
        lengths[i] = lengths[j] + 1;
        previous[i] = j;
      }

  let i = values.length ? lengths.indexOf(Math.max(...lengths)) : -1;

    kept.add(i);
    i = previous[i];

type FirebaseStoredScene = {
  sceneVersion: number;
  iv: Bytes;
  ciphertext: Bytes;
  /**
   * the room's page data (#167), encrypted separately so the elements keep
   * their format. Missing in rooms saved before pages were shared.
   */
  pagesIv?: Bytes;
  pagesCiphertext?: Bytes;
};

/** what the room stores: every page's elements and the page data (#167) */
export type StoredRoom = {
  elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[];
  /** null when missing or invalid (see `parsePageData`) */
  pageData: SharedPageData | null;
};

const encryptJSON = async (
  key: string,
  value: unknown,
): Promise<{ ciphertext: ArrayBuffer; iv: Uint8Array }> => {
  const json = JSON.stringify(value);
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
  const { encryptedBuffer, iv } = await encryptData(key, encoded);

  return { ciphertext: encryptedBuffer, iv };
};

const decryptJSON = async (
  ivBytes: Bytes,
  ciphertextBytes: Bytes,
  roomKey: string,
): Promise<unknown> => {
  const ciphertext = ciphertextBytes.toUint8Array() as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
  const iv = ivBytes.toUint8Array() as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;

  const decrypted = await decryptData(iv, ciphertext, roomKey);
  const decodedData = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(
    new Uint8Array(decrypted),
  );
  return JSON.parse(decodedData);
};

const decryptElements = async (
  data: FirebaseStoredScene,
  roomKey: string,
) =>
  (await decryptJSON(
    data.iv,
    data.ciphertext,
    roomKey,
  )) as readonly ExcalidrawElement[];

const decryptPageData = async (
  data: FirebaseStoredScene,
  roomKey: string,
): Promise<SharedPageData | null> => {
  if (!data.pagesIv || !data.pagesCiphertext) {
    return null;
  }
  try {
    return parsePageData(
      await decryptJSON(data.pagesIv, data.pagesCiphertext, roomKey),
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(error);
    return null;
  }
};

/** what was last saved to or loaded from the room, per socket */
class FirebaseSceneVersionCache {
  private static cache = new WeakMap<
    Socket,
    { sceneVersion: number; pageData: string | null }
  >();
  static get = (socket: Socket) => {
    return FirebaseSceneVersionCache.cache.get(socket);
  };
  static set = (
    socket: Socket,
    elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
    pageData: SharedPageData | null,
  ) => {
    FirebaseSceneVersionCache.cache.set(socket, {
      sceneVersion: getSceneVersion(elements),
      pageData: pageData && JSON.stringify(pageData),
    });
  };
}

/**
 * @param pageData the room's page data (#167): a page change is unsaved too.
 * Omit it to compare elements only.
 */
export const isSavedToFirebase = (
  portal: Portal,
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  pageData?: SharedPageData | null,
): boolean => {
  if (portal.socket && portal.roomId && portal.roomKey) {
    const saved = FirebaseSceneVersionCache.get(portal.socket);
    return (
      saved?.sceneVersion === getSceneVersion(elements) &&
      (pageData === undefined ||
        saved.pageData === (pageData && JSON.stringify(pageData)))
    );
  }
  // if no room exists, consider the room saved so that we don't unnecessarily
  // prevent unload (there's nothing we could do at that point anyway)
  return true;
};

export const saveFilesToFirebase = async ({
  prefix,
  files,
}: {
  prefix: string;
  files: { id: FileId; buffer: Uint8Array }[];
}) => {
  const storage = await loadFirebaseStorage();

  const erroredFiles: FileId[] = [];
  const savedFiles: FileId[] = [];

  await Promise.all(
    files.map(async ({ id, buffer }) => {
      try {
        const storageRef = ref(storage, `${prefix}/${id}`);
        await uploadBytes(storageRef, buffer, {
          cacheControl: `public, max-age=${FILE_CACHE_MAX_AGE_SEC}`,
        });
        savedFiles.push(id);
      } catch (error: any) {
        erroredFiles.push(id);
      }
    }),
  );

  return { savedFiles, erroredFiles };
};

const createFirebaseSceneDocument = async (
  elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  pageData: SharedPageData | null,
  roomKey: string,
) => {
  const sceneVersion = getSceneVersion(elements);
  const { ciphertext, iv } = await encryptJSON(roomKey, elements);
  const pages = pageData && (await encryptJSON(roomKey, pageData));
  return {
    sceneVersion,
    ciphertext: Bytes.fromUint8Array(new Uint8Array(ciphertext)),
    iv: Bytes.fromUint8Array(iv),
    ...(pages
      ? {
          pagesCiphertext: Bytes.fromUint8Array(
            new Uint8Array(pages.ciphertext),
          ),
          pagesIv: Bytes.fromUint8Array(pages.iv),
        }
      : {}),
  } as FirebaseStoredScene;
};

/**
 * @param isKnownToRoom whether an element was ever in the room's scene as
 * far as this client knows. Local elements the stored scene no longer has
 * because their deletion expired aren't saved (see expiredDeletions.ts).
 * @param pageData our copy of the room's page data (#167), merged with the
 * stored copy
 * @returns what the room stores after the save, or null if nothing was saved
 */
export const saveToFirebase = async (
  portal: Portal,
  elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: AppState,
  isKnownToRoom?: (elementId: string) => boolean,
  pageData: SharedPageData | null = null,
): Promise<{
  elements: RemoteExcalidrawElement[];
  pageData: SharedPageData | null;
} | null> => {
  const { roomId, roomKey, socket } = portal;
  if (
    // bail if no room exists as there's nothing we can do at this point
    !roomId ||
    !roomKey ||
    !socket ||
    isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, pageData)
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const firestore = _getFirestore();
  const docRef = doc(firestore, "scenes", roomId);

  const storedScene = await runTransaction(firestore, async (transaction) => {
    const snapshot = await transaction.get(docRef);

    if (!snapshot.exists()) {
      const storedScene = await createFirebaseSceneDocument(
        elements,
        pageData,
        roomKey,
      );

      transaction.set(docRef, storedScene);

      return storedScene;
    }

    const prevStoredScene = snapshot.data() as FirebaseStoredScene;
    const prevStoredElements = getSyncableElements(
      // page by page (#167)
      restoreElementsByPage(
        await decryptElements(prevStoredScene, roomKey),
        null,
      ),
    );
    // don't save our live copies of elements whose deletion expired
    const expiredIds = isKnownToRoom
      ? new Set(
          getLocalElementsWithExpiredDeletion(
            elements,
            new Set(prevStoredElements.map((el) => el.id)),
            isKnownToRoom,
          ).map((el) => el.id),
        )
      : new Set<string>();
    const reconciledElements = getSyncableElements(
      reconcileElementsByPage(
        elements.filter((el) => !expiredIds.has(el.id)),
        prevStoredElements as OrderedExcalidrawElement[] as RemoteExcalidrawElement[],
        appState,
      ),
    );
    // the same merge as for peers' page data, so storage converges too
    const prevPageData = await decryptPageData(prevStoredScene, roomKey);
    const mergedPageData =
      pageData && prevPageData
        ? mergePageData(prevPageData, pageData, t("labels.page"))
        : pageData ?? prevPageData;

    const storedScene = await createFirebaseSceneDocument(
      reconciledElements,
      mergedPageData,
      roomKey,
    );

    transaction.update(docRef, storedScene);

    // Return the stored elements as the in memory `reconciledElements` could have mutated in the meantime
    return storedScene;
  });

  const storedElements = getSyncableElements(
    restoreElementsByPage(await decryptElements(storedScene, roomKey), null),
  );
  const storedPageData = await decryptPageData(storedScene, roomKey);

  FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, storedElements, storedPageData);

  return {
    elements: toBrandedType<RemoteExcalidrawElement[]>(storedElements),
    pageData: storedPageData,
  };
};

export const loadFromFirebase = async (
  roomId: string,
  roomKey: string,
  socket: Socket | null,
): Promise<StoredRoom | null> => {
  const firestore = _getFirestore();
  const docRef = doc(firestore, "scenes", roomId);
  const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);
  if (!docSnap.exists()) {
    return null;
  }
  const storedScene = docSnap.data() as FirebaseStoredScene;
  const elements = getSyncableElements(
    restoreElementsByPage(await decryptElements(storedScene, roomKey), null, {
      deleteInvisibleElements: true,
    }),
  );
  const pageData = await decryptPageData(storedScene, roomKey);

  if (socket) {
    FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, elements, pageData);
  }

  return { elements, pageData };
};

/**
 * Page data in a room (#167): merging peers' copies, conflicts, local
 * changes and validation. Pure logic, see collab/pageSync.ts. The room-level
 * behaviour is tested in collabPages.test.tsx.
 */
import {
  EMPTY_PAGE_DATA,
  getLocalPageChanges,
  getSharedPageInfos,
  isSamePageData,
  mergePageData,
  parsePageData,
  resolvePageNameCollisions,
} from "../collab/pageSync";

import type { PageField, SharedPage, SharedPageData } from "../collab/pageSync";
import type { SharedPageInfo } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/pages";

const BASE_NAME = "Page";

const field = (value: string, updated = 1): PageField => ({ value, updated });

/** a shared page; every field changed at time 1 unless given */
const page = (
  id: string,
  {
    name = id,
    description = "",
    viewBackgroundColor = "#ffffff",
    position = "a0",
    updated = 1,
  }: Partial<Record<"name" | "description" | "viewBackgroundColor", string>> & {
    position?: string;
    updated?: number;
  } = {},
): SharedPage => ({
  id,
  name: field(name, updated),
  description: field(description, updated),
  viewBackgroundColor: field(viewBackgroundColor, updated),
  position: field(position, updated),
});

const data = (
  pages: SharedPage[],
  deletedPageIds: Record<string, number> = {},
): SharedPageData => ({ pages, deletedPageIds });

const info = (id: string, name = id): SharedPageInfo => ({
  id,
  name,
  description: "",
  viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
});

const merge = (a: SharedPageData, b: SharedPageData) =>
  mergePageData(a, b, BASE_NAME);

/** merging in both orders gives the same result: returns it */
const mergeBothWays = (a: SharedPageData, b: SharedPageData) => {
  const ab = merge(a, b);
  expect(isSamePageData(ab, merge(b, a))).toBe(true);
  return ab;
};

const names = (pageData: SharedPageData) =>
  pageData.pages.map((p) => p.name.value);

const ids = (pageData: SharedPageData) => pageData.pages.map((p) => p.id);

describe("page data (#167)", () => {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe("AC 4.5: simultaneous changes to one page", () => {
    it.each(["name", "description", "viewBackgroundColor"] as const)(
      "the later %s change wins, in any order",
      (key) => {
        const older = data([page("p1", { [key]: "older", updated: 10 })]);
        const newer = data([page("p1", { [key]: "newer", updated: 20 })]);

        const merged = mergeBothWays(older, newer);

        expect(merged.pages[0][key].value).toBe("newer");
      },
    );

    it("the later position change wins, in any order", () => {
      const a = data([
        page("p1", { position: "a0" }),
        page("p2", { position: "a1", updated: 10 }),
      ]);
      const b = data([
        page("p1", { position: "a0" }),
        page("p2", { position: "Zz", updated: 20 }),
      ]);

      expect(ids(mergeBothWays(a, b))).toEqual(["p2", "p1"]);
    });

    it("same time: both clients pick the same value", () => {
      const a = data([page("p1", { name: "Alpha", updated: 10 })]);
      const b = data([page("p1", { name: "Beta", updated: 10 })]);

      expect(names(mergeBothWays(a, b))).toEqual(["Beta"]);
    });

    it("changes to different fields of one page both survive", () => {
      const base = page("p1", { updated: 1 });
      const renamed = data([{ ...base, name: field("Renamed", 10) }]);
      const recoloured = data([
        { ...base, viewBackgroundColor: field("#000000", 11) },
      ]);

      const merged = mergeBothWays(renamed, recoloured).pages[0];

      expect(merged.name.value).toBe("Renamed");
      expect(merged.viewBackgroundColor.value).toBe("#000000");
    });

    it("pages with the same position are ordered by page id", () => {
      expect(
        ids(
          merge(
            data([page("b", { position: "a0" })]),
            data([page("a", { position: "a0" })]),
          ),
        ),
      ).toEqual(["a", "b"]);
    });

    it("a page only one side has is kept", () => {
      expect(
        ids(
          mergeBothWays(
            data([page("p1", { position: "a0" })]),
            data([page("p2", { position: "a1" })]),
          ),
        ),
      ).toEqual(["p1", "p2"]);
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe("AC 4.2: delete wins", () => {
    it("a deleted page stays deleted, even if edited later", () => {
      const deleted = data([page("p2")], { p1: 10 });
      const editedLater = data([
        page("p1", { name: "Edited", updated: 99 }),
        page("p2"),
      ]);

      const merged = mergeBothWays(deleted, editedLater);

      expect(ids(merged)).toEqual(["p2"]);
      expect(merged.deletedPageIds).toEqual({ p1: 10 });
    });

    it("keeps every deletion it hears of", () => {
      const merged = mergeBothWays(
        data([page("p3")], { p1: 10 }),
        data([page("p3")], { p2: 20 }),
      );
      expect(merged.deletedPageIds).toEqual({ p1: 10, p2: 20 });
    });
  });

  describe("AC 4.3: deleting every page", () => {
    it("concurrent deletions of every page leave the same blank page everywhere", () => {
      // A deleted p1 (keeping p2), B deleted p2 (keeping p1)
      const merged = mergeBothWays(
        data([page("p2")], { p1: 10 }),
        data([page("p1")], { p2: 20 }),
      );

      expect(merged.pages).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(names(merged)).toEqual(["Page 1"]);
      expect(merged.pages[0].id).not.toMatch(/^p[12]$/);
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe("AC 4.4: duplicate names", () => {
    it("the page with the later name change becomes the next free Page N", () => {
      // both renamed to "Plan" before hearing of each other
      const a = data([
        page("p1", { name: "Plan", updated: 10, position: "a0" }),
        page("p2", { name: "Page 1", updated: 1, position: "a1" }),
      ]);
      const b = data([
        page("p1", { name: "Page 3", updated: 1, position: "a0" }),
        page("p2", { name: "Plan", updated: 20, position: "a1" }),
      ]);

      // p2's rename was later → renamed. "Page 1" is free again (p2 was
      // "Page 1" before), so that's the next free default name
      expect(names(mergeBothWays(a, b))).toEqual(["Plan", "Page 1"]);
    });

    it("compares names trimmed and case-insensitively", () => {
      const merged = merge(
        data([page("p1", { name: "plan", updated: 10, position: "a0" })]),
        data([page("p2", { name: " Plan ", updated: 20, position: "a1" })]),
      );
      expect(names(merged)).toEqual(["plan", "Page 1"]);
    });

    it("same time: the larger page id is renamed", () => {
      const merged = mergeBothWays(
        data([page("b", { name: "Plan", updated: 10, position: "a0" })]),
        data([page("a", { name: "Plan", updated: 10, position: "a1" })]),
      );
      expect(merged.pages.map((p) => [p.id, p.name.value]).sort()).toEqual([
        ["a", "Plan"],
        ["b", "Page 1"],
      ]);
    });

    it("skips default names that are taken", () => {
      const merged = resolvePageNameCollisions(
        data([
          page("p1", { name: "Page 1", position: "a0" }),
          page("p2", { name: "Plan", updated: 5, position: "a1" }),
          page("p3", { name: "Plan", updated: 6, position: "a2" }),
        ]),
        BASE_NAME,
      );
      expect(names(merged)).toEqual(["Page 1", "Plan", "Page 2"]);
    });

    it("the renamed name is a newer change, so it spreads like any rename", () => {
      const merged = merge(
        data([page("p1", { name: "Plan", updated: 10, position: "a0" })]),
        data([page("p2", { name: "Plan", updated: 20, position: "a1" })]),
      );
      expect(merged.pages[1].name).toEqual({ value: "Page 1", updated: 21 });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe("local changes (AC 3.2, 3.3)", () => {
    const NOW = 100;
    const shared = data([
      page("p1", { position: "a0" }),
      page("p2", { position: "a1" }),
      page("p3", { position: "a2" }),
    ]);

    it("nothing shared changed → null", () => {
      expect(
        getLocalPageChanges(shared, [info("p1"), info("p2"), info("p3")], NOW),
      ).toBeNull();
    });

    it("a rename changes only that page's name, at the change time", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(
        shared,
        [info("p1"), info("p2", "Renamed"), info("p3")],
        NOW,
      )!;
      expect(changes.pages[1].name).toEqual({ value: "Renamed", updated: NOW });
      expect(changes.pages[1].description).toEqual(shared.pages[1].description);
      expect(changes.pages[0]).toEqual(shared.pages[0]);
    });

    it("a description or background change is recorded", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(
        shared,
        [
          { ...info("p1"), description: "About" },
          info("p2"),
          { ...info("p3"), viewBackgroundColor: "#000000" },
        ],
        NOW,
      )!;
      expect(changes.pages[0].description).toEqual(field("About", NOW));
      expect(changes.pages[2].viewBackgroundColor).toEqual(
        field("#000000", NOW),
      );
    });

    it("a new page is recorded with every field, after its neighbour", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(
        shared,
        [info("p1"), info("p2"), info("p3"), info("p4")],
        NOW,
      )!;
      expect(ids(changes)).toEqual(["p1", "p2", "p3", "p4"]);
      expect(changes.pages[3].name).toEqual(field("p4", NOW));
      expect(changes.pages[3].position.updated).toBe(NOW);
    });

    it("a removed page is recorded as deleted", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(
        shared,
        [info("p1"), info("p3")],
        NOW,
      )!;
      expect(ids(changes)).toEqual(["p1", "p3"]);
      expect(changes.deletedPageIds).toEqual({ p2: NOW });
    });

    it("moving one page gives only that page a new position", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(
        shared,
        [info("p3"), info("p1"), info("p2")],
        NOW,
      )!;
      expect(ids(changes)).toEqual(["p3", "p1", "p2"]);
      expect(changes.pages.map((p) => p.position.updated)).toEqual([NOW, 1, 1]);
    });

    it("moves of different pages by two clients both survive", () => {
      const four = data([
        page("p1", { position: "a0" }),
        page("p2", { position: "a1" }),
        page("p3", { position: "a2" }),
        page("p4", { position: "a3" }),
      ]);
      // A moves p1 after p2, B moves p4 before p3
      const a = getLocalPageChanges(
        four,
        [info("p2"), info("p1"), info("p3"), info("p4")],
        NOW,
      )!;
      const b = getLocalPageChanges(
        four,
        [info("p1"), info("p2"), info("p4"), info("p3")],
        NOW + 1,
      )!;
      expect(ids(mergeBothWays(a, b))).toEqual(["p2", "p1", "p4", "p3"]);
    });

    it("deleting every page and adding a blank one puts it first", () => {
      // as App.deletePages does: every page gone, one new page left
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(shared, [info("blank")], NOW)!;
      // a page someone else added meanwhile, after the old pages
      const merged = merge(
        changes,
        data([page("other", { position: "a3", updated: 50 })]),
      );
      expect(ids(merged)).toEqual(["blank", "other"]);
    });

    it("never includes personal settings", () => {
      const changes = getLocalPageChanges(EMPTY_PAGE_DATA, [info("p1")], NOW)!;
      expect(Object.keys(changes.pages[0]).sort()).toEqual([
        "description",
        "id",
        "name",
        "position",
        "viewBackgroundColor",
      ]);
    });

    it("round-trips through what the editor shows", () => {
      const pages = [info("p1", "One"), info("p2", "Two")];
      expect(
        getSharedPageInfos(getLocalPageChanges(EMPTY_PAGE_DATA, pages, NOW)!),
      ).toEqual(pages);
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  describe("AC 5.1: bad page data", () => {
    const valid = data([page("p1"), page("p2", { position: "a1" })]);

    it("accepts valid page data, dropping unknown fields", () => {
      const parsed = parsePageData({
        ...valid,
        pages: valid.pages.map((p) => ({ ...p, scrollX: 5 })),
      });
      expect(parsed).toEqual(valid);
    });

    it.each([
      ["not an object", "nope"],
      ["no pages", { deletedPageIds: {} }],
      ["no live page", data([])],
      ["no deleted pages entry", { pages: valid.pages }],
      [
        "a duplicate page id",
        data([page("p1"), page("p1", { position: "a1" })]),
      ],
      ["a page without an id", data([{ ...page("p1"), id: "" }])],
      [
        "a page missing a field",
        data([{ ...page("p1"), description: undefined } as any]),
      ],
      [
        "a field without a change time",
        data([{ ...page("p1"), name: { value: "x" } } as any]),
      ],
      ["an empty name", data([page("p1", { name: "  " })])],
      [
        "a name over 50 characters",
        data([page("p1", { name: "x".repeat(51) })]),
      ],
      [
        "a description over 350 characters",
        data([page("p1", { description: "x".repeat(351) })]),
      ],
      ["an invalid position", data([page("p1", { position: "!!" })])],
      ["a deleted page without a time", data([page("p1")], { p2: "x" } as any)],
    ])("rejects %s", (_, value) => {
      expect(parsePageData(value)).toBeNull();
    });
  });
});
