```typescript
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // page data (#167): order, names, descriptions, backgrounds, deletions
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const ROOM = { roomId: "room-id", roomKey: "room-key-0000000000000" };

  /** room page data with every field changed at `updated` */
  const roomPageData = (
    pages: (Partial<SharedPageInfo> & { id: string })[],
    updated = 1,
  ) =>
    getLocalPageChanges(
      EMPTY_PAGE_DATA,
      pages.map((page) => ({
        name: page.id,
        description: "",
        viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
        ...page,
      })),
      updated,
    )!;

  const deliverPageData = (pageData: unknown) =>
    deliver({ type: WS_SUBTYPES.PAGE_DATA, payload: pageData as any });

  const getSentPageData = (): SharedPageData[] =>
    getSentMessages()
      .filter((message) => message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.PAGE_DATA)
      .map((message) => message.payload);

  const getLastSentPageInfos = () =>
    getSharedPageInfos(getSentPageData().at(-1)!);

  /** what the page list shows: [name, description, background] */
  const getPageInfos = () =>
    h.app
      .getPages()
      .map((page) => [
        page.name,
        page.description,
        page.settings.viewBackgroundColor,
      ]);

  /** joins ROOM by its link; the room's messages are delivered by the test */
  const joinRoom = async () => {
    act(() => {
      window.collab.startCollaboration(ROOM);
    });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mocks.handlers.has("client-broadcast")).toBe(true),
    );
  };

  /** joins ROOM while nobody else is online: the stored room is loaded */
  const joinRoomAlone = async () => {
    await joinRoom();
    await triggerServerEvent("first-in-room");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
    );
  };

  /** a peer's INIT (the room's elements), which completes joining */
  const deliverInit = async (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) => {
    await deliver({
      type: WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
      payload: {
        elements: syncInvalidIndices(elements.map((el) => ({ ...el }))) as any,
      },
    });
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
    );
  };

  /** the room every joining test joins: two pages, one element on each */
  const ARCHITECTURE = {
    id: "architecture",
    name: "Architecture",
    description: "Services",
    viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
  };
  const DATABASE = {
    id: "database",
    name: "Database",
    description: "Tables",
    viewBackgroundColor: "#ffec99",
  };
  const ROOM_PAGE_INFOS = [
    ["Architecture", "Services", "#ffffff"],
    ["Database", "Tables", "#ffec99"],
  ];
  const roomElements = () => [
    tag(createRect("box"), ARCHITECTURE.id),
    tag(createRect("table"), DATABASE.id),
  ];

  /** a local drawing that joining must replace */
  const setUpLocalDrawing = () => {
    drawOnOpenPage(createRect("mine"));
    addPage();
  };

  describe("AC 1.1: starting a room (page data)", () => {
    it("shares every page's order, name, description and background", async () => {
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      act(() => {
        h.app.updatePageInfo(firstPageId, {
          name: "Architecture",
          description: "Services",
          showThumbnail: true,
          grid: { gridModeEnabled: false, gridSnapEnabled: false, gridSize: 20 },
        });
      });
      addPage();
      act(() => {
        API.setAppState({ viewBackgroundColor: "#ffec99" });
      });

      await startNewRoom();

      expect(
        getSharedPageInfos(mocks.savedPageData[0] as SharedPageData),
      ).toEqual([
        {
          id: firstPageId,
          name: "Architecture",
          description: "Services",
          viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
        },
        {
          id: getPageIds()[1],
          name: "Page 2",
          description: "",
          viewBackgroundColor: "#ffec99",
        },
      ]);
    });

    it("sends the pages to a newcomer before the elements", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await triggerServerEvent("new-user", "peer-socket");

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getSentMessages().map((message) => message.type)).toEqual([
          WS_SUBTYPES.PAGE_DATA,
          WS_SUBTYPES.INIT,
          WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
        ]),
      );
    });
  });

  describe("AC 1.2: joining a room", () => {
    it("replaces the pages you had with the room's pages", async () => {
      setUpLocalDrawing();
      const localPageIds = getPageIds();

      await joinRoom();
      await deliverPageData(roomPageData([ARCHITECTURE, DATABASE]));
      await deliverInit(roomElements());

      expect(getPageInfos()).toEqual(ROOM_PAGE_INFOS);
      expect(getPageIds()).toEqual(["architecture", "database"]);
      expect(getPageIds()).not.toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(localPageIds));
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["box"], ["table"]]),
      );
    });

    it("keeps the room's pages as the local drawing after leaving", async () => {
      await joinRoom();
      await deliverPageData(roomPageData([ARCHITECTURE, DATABASE]));
      await deliverInit(roomElements());
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["box"], ["table"]]),
      );

      act(() => {
        window.collab.stopCollaboration(false);
      });

      expect(window.collab.isCollaborating()).toBe(false);
      expect(getPageInfos()).toEqual(ROOM_PAGE_INFOS);
      expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["box"], ["table"]]);
    });

    it("puts elements that arrive before their page on it once it arrives", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();

      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("early"), "late-page")]);
      expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([[]]);

      await deliverPageData(
        mergePageData(
          window.collab["pageData"]!,
          roomPageData([{ id: "late-page", name: "Late" }], Date.now()),
          "Page",
        ),
      );

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([[], ["early"]]),
      );
    });
  });

  describe("AC 1.3: room storage", () => {
    it("a user who joins while nobody is online gets every page", async () => {
      setUpLocalDrawing();
      mocks.storedPageData = roomPageData([ARCHITECTURE, DATABASE]);
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices(roomElements());

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["box"], ["table"]]),
      );
      expect(getPageInfos()).toEqual(ROOM_PAGE_INFOS);
      expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["box"]);
    });

    it("puts untagged stored elements on the first page, stamped once", async () => {
      mocks.storedPageData = roomPageData([ARCHITECTURE, DATABASE]);
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([
        createRect("stored-untagged"),
      ]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["stored-untagged"], []]),
      );
      expect(getElementPageId(h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0])).toBe(
        ARCHITECTURE.id,
      );
      // and the new stamp is sent to the room
      sync();
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getLastSent("stored-untagged")?.customData?.[PAGE_ID_KEY]).toBe(
          ARCHITECTURE.id,
        ),
      );
    });

    it("a room stored without pages starts from one blank page", async () => {
      setUpLocalDrawing();
      mocks.storedRoomElements = syncInvalidIndices([createRect("legacy")]);

      await joinRoomAlone();

      await waitFor(() => expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([["legacy"]]));
      expect(getPageInfos()).toEqual([["Page 1", "", "#ffffff"]]);
    });

    it("saves page changes with the room", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      act(() => {
        h.app.updatePageInfo(h.app.getActivePageId(), {
          name: "Renamed",
          description: "",
          showThumbnail: true,
          grid: { gridModeEnabled: false, gridSnapEnabled: false, gridSize: 20 },
        });
      });
      sync();
      act(() => {
        window.collab.queueSaveToFirebase.flush();
      });

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(
          getSharedPageInfos(
            mocks.savedPageData.at(-1) as SharedPageData,
          ).map((page) => page.name),
        ).toEqual(["Renamed"]),
      );
    });
  });

  describe("AC 3.2: shared page changes", () => {
    /** a room with two pages, the first open; returns their ids */
    const startRoomWithTwoPages = async () => {
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;
      return { firstPageId, secondPageId };
    };

    const changePageInfo = (
      pageId: string,
      patch: { name?: string; description?: string },
    ) => {
      const page = h.app.getPages().find((p) => p.id === pageId)!;
      act(() => {
        h.app.updatePageInfo(pageId, {
          name: patch.name ?? page.name,
          description: patch.description ?? page.description,
          showThumbnail: page.showThumbnail,
          grid: {
            gridModeEnabled: page.settings.gridModeEnabled,
            gridSnapEnabled: page.settings.gridSnapEnabled,
            gridSize: page.settings.gridSize,
          },
        });
      });
    };

    describe("sends", () => {
      it("a new page", async () => {
        await startRoomWithTwoPages();
        const pageId = addPage();
        sync();

        await waitFor(() =>
          expect(getLastSentPageInfos().map((page) => page.id)).toEqual([
            ...getPageIds().slice(0, 2),
            pageId,
          ]),
        );
      });

      it("a rename and a description", async () => {
        const { secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoPages();
        changePageInfo(secondPageId, {
          name: "Schema",
          description: "Tables",
        });
        sync();

        await waitFor(() =>
          expect(getLastSentPageInfos()[1]).toEqual({
            id: secondPageId,
            name: "Schema",
            description: "Tables",
            viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
          }),
        );
      });

      it("a reorder by drag", async () => {
        const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoPages();
        act(() => {
          (h.app as any).movePageNavItem(
            { type: "page", id: secondPageId },
            { type: "page", id: firstPageId },
            "before",
          );
        });
        sync();

        await waitFor(() =>
          expect(getLastSentPageInfos().map((page) => page.id)).toEqual([
            secondPageId,
            firstPageId,
          ]),
        );
      });

      it("a reorder by typed position", async () => {
        const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoPages();
        act(() => {
          h.app.movePageToPosition(firstPageId, "2");
        });
        sync();

        await waitFor(() =>
          expect(getLastSentPageInfos().map((page) => page.id)).toEqual([
            secondPageId,
            firstPageId,
          ]),
        );
      });

      it("the open page's background, for that page only", async () => {
        await startRoomWithTwoPages();
        act(() => {
          API.setAppState({ viewBackgroundColor: "#ffc9c9" });
        });
        sync();

        await waitFor(() =>
          expect(
            getLastSentPageInfos().map((page) => page.viewBackgroundColor),
          ).toEqual(["#ffc9c9", "#ffffff"]),
        );
      });
    });

    describe("applies a peer's", () => {
      /** our pages as page data, with `change` applied by a peer later */
      const peerChanges = (
        change: (
          pages: SharedPageInfo[],
        ) => (Partial<SharedPageInfo> & { id: string })[],
      ) => {
        const ours = window.collab["pageData"]!;
        // a peer's change: later than ours, positions taken from its order
        return getLocalPageChanges(
          ours,
          change(getSharedPageInfos(ours)) as SharedPageInfo[],
          Date.now() + 1000,
        )!;
      };

      it("new page, rename, description and background", async () => {
        const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoPages();

        await deliverPageData(
          peerChanges((pages) => [
            { ...pages[0], viewBackgroundColor: "#ffc9c9" },
            { ...pages[1], name: "Schema", description: "Tables" },
            {
              id: "peer-page",
              name: "UI flow",
              description: "",
              viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
            },
          ]),
        );

        expect(getPageIds()).toEqual([firstPageId, secondPageId, "peer-page"]);
        expect(getPageInfos()).toEqual([
          ["Page 1", "", "#ffc9c9"],
          ["Schema", "Tables", "#ffffff"],
          ["UI flow", "", "#ffffff"],
        ]);
        // the open page's background shows right away
        expect(h.state.viewBackgroundColor).toBe("#ffc9c9");
        // and switching pages is still ours alone (AC 3.1)
        expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(firstPageId);
      });

      it("reorder", async () => {
        const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoPages();

        await deliverPageData(peerChanges((pages) => [pages[1], pages[0]]));

        expect(getPageIds()).toEqual([secondPageId, firstPageId]);
      });

      it("change without echoing it back", async () => {
        await startRoomWithTwoPages();

        await deliverPageData(
          peerChanges((pages) => [{ ...pages[0], name: "Theirs" }, pages[1]]),
        );
        sync();

        expect(getSentPageData()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("AC 3.3: personal settings", () => {
    it("scroll, zoom, grid and thumbnail changes send nothing", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;
      const page = h.app.getPages()[0];

      act(() => {
        API.setAppState({
          scrollX: 100,
          scrollY: 200,
          zoom: { value: 2 as any },
        });
        h.app.updatePageInfo(page.id, {
          name: page.name,
          description: page.description,
          showThumbnail: false,
          grid: { gridModeEnabled: true, gridSnapEnabled: true, gridSize: 40 },
        });
      });
      sync();

      expect(getSentPageData()).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("page messages carry only the shared fields", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;
      addPage();
      sync();

      await waitFor(() => expect(getSentPageData()).not.toEqual([]));
      for (const pageData of getSentPageData()) {
        expect(Object.keys(pageData).sort()).toEqual([
          "deletedPageIds",
          "pages",
        ]);
        for (const page of pageData.pages) {
          expect(Object.keys(page).sort()).toEqual([
            "description",
            "id",
            "name",
            "position",
            "viewBackgroundColor",
          ]);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  describe("AC 4.2: delete wins (pages)", () => {
    it("sends a deleted page as deleted", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      sync();
      act(() => pageInternals().deletePages([secondPageId]));
      sync();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(
          Object.keys(getSentPageData().at(-1)!.deletedPageIds),
        ).toEqual([secondPageId]),
      );
    });

    it("a page a peer deleted never comes back from a late edit", async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      const secondPageId = addPage();
      selectPage(firstPageId);
      sync();
      const before = window.collab["pageData"]!;

      // a peer deletes the second page…
      await deliverPageData({
        pages: before.pages.filter((page) => page.id === firstPageId),
        deletedPageIds: { [secondPageId]: Date.now() + 1000 },
      });
      expect(getPageIds()).toEqual([firstPageId]);

      // …while another peer, who hadn't heard yet, renamed it later
      await deliverPageData(
        getLocalPageChanges(
          before,
          getSharedPageInfos(before).map((page) =>
            page.id === secondPageId ? { ...page, name: "Edited" } : page,
          ),
          Date.now() + 2000,
        ),
      );
      // and drew on it
      await deliverUpdate([tag(createRect("late"), secondPageId)]);

      expect(getPageIds()).toEqual([firstPageId]);
      expect(getPageElementIds()).toEqual([[]]);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 4.4 and 4.5: changes that cross in transit", () => {
    const renameOpenPage = (name: string) => {
      const page = h.app.getPages()[0];
      act(() => {
        h.app.updatePageInfo(page.id, {
          name,
          description: page.description,
          showThumbnail: page.showThumbnail,
          grid: { gridModeEnabled: false, gridSnapEnabled: false, gridSize: 20 },
        });
      });
      sync();
    };

    /** the room's page data before either change */
    const startCrossing = async () => {
      await startNewRoom();
      addPage();
      selectPage(getPageIds()[0]);
      sync();
      return window.collab["pageData"]!;
    };

    it("a later rename of the same page by a peer wins", async () => {
      const before = await startCrossing();
      renameOpenPage("Mine");

      await deliverPageData(
        getLocalPageChanges(
          before,
          getSharedPageInfos(before).map((page, i) =>
            i === 0 ? { ...page, name: "Theirs" } : page,
          ),
          Date.now() + 1000,
        ),
      );

      expect(h.app.getPages()[0].name).toBe("Theirs");
    });

    it("an earlier rename by a peer loses, and the peer gets ours", async () => {
      const before = await startCrossing();
      renameOpenPage("Mine");
      mocks.emitted.length = 0;

      await deliverPageData(
        getLocalPageChanges(
          before,
          getSharedPageInfos(before).map((page, i) =>
            i === 0 ? { ...page, name: "Theirs" } : page,
          ),
          1,
        ),
      );

      expect(h.app.getPages()[0].name).toBe("Mine");
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(getLastSentPageInfos()[0].name).toBe("Mine"),
      );
    });

    it("two pages renamed to the same name: the later one becomes Page N", async () => {
      const before = await startCrossing();
      renameOpenPage("Plan");

      // a peer renamed the second page to "plan" after our rename
      await deliverPageData(
        getLocalPageChanges(
          before,
          getSharedPageInfos(before).map((page, i) =>
            i === 1 ? { ...page, name: "plan" } : page,
          ),
          Date.now() + 1000,
        ),
      );

      // "Page 1" was the first page's old name, so it's free again
      expect(h.app.getPages().map((page) => page.name)).toEqual([
        "Plan",
        "Page 1",
      ]);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 5.1: bad page data from a peer", () => {
    const validPage = () => window.collab["pageData"]!.pages[0];

    it.each([
      [
        "a duplicate page id",
        () => ({ pages: [validPage(), validPage()], deletedPageIds: {} }),
      ],
      [
        "a page with missing fields",
        () => ({
          pages: [{ id: validPage().id, name: validPage().name }],
          deletedPageIds: {},
        }),
      ],
      [
        "an unknown, empty page id",
        () => ({ pages: [{ ...validPage(), id: "" }], deletedPageIds: {} }),
      ],
      ["no pages at all", () => ({ deletedPageIds: {} })],
    ])("ignores %s and leaves the pages unchanged", async (_, payload) => {
      await startNewRoom();
      addPage();
      sync();
      const pagesBefore = h.app.getPages();
      const pageDataBefore = window.collab["pageData"];

      await deliverPageData(payload());

      expect(h.app.getPages()).toEqual(pagesBefore);
      expect(window.collab["pageData"]).toBe(pageDataBefore);
    });
  });
});
```

Step 3 is done and passing; nothing is committed. I need your "Approved" before starting step 4.

**What works now:**

- **One new `PAGE_DATA` message.** It carries the page list, and for each page its id, name, description, background and position, each with its own change time. It also lists deleted pages, so "delete wins". It's sent:
  - when you change a page (create, rename, description, drag or typed reorder, background, delete);
  - to a newcomer, before INIT;
  - with the 20-second resync.
- **Room storage keeps the same data** in the room's Firebase document. It's stored as separate encrypted fields, so rooms saved before this still load.
- **Starting a room** shares your pages' order, names, descriptions and backgrounds.
- **Joining** replaces your pages with the room's, the same way joining replaces your canvas today. After leaving, the room's pages stay as your drawing.
- **Conflicts:** for each field of each page, the later change wins, so a rename and a background change to the same page both survive. A deleted page never comes back. If crossing renames leave two pages with the same name, the page renamed later becomes the next free "Page N". Every client ends with the same result whatever order messages arrive in, and the unit tests check that by merging both ways.
- **Moving one page only changes that page's position**, so two people moving different pages at the same time both keep their move.
- **Bad page data from a peer is ignored as a whole** and your pages stay unchanged. That covers duplicate ids, missing or invalid fields, no pages, and invalid deletions.
- **Elements that arrive before their page** are held until the page data arrives. This fixes known gap 1 from my last update.

**Decisions inside the spec you should know about:**

- **Two changes to the same field of the same page at exactly the same time can't be ordered by page id**, because it's the same page. For that case the larger value wins, which is still the same on every client.
- **If concurrent deletions leave no page at all**, every client builds the same blank page with the same id, so they still agree.
- **The "Page N" name follows each client's language.** With mixed languages, both clients still settle on the same name through the same-time rule above.

**Existing tests I changed:**

- **`collabVisibility` "introduces itself to newcomers"** (#80): the expected messages are now `PAGE_DATA, INIT, USER_IDENTITY`, because the spec adds the page message.
- **`collabNewcomer` AC-H** (#83): the step 2 load-time hook is gone. The fixture is now a real stored room with one page and Alice's element on it, and the test passes unchanged otherwise.
- **The `loadFromFirebase` mocks** now return `{ elements, pageData }`. Only collabVisibility needed this; the other mocks return `null`.
- **My step 2 storage tests** are rewritten to use real stored page data instead of the joiner's own pages.

```javascript
// Changed-line coverage: of the executable lines this branch adds (vs
// origin/master), how many ran. Usage: node diffcov.js <lcov.info> <repo>
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const { execSync } = require("child_process");

const [lcovPath, repo] = process.argv.slice(2);

// lcov: file -> Map(line -> hits)
const lcov = new Map();
let current = null;
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(lcovPath, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (line.startsWith("SF:")) {
    current = new Map();
    lcov.set(path.resolve(repo, line.slice(3)).toLowerCase(), current);
  } else if (line.startsWith("DA:") && current) {
    const [n, hits] = line.slice(3).split(",").map(Number);
    current.set(n, hits);
  }
}

const isSource = (file) =>
  /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(file) && !/(\.test\.|\/tests\/|\.snap$)/.test(file);

// added lines per modified file
const diff = execSync("git diff -U0 origin/master --", {
  cwd: repo,
  encoding: "utf8",
  maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
});
const added = new Map();
let file = null;
for (const line of diff.split("\n")) {
  if (line.startsWith("+++ ")) {
    file = line.startsWith("+++ b/") ? line.slice(6) : null;
  } else if (file && line.startsWith("@@")) {
    const m = /\+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))?/.exec(line);
    const start = Number(m[1]);
    const count = m[2] === undefined ? 1 : Number(m[2]);
    const set = added.get(file) ?? new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) set.add(start + i);
    added.set(file, set);
  }
}

// new (untracked) source files: every line counts
const untracked = execSync("git ls-files --others --exclude-standard", {
  cwd: repo,
  encoding: "utf8",
})
  .split("\n")
  .filter((f) => f && isSource(f));

const rows = [];
const measure = (file, lines) => {
  const hits = lcov.get(path.resolve(repo, file).toLowerCase());
  let executable = 0;
  let covered = 0;
  const missed = [];
  for (const n of lines) {
    if (hits?.has(n)) {
      executable++;
      if (hits.get(n) > 0) covered++;
      else missed.push(n);
    }
  }
  rows.push({ file, executable, covered, missed, loaded: !!hits });
};
for (const [f, lines] of added) if (isSource(f)) measure(f, lines);
for (const f of untracked) {
  const count = fs.readFileSync(path.join(repo, f), "utf8").split("\n").length;
  measure(
    f,
    Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i + 1),
  );
}

let totalE = 0;
let totalC = 0;
for (const r of rows.sort((a, b) => a.file.localeCompare(b.file))) {
  totalE += r.executable;
  totalC += r.covered;
  const pct = r.executable
    ? ((100 * r.covered) / r.executable).toFixed(1)
    : "-";
  console.log(
    `${r.file}\t${r.covered}/${r.executable}\t${pct}%${
      r.loaded ? "" : "\t(not loaded by these tests)"
    }${r.missed.length ? `\tmissed: ${r.missed.join(",")}` : ""}`,
  );
}
console.log(
  `TOTAL\t${totalC}/${totalE}\t${((100 * totalC) / totalE).toFixed(1)}%`,
);
```

For steps 0–3, the #167 tests cover **95%** of the new code that can actually run in these tests. Overall it's **85.6%** of every line this branch adds; the difference is mostly the Firebase storage code, which every collab test replaces with a mock. Step 0 was only reading and setup, so all of this is steps 1–3.

I measured it with Vitest's v8 coverage, running only the five #167 test files (125 tests). That shows what our tests cover, not what the rest of the suite happens to touch.

| -------------- | ----- | -------- | --------- |
| `pageStamp.ts` | 100%  | 100%     | 100%      |
| `pageSync.ts`  | 97.7% | 98.6%    | 96%       |

### Changed lines in modified files

These count only the lines this branch adds, so each big file is judged on its own changes.

| Scope | Covered | % |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Without `types.ts` (type declarations, no runtime code) | 1198 / 1384 | 86.6% |

**100% of the changed lines** in these files: App.tsx (163 lines), ownership.ts, pages.ts, Renderer.ts, visibility.ts, groups.ts, actionExport.tsx, appState.ts, Portal.tsx, app_constants.ts, and `excalidraw-app/data/index.ts`.

### What isn't covered

1. **`firebase.ts`: 0/125 lines.** This is the biggest gap. Every collab test mocks Firebase, as before #167, so the real code that encrypts page data, merges it inside the save transaction and loads it never runs. The merge it calls is unit-tested, but the Firebase code itself isn't. It's on the two-browser checklist, and I could add a unit test with a fake Firestore if you want it covered automatically.
2. **Collab.tsx: 90% (371/412).** The uncovered parts are:

   - the branch that runs after a successful save, because the mocked save returns `null`;
   - the expired-deletion step on the stored scene;
   - the before-unload save;
   - the throttled image loading.

   A few lines reported here are comments, so v8's line mapping for TSX is slightly imprecise.

3. **pageSync.ts: 12 lines.** This is the fallback that renumbers every page when two pages share a position key and a page is moved between them. It's a real path and easy to test; I just haven't yet.
4. **`packages/excalidraw/data/index.ts`: 0/8.** Passing `openPageId` into image export (PNG/SVG of the scene) has no test.

**How the numbers were counted:**

- Vitest runs two workspace projects, so each file appeared twice in the report. My first count showed 0%; I fixed the script to add hits from both copies.

```text
  scope?: "canvas" | "allPages";
} | null>({

  trackEvent: { category: "canvas" },
```

```text
export const serializeAsJSON = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Partial<AppState>,
  files: BinaryFiles,
  type: "local" | "database",
): string => {
  const allElements = appState.pages
    ? appState.pages.flatMap((page) => page.elements)
    : elements;
  const data: ExportedDataState = {
    type: EXPORT_DATA_TYPES.excalidraw,
    version: VERSIONS.excalidraw,
    source: getExportSource(),
    elements,
    appState:
      type === "local"
        ? cleanAppStateForExport(appState)
        : clearAppStateForDatabase(appState),
    files:
      type === "local"
        ? filterOutDeletedFiles(allElements, files)
        : // will be stripped from JSON
          undefined,
  };

  // embed only the uploaded fonts the scene's text uses (#140); custom fonts
  // aren't synced through the database (collaboration is out of scope)
  if (type === "local") {
    const customFonts = Fonts.getCustomFontsUsedBy(allElements);
    if (customFonts.length) {
      data.customFonts = customFonts;
    }
  }

  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
};
```

```typescript
  // AC 4.6: clearing reaches collaborators like any other change
  describe("clearPages", () => {
    it("marks a page's elements deleted instead of dropping them", async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      API.setElements([createSolidRect("on-first", 0)]);
      const before = h.elements[0];
      act(() => pageInternals().createPage());

      act(() => h.app.clearPages([firstPageId]));

      const [cleared] = h.app.getPages()[0].elements;
      expect(cleared.id).toBe("on-first");
      expect(cleared.isDeleted).toBe(true);
      // a new version, so the deletion is sent
      expect(cleared.version).toBeGreaterThan(before.version);
    });

    it("leaves already deleted elements as they are", async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
      API.setElements([
        newElementWith(createSolidRect("gone", 0), { isDeleted: true }),
      ]);
      const before = h.elements[0];
      act(() => pageInternals().createPage());

      act(() => h.app.clearPages([firstPageId]));

      expect(h.app.getPages()[0].elements[0]).toBe(before);
    });
  });

  // AC 4.1: a collaborator deletes the page you're on
  describe("the open page deleted by a collaborator", () => {
    const shared = (id: string) => ({
      id,
      name: `Name of ${id}`,
      description: "",
      viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
    });

    const setUpOnSecondPage = async () => {
      await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
      act(() => {
        h.app.applySharedPages([shared("p1"), shared("p2"), shared("p3")]);
      });
      act(() => pageInternals().selectPage("p2"));
    };

    const deleteSecondPage = (deletedPageIds = ["p2"]) => {
      act(() => {
        h.app.applySharedPages([shared("p1"), shared("p3")], deletedPageIds);
      });
    };

    it("moves you to the page before it and names it in a toast", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();

      deleteSecondPage();

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe("p1");
      expect(h.state.toast?.message).toBe(
        '"Name of p2" was deleted by a collaborator.',
      );
    });

    it("no toast when your page is replaced, not deleted (joining a room)", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();

      deleteSecondPage([]);

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe("p1");
      expect(h.state.toast).toBeNull();
    });

    it("no toast when another page is deleted", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();

      act(() => {
        h.app.applySharedPages([shared("p1"), shared("p2")], ["p3"]);
      });

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe("p2");
      expect(h.state.toast).toBeNull();
    });

    it("discards an element being drawn (pointer still down)", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();
      UI.clickTool("rectangle");
      mouse.downAt(10, 10);
      mouse.moveTo(60, 60);
      expect(h.state.newElement).not.toBeNull();

      deleteSecondPage();
      // the user keeps dragging, then lets go
      mouse.moveTo(90, 90);
      mouse.upAt(90, 90);

      expect(h.state.newElement).toBeNull();
      expect(
        h.app.getPages().flatMap((page) =>
          page.elements.filter((el) => !el.isDeleted).map((el) => el.type),
        ),
      ).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("closes the page info dialog of a removed page", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();
      act(() => h.app.openPageInfo("p3"));
      expect(h.state.openDialog).toEqual({ name: "pageInfo", pageId: "p3" });

      act(() => {
        h.app.applySharedPages([shared("p1"), shared("p2")], ["p3"]);
      });

      expect(h.state.openDialog).toBeNull();
    });

    it("drops a removed page from the clearing selection", async () => {
      await setUpOnSecondPage();
      act(() => {
        API.setAppState({ pageClearingSelection: ["p1", "p3"] });
      });

      act(() => {
        h.app.applySharedPages([shared("p1"), shared("p2")], ["p3"]);
      });

      expect(h.state.pageClearingSelection).toEqual(["p1"]);
    });
  });
});
```

```
  describe("AC 4.6: clearing", () => {
    /**
     * What Collab hands to Portal to send that Portal hasn't sent yet.
     * (Checked before Portal's own filter: in tests every element's
     * `updated` is 1, so a deletion always looks a day old and Portal's
     * existing expiry filter drops it. Live clients use the real clock.)
     */
    const spyOnUnsent = () => {
      const { portal } = window.collab;
      const sent = new Map(portal.broadcastedElementVersions);
      const handedOver: ExcalidrawElement[] = [];
      const spy = vi
        .spyOn(portal, "broadcastScene")
        .mockImplementation(async (_type, elements) => {
          handedOver.push(...elements);
        });
      return {
        unsent: (id: string) =>
          handedOver
            .filter((el) => el.id === id)
            .filter((el) => el.version > (sent.get(el.id) ?? -1))
            .at(-1),
        restore: () => spy.mockRestore(),
      };
    };

    it("clearing a page that isn't open sends its elements as deleted", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = await startRoomWithTwoDrawnPages();
      const { unsent } = spyOnUnsent();

      act(() => h.app.clearPages([secondPageId]));
      sync();

      expect(unsent("on-second")?.isDeleted).toBe(true);
      expect(unsent("on-first")).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it("'Clear canvas and all pages' sends every page's elements as deleted", async () => {
      await startRoomWithTwoDrawnPages();
      const { unsent } = spyOnUnsent();

      act(() => {
        h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionClearCanvas, "api", {
          scope: "allPages",
        });
      });
      sync();

      expect(unsent("on-first")?.isDeleted).toBe(true);
      expect(unsent("on-second")?.isDeleted).toBe(true);
    });
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-25 22:34:51Z)**_

Step 4 is done and passing; nothing is committed. I need your "Approved" before starting step 5.

**What works now:**

- **AC 4.1, deleting a page someone is on:**
  - Deleting a page sends it as deleted, and its elements go with it for everyone.
  - If a collaborator deletes the page you're on, you're moved to the page before it (or the next one if it was first), and a toast says `"Page 2" was deleted by a collaborator.`
  - An element you're drawing at that moment is discarded at once and never shows up on any page, even if you keep dragging.
  - A page info dialog open for a removed page closes, and removed pages drop out of the clearing selection.
  - Joining a room doesn't show the toast: your old pages are replaced there, not deleted.
- **AC 4.2, delete wins:** late edits to a deleted page's elements are discarded. Room storage also drops a deleted page's elements, so they stop counting toward the room's size limit.
- **AC 4.3, deleting every page:** this leaves one new blank page, first in the list, and every collaborator gets that same page.
- **AC 4.6, clearing:** `clearPages` now marks elements deleted instead of emptying the page, so clearing an inactive page and "Clear canvas and all pages" both reach collaborators. Previews already skip deleted elements, so they look the same as before.
- **AC 5.2, reconnecting:** when the socket reconnects, the client loads the stored room, picking up pages and elements others changed while it was offline. It then sends its own page data and a full resync, so its offline changes go out too.

**A third bug the tests caught: the "already sent" check.**

- That check compared a sum of element versions. When a deleted page's elements went away and a new element was drawn, the sum could come out exactly the same, so the new element was never sent.
- My first fix (`!==` instead of `>`) wasn't enough. It's now a hash of every element's `versionNonce`, using Excalidraw's existing `hashElementsVersion`, which changes with any edit, addition or removal.
- This changes upstream Excalidraw code, not a merged course issue, so I'm flagging it.
- Portal now also skips sending an empty update.
- A unit test shows the old sum giving the same total for different content, and two tests fail if the sum is put back.

**Existing test I changed:** #159's "Clear canvas and all pages" (`pages.test.tsx`). After switching to a cleared page it expected the element list to be empty; the cleared page now keeps its deleted copies, as the spec requires. It now checks that no _live_ elements remain, using the test's own `liveIds()` helper, so it still proves the page was cleared.

**A test-environment limit:** in tests every element's `updated` timestamp is 1, so Portal's existing expiry filter treats every deletion as a day old and drops it. The two clearing tests therefore check what Collab hands to Portal (deleted copies newer than what was last sent), not the final socket payload. Real clients use the real clock. This belongs on the two-browser checklist.

```text
import clsx from "clsx";
import React, { useState } from "react";

import { getNameInitial } from "../clients";

import "./Avatar.scss";

type AvatarProps = {
  onClick: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void;
  color: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  className?: string;
};

export const Avatar = ({
  color,
  onClick,
  name,
  src,
  className,
}: AvatarProps) => {
  const shortName = getNameInitial(name);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const loadImg = !error && src;
  const style = loadImg ? undefined : { background: color };
  return (
    <div className={clsx("Avatar", className)} style={style} onClick={onClick}>
      {loadImg ? (
        <img
          className="Avatar-img"
          src={src}
          alt={shortName}
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          onError={() => setError(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        shortName
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

```text
export const getClientColor = (
  socketId: SocketId,
  collaborator: Collaborator | undefined,
) => {
  // to get more even distribution in case `id` is not uniformly distributed to
  // begin with, we hash it
  const hash = Math.abs(hashToInteger(collaborator?.id || socketId));
  // we want to get a multiple of 10 number in the range of 0-360 (in other
  // words a hue value of step size 10). There are 37 such values including 0.
  const hue = (hash % 37) * 10;
  const saturation = 100;
  const lightness = 83;

  return `hsl(${hue}, ${saturation}%, ${lightness}%)`;
};
```

```typescript
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // presence and follow mode (step 5)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const ALICE = "alice-socket" as SocketId;
  const BOB = "bob-socket" as SocketId;

  /** a peer tells the room which page it's on */
  const deliverPresence = (socketId: SocketId, pageId?: string) =>
    deliver({
      type: WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY,
      payload: {
        socketId,
        clientId: `${socketId}-client`,
        username: socketId,
        ...(pageId ? { pageId } : {}),
      },
    });

  const getCollaboratorPage = (socketId: SocketId) =>
    h.state.collaborators.get(socketId)?.pageId;

  /** a room with two pages, the first open; returns their ids */
  const startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages = async () => {
    const firstPageId = h.app.getActivePageId();
    const secondPageId = addPage();
    selectPage(firstPageId);
    await startNewRoom();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    return { firstPageId, secondPageId };
  };

  const getSentVolatile = () =>
    mocks.emitted
      .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER_VOLATILE)
      .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)));

  describe("AC 3.1 / 6: our page in presence messages", () => {
    it("pointer, idle and identity messages carry the page we're on", async () => {
      const { firstPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();

      await act(async () => {
        await window.collab.portal.broadcastMouseLocation({
          pointer: { x: 0, y: 0, tool: "pointer" },
          button: "up",
        });
        await window.collab.portal.broadcastIdleChange("active" as any);
        await window.collab.portal.broadcastUserIdentity();
      });

      expect(
        [...getSentVolatile(), ...getSentMessages()].map((message) => [
          message.type,
          message.payload.pageId,
        ]),
      ).toEqual([
        [WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION, firstPageId],
        [WS_SUBTYPES.IDLE_STATUS, firstPageId],
        [WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY, firstPageId],
      ]);
    });

    it("switching pages tells the room once, without changing anything else", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();

      selectPage(secondPageId);
      sync();
      sync();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(
          getSentMessages().map((message) => [
            message.type,
            message.payload.pageId,
          ]),
        ).toEqual([[WS_SUBTYPES.USER_IDENTITY, secondPageId]]),
      );
      // nothing that would move anyone else: no page data, no elements
      expect(getSentPageData()).toEqual([]);
      expect(getSentElements()).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("a peer switching pages never changes our page", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, firstPageId);
      await deliverPresence(ALICE, secondPageId);

      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe(secondPageId);
      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(firstPageId);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 6.2: who is on which page", () => {
    it("follows peers across pages and forgets them when they leave", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();
      await triggerServerEvent("room-user-change", ["my-socket", ALICE, BOB]);

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, firstPageId);
      await deliverPresence(BOB, secondPageId);
      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe(firstPageId);
      expect(getCollaboratorPage(BOB)).toBe(secondPageId);

      // alice switches
      await deliverPresence(ALICE, secondPageId);
      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe(secondPageId);

      // bob leaves
      await triggerServerEvent("room-user-change", ["my-socket", ALICE]);
      expect(h.state.collaborators.has(BOB)).toBe(false);
    });

    it("a pointer update keeps the page it carries", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();

      await deliver({
        type: WS_SUBTYPES.MOUSE_LOCATION,
        payload: {
          socketId: ALICE,
          pointer: { x: 1, y: 1, tool: "pointer" },
          button: "up",
          selectedElementIds: {},
          username: "Alice",
          pageId: secondPageId,
        },
      });

      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe(secondPageId);
    });

    it("a message without a page (older client) keeps the page we knew", async () => {
      const { secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, secondPageId);
      await deliverPresence(ALICE);

      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe(secondPageId);
    });
  });

  describe("AC 6.3: follow mode", () => {
    const follow = (socketId: SocketId) => {
      act(() => {
        API.setAppState({
          userToFollow: { socketId, username: socketId },
        });
      });
    };

    it("when the followed collaborator switches pages, we switch too", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();
      await deliverPresence(ALICE, firstPageId);
      follow(ALICE);

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, secondPageId);

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(secondPageId);
    });

    it("(control) without following, we stay", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();
      await deliverPresence(ALICE, firstPageId);

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, secondPageId);

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(firstPageId);
    });

    it("others switching pages don't move us", async () => {
      const { firstPageId, secondPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();
      follow(ALICE);

      await deliverPresence(BOB, secondPageId);

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(firstPageId);
    });

    it("a page we don't have is ignored (unknown page id)", async () => {
      const { firstPageId } = await startRoomOnFirstOfTwoPages();
      follow(ALICE);

      await deliverPresence(ALICE, "unknown-page");

      expect(h.app.getActivePageId()).toBe(firstPageId);
      expect(getCollaboratorPage(ALICE)).toBe("unknown-page");
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
      expect(isCollaboratorOnPage({ pageId: "p2" }, "p1")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("a collaborator whose page isn't known shows everywhere (older clients)", () => {
      expect(isCollaboratorOnPage({}, "p1")).toBe(true);
    });

    it("outside a room (no open page) everyone shows", () => {
      expect(isCollaboratorOnPage({ pageId: "p2" }, null)).toBe(true);
    });

  /** two shared pages p1, p2; p1 open; three collaborators */
  const setUpCollaborators = async () => {
    const renderSpy = vi.spyOn(InteractiveScene, "renderInteractiveScene");
    const rendered = await render(<Excalidraw isCollaborating={true} />);
    act(() => {
      h.app.applySharedPages(
        ["p1", "p2"].map((id) => ({
          id,
          name: id === "p1" ? "Page 1" : "Page 2",
          description: "",
          viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
        })),
      );
    });
    const collaborator = (
      username: string,
      pageId: string | undefined,
      extra: Partial<Collaborator> = {},
    ): Collaborator => ({
      username,
      pointer: { x: 10, y: 10, tool: "pointer" },
      selectedElementIds: { [`${username}-selection`]: true },
      ...(pageId ? { pageId } : {}),
      ...extra,
    });
    const setCollaborators = (
      entries: [string, Collaborator][],
    ) => {
      act(() => {
        API.updateScene({
          collaborators: new Map(
            entries.map(([socketId, c]) => [socketId as SocketId, c]),
          ),
        });
      });
    };
    setCollaborators([
      ["alice", collaborator("alice", "p1")],
      ["bob", collaborator("bob", "p2")],
      ["carol", collaborator("carol", undefined)],
    ]);
    const lastRenderConfig = () =>
      (renderSpy.mock.calls.at(-1)![0] as any).renderConfig;
    return { ...rendered, collaborator, setCollaborators, lastRenderConfig };
  };

  // AC 6.1
  describe("collaborators on other pages", () => {

      vi.restoreAllMocks();
    });

    it("their cursors and selections aren't drawn", async () => {
      const { lastRenderConfig } = await setUpCollaborators();

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect([
          ...lastRenderConfig().remotePointerViewportCoords.keys(),
        ]).toEqual(["alice", "carol"]),
      );
      expect([...lastRenderConfig().remoteSelectedElementIds.keys()]).toEqual(
        ["alice-selection", "carol-selection"],

    });

      await waitFor(() =>

          ...lastRenderConfig().remotePointerViewportCoords.keys(),
        ]).toEqual(["bob", "carol"]),

        .toEqual(["alice", "carol"]);
    });

    it("(control) outside a room everyone is drawn", async () => {

      act(() => {

          collaborators: new Map([

        ]).toEqual(["bob"]),

  // AC 6.2
  describe("avatars on page tabs", () => {
    const openPages = (getByRole: (role: string, o: any) => HTMLElement) => {
      fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Pages" }));
    };

    const getTabGroupLabel = (
      getByRole: (role: string, o: any) => HTMLElement,
      pageName: string,
    ) =>
      getByRole("button", { name: pageName })
        .querySelector(".page-navigation__collaborators")
        ?.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? null;

    it("each tab shows who is on that page", async () => {
      const { getByRole } = await setUpCollaborators();
      openPages(getByRole);

      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 1")).toBe(
        "On this page: alice",
      );
      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 2")).toBe("On this page: bob");
    });

    it("updates when someone switches pages or leaves", async () => {
      const { getByRole, collaborator, setCollaborators } =
        await setUpCollaborators();
      openPages(getByRole);

      setCollaborators([
        ["alice", collaborator("alice", "p2")],
        ["bob", collaborator("bob", "p2")],
      ]);
      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 1")).toBeNull();
      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 2")).toBe(
        "On this page: alice, bob",
      );

      // bob leaves
      setCollaborators([["alice", collaborator("alice", "p2")]]);
      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 2")).toBe(
        "On this page: alice",
      );
    });

    it("never shows you, nor collaborators on a page we don't have", async () => {
      const { getByRole, collaborator, setCollaborators } =
        await setUpCollaborators();
      openPages(getByRole);

      setCollaborators([
        ["me", collaborator("me", "p1", { isCurrentUser: true })],
        ["dave", collaborator("dave", "unknown-page")],
      ]);

      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 1")).toBeNull();
      expect(getTabGroupLabel(getByRole, "Page 2")).toBeNull();
    });

    it("shows three avatars, then +N", async () => {
      const { getByRole, collaborator, setCollaborators } =
        await setUpCollaborators();
      openPages(getByRole);

      setCollaborators(
        ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"].map((name) => [
          name,
          collaborator(name, "p2"),
        ]),
      );

      const group = getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2" }).querySelector(
        ".page-navigation__collaborators",
      )!;
      expect(group.querySelectorAll(".page-navigation__avatar")).toHaveLength(
        3,
      );
      expect(group.textContent).toContain("+2");
    });
  });
});
```

Step 5 is done, and all steps 1–5 are now in place. Below are the step 5 summary, the coverage check, and the test-by-test review of steps 3–5 you asked for. Nothing is committed yet.

## Step 5: presence and follow mode

**What works now:**

- **AC 3.1 and 6.x, our page in presence messages:** pointer, idle and identity messages carry the sender's page. Switching pages sends one non-volatile identity message, and nothing else: no page data and no elements, so it can't move anyone.
- **AC 6.1, other pages' cursors:** cursors, selections and laser trails of collaborators on another page aren't drawn, and they come back once you're on the same page. A collaborator whose client doesn't send a page (an older client) still shows everywhere, as before.
- **AC 6.2, presence on tabs:** each page tab shows the avatars of the collaborators on it (up to 3, then "+N"). It updates when someone switches or leaves. You never appear on a tab yourself.
- **AC 6.3, follow mode:** when the person you follow switches pages, you switch too. A page id we don't have is ignored: it shows on no tab and nobody gets moved to it. That's the "unknown page id" reading we agreed for AC 5.1.

**Tests:** 21 new (10 multi-client, 11 editor). I broke the code on purpose six ways and every break was caught:

| Break                             | Tests that failed |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Canvas draws everyone             | 2                 |
| Laser trails for everyone         | 1                 |
| Your own avatar shown on a tab    | 1                 |
| Follow mode ignores page switches | 1                 |
| Page switches not announced       | 1                 |
| Received page ids dropped         | 6                 |

One test was too weak at first: "a message without a page keeps the page we knew" could pass before the message was applied. It now waits for the message to land before checking. The full suite passes apart from the same 3 known Windows font snapshots, and typecheck, ESLint and Prettier are clean.

**One question:** when you _start_ following someone who is on another page, should you jump to their page right away? The spec only covers "when they switch pages", so right now you stay where you are until they switch. Your view then uses their viewport position, but on your own page.

```javascript
// Prints "start-end<TAB>describe > test name" for every it()/it.each() in a
// file, by matching parentheses from the it( line. Usage: node testranges.js f
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], "utf8").split(/\r?\n/);
const describes = [];
for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
  const line = lines[i];
  const d = /^(\s*)describe\(\s*["'`](.*?)["'`]/.exec(line);
  if (d) {
    while (describes.length && describes.at(-1).indent >= d[1].length) {
      describes.pop();
    }
    describes.push({ indent: d[1].length, name: d[2] });
    continue;
  }
  const t = /^(\s*)it(\.each)?\(/.exec(line);
  if (!t) continue;
  while (describes.length && describes.at(-1).indent >= t[1].length) {
    describes.pop();
  }
  // name: first string literal on this line or the next few
  let name = null;
  for (let k = i; k < i + 4 && !name; k++) {
    const m = /\(\s*["'`]([^"'`]+)["'`]/.exec(
      lines[k].replace(/^\s*it(\.each)?/, ""),
    );
    if (m) name = m[1];
  }
  // end: balance parentheses from the it( line
  let depth = 0;
  let end = i;
  outer: for (let k = i; k < lines.length; k++) {
    for (const ch of lines[k]) {
      if (ch === "(") depth++;
      else if (ch === ")") {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) {
          end = k;
          break outer;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const scope = describes
    .map((d) => d.name)
    .slice(1)
    .join(" > ");
  console.log(
    `${i + 1}-${end + 1}\t${scope ? scope + " > " : ""}${name}${
      t[2] ? " (each)" : ""
    }`,
  );
}
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**View mode in a room (AC 7.1): the page info dialog's Edit button works in view mode today. Names and descriptions will become read-only. What about your personal settings in that dialog (grid on/off, snap, grid size, show thumbnail), which are marked "Only you see this"?**

Options:

- **Personal stays editable (Recommended)** - Like PowerPoint's read-only/viewing mode, where you can still change your own view (zoom, gridlines). Name and description are read-only; grid and thumbnail can still change because they affect only you.
- **Whole dialog read-only** - In view mode the dialog only shows info; the Edit button is disabled entirely.

**Folders in a room (AC 7.3): if you start a room while your drawing has folders, the room shows the pages flat, in the shared order. What happens to your folders?**

Options:

- **Removed when the room starts (Recommended)** - Pages go flat when you start or join a room, and stay flat after you leave. This matches joining a room, where the room's pages become your drawing. You'd have to recreate folders after leaving.
- **Hidden, restored after leaving** - Folders are hidden during the room and come back when you leave, for pages that still exist. The folder layout then overrides the room's order for those pages, and pages added in the room go to the end.

**Answer:** Personal stays editable (Recommended), Removed when the room starts (Recommended)

</details></tool-use>

```text
import { useState } from "react";

import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { t } from "../i18n";
import {
  PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
  PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH,
  isPageInfoValid,
  validatePageInfo,
} from "../pages";
import { getNormalizedGridSize } from "../scene/normalize";

import { CheckboxItem } from "./CheckboxItem";
import { Dialog } from "./Dialog";
import DialogActionButton from "./DialogActionButton";
import { Switch } from "./Switch";
import { TextField } from "./TextField";

import "./PageInfoDialog.scss";

import type { DrawingPage, PageInfoPatch } from "../pages";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

const getPatchFromPage = (page: DrawingPage): PageInfoPatch => ({
  name: page.name,
  description: page.description,
  showThumbnail: page.showThumbnail,
  grid: {
    gridModeEnabled: page.settings.gridModeEnabled,
    gridSnapEnabled: page.settings.gridSnapEnabled,
    gridSize: page.settings.gridSize,
  },
});

/**
 * Shows a page's name, description and settings, and lets the user edit them.
 * Changes are kept in a local draft until explicitly saved.
 */
export const PageInfoDialog = ({
  page,
  pages,
  onSave,
  onClose,
  position,
  onMoveToPosition,
  isMoveDisabled,
  isInFolder,
  onRemoveFromFolder,
}: {
  page: DrawingPage;
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  onSave: (patch: PageInfoPatch) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** 1-based position in the page's list (top level or its folder) (#162) */
  position: { position: number; count: number };
  /** returns whether the input was valid and the page moved */
  onMoveToPosition: (input: string) => boolean;
  isMoveDisabled: boolean;
  isInFolder: boolean;
  onRemoveFromFolder: () => void;
}) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageInfoPatch | null>(null);
  const [positionInput, setPositionInput] = useState("");
  // keep the raw text so the field can be cleared while typing
  const [gridSizeInput, setGridSizeInput] = useState("");

  const startEditing = () => {
    const initial = getPatchFromPage(page);
    setDraft(initial);
    setGridSizeInput(String(initial.grid.gridSize));
  };

  const cancelEditing = () => {
    setDraft(null);
  };

  const validation = draft
    ? validatePageInfo(draft, pages, page.id)
    : { nameError: undefined, descriptionError: undefined };
  const canSave = !!draft && isPageInfoValid(validation);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!draft || !canSave) {
      return;
    }
    onSave({ ...draft, name: draft.name.trim() });
  };

  const handleNameKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleSave();
    }
  };

  const updateDraft = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch>) => {
    setDraft((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, ...patch } : prev));
  };

  const updateGrid = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch["grid"]>) => {
    setDraft((prev) =>
      prev ? { ...prev, grid: { ...prev.grid, ...patch } } : prev,
    );
  };

  const nameErrorMessage =
    validation.nameError === "empty"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.emptyName")
      : validation.nameError === "duplicate"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.duplicateName")
      : validation.nameError === "tooLong"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.nameTooLong", { max: PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH })
      : null;

  const renderView = () => (
    <>
      <dl className="PageInfoDialog__details">
  const renderEdit = (draft: PageInfoPatch) => (
    <>
      <div className="PageInfoDialog__fields">
        <div>
          <TextField
            label={t("pageInfoDialog.name")}
            value={draft.name}
            onChange={(name) => updateDraft({ name })}
            onKeyDown={handleNameKeyDown}
            selectOnRender
            fullWidth
          />
          {nameErrorMessage && (
            <div className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
              {nameErrorMessage}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <label className="PageInfoDialog__textarea">
          <span className="PageInfoDialog__label">
            {t("pageInfoDialog.description")}
          </span>
          <textarea
            value={draft.description}
            placeholder={t("pageInfoDialog.descriptionPlaceholder")}
            rows={4}
            onChange={(event) =>
              updateDraft({ description: event.target.value })
            }
            aria-invalid={!!validation.descriptionError}
          />
          <span
            className={
              validation.descriptionError
                ? "PageInfoDialog__counter PageInfoDialog__counter--error"
                : "PageInfoDialog__counter"
            }
          >
            {t("pageInfoDialog.charCount", {
              count: draft.description.length,
              max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
            })}
          </span>
          {validation.descriptionError && (
            <span className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
              {t("pageInfoDialog.errors.descriptionTooLong", {
                max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
              })}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <CheckboxItem
          checked={draft.showThumbnail}
          onChange={(showThumbnail) => updateDraft({ showThumbnail })}
        >
          {t("pageInfoDialog.showThumbnail")}
        </CheckboxItem>
        <fieldset className="PageInfoDialog__grid">
          <legend>{t("pageInfoDialog.grid")}</legend>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}</span>
            <Switch
              name="page-info-grid-mode"
              title={t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}
              checked={draft.grid.gridModeEnabled}
              onChange={(gridModeEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridModeEnabled })}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}</span>
            <Switch
              name="page-info-grid-snap"
              title={t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}
              checked={draft.grid.gridSnapEnabled}
              onChange={(gridSnapEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridSnapEnabled })}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.gridSize")}</span>
            <input
              className="PageInfoDialog__number"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={100}
              value={gridSizeInput}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setGridSizeInput(event.target.value);
                const value = Number(event.target.value);
                if (event.target.value !== "" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
                  updateGrid({ gridSize: getNormalizedGridSize(value) });
                }
              }}
              onBlur={() => setGridSizeInput(String(draft.grid.gridSize))}
            />
          </label>
        </fieldset>
      </div>
      <div className="PageInfoDialog__actions">
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("buttons.cancel")}
          onClick={cancelEditing}
        />
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("pageInfoDialog.save")}
          onClick={handleSave}
          actionType="primary"
          disabled={!canSave}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Dialog
      size="small"
      onCloseRequest={onClose}
      title={t("pageInfoDialog.title")}
      className="PageInfoDialog"
    >
      {draft ? renderEdit(draft) : renderView()}
    </Dialog>
  );
};
```

```text
const PagePreview = React.memo(
  ({
    page,
    files,
    appState,
  }: {
    page: DrawingPage;
    files: BinaryFiles;
    appState: UIAppState;
  }) => {
    const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      let active = true;
      const elements = page.elements.filter(isNonDeletedElement);

      if (!elements.length) {
        setPreviewUrl(null);
        return;
      }

      const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
        const defaultAppState = getDefaultAppState();
        const previewAppState = {
          ...defaultAppState,
          ...appState,
          ...page.settings,
          width: appState.width,
          height: appState.height,
          offsetTop: 0,
          offsetLeft: 0,
          scrollX: 0,
          scrollY: 0,
          zoom: defaultAppState.zoom,
        };

        void exportToCanvas(
          elements,
          previewAppState,
          files,
          {
            exportBackground: true,
            exportPadding: 8,
            viewBackgroundColor: page.settings.viewBackgroundColor,
          },
          (width, height) => {
            const scale = Math.min(
              PAGE_PREVIEW_WIDTH / Math.max(width, 1),
              PAGE_PREVIEW_HEIGHT / Math.max(height, 1),
              1,
            );
            const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(width * scale));
            canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(height * scale));
            return { canvas, scale };
          },
        )
          .then((canvas) => {
            if (active) {
              setPreviewUrl(canvas.toDataURL());
            }
          })
          .catch((error: unknown) => {
            console.error("Failed to render page preview", error);
          });
      }, 250);

      return () => {
        active = false;
        window.clearTimeout(timeout);
      };
    }, [appState, files, page]);

    return previewUrl ? (
      <img className="page-navigation__preview" src={previewUrl} alt="" />
    ) : (
      <span
        className="page-navigation__preview page-navigation__preview--empty"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    );
  },
  (prevProps, nextProps) =>
    prevProps.page === nextProps.page &&
    prevProps.files === nextProps.files &&
    prevProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode ===
      nextProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode &&
    prevProps.appState.theme === nextProps.appState.theme,
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-25 23:08:58Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**In view mode the Pages button is hidden (since #157), so a view-mode user can't open the page list, which AC 7.1 requires ("can switch pages"). Library and Pages share one button slot that view mode hides. How should a view-mode user switch pages?**

Options:

- **Show Pages button only (Recommended)** - Like PowerPoint's reading view, where viewers can still move between slides. The Pages button shows in view mode; the Library button stays hidden. The page list opens with editing disabled, as it already is in view mode.
- **Show Pages only in a room** - Same, but only while collaborating; solo view mode stays as it is today.
- **Leave as is** - Keep #157's behaviour. View-mode users can only switch pages through follow mode or a list opened before view mode was turned on. AC 7.1 would be met only partly.

**Answer:** Show Pages button only (Recommended)

</details></tool-use>

```text
import clsx from "clsx";
import React from "react";

import { checkIcon } from "./icons";

import "./CheckboxItem.scss";

export const CheckboxItem: React.FC<{
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: (checked: boolean, event: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  className?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ children, checked, onChange, className }) => {
  return (
    <div
      className={clsx("Checkbox", className, { "is-checked": checked })}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onChange(!checked, event);
        (
          (event.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).querySelector(
            ".Checkbox-box",
          ) as HTMLButtonElement
        ).focus();
      }}

      <button
        type="button"

        role="checkbox"
        aria-checked={checked}
      >
        {checkIcon}
      </button>
      <div className="Checkbox-label">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

Step 6 is done, so all six steps are complete and all 24 acceptance criteria are covered. Nothing is committed yet.

## Step 6: view mode, hide/lock and folders

**Your decisions, as implemented:**

- **Follow mode:** starting to follow someone takes you to their page right away, like following a presenter in PowerPoint. Stopping following leaves you where you are.
- **View mode in the page info dialog:** name and description are read-only; grid and thumbnail stay editable, because only you see them.
- **Folders:** starting or joining a room turns them into a flat list in the shared order, and pages stay flat after you leave.
- **Pages button in view mode:** it's now shown, and the Library button stays hidden. This changes #157's behaviour, as you approved: before, view-mode users couldn't open the page list at all.

**What works now:**

- **AC 7.1, view mode:** you can switch pages and follow others, but you can't create, rename, change descriptions, delete, clear or reorder pages, or change the background. The page buttons are disabled. A peer's page changes still apply, and nothing page-related is sent from view mode.
- **AC 3.3:** the page info dialog marks Thumbnail and Grid "Only you see this.", both when viewing and when editing.
- **AC 7.2:** hiding or locking a collaborator applies on every page. A hidden collaborator's elements are never passed to any page preview, and previews redraw when someone is hidden or shown.
- **AC 7.3:** folder controls are off in a room (shift + right-click selects nothing, and a hint explains why). Pages show flat in the shared order, and reordering still works because it's a shared change.

**A latent bug I fixed on the way:** page previews were drawn with the open page's id, so the step 1 safety net could have hidden an inactive page's own elements in its thumbnail. Each preview now checks against its own page.

**Tests:**

- 22 new tests: 17 editor tests and 5 multi-client tests (two for starting to follow, three for view mode in a room).
- **Mutation checks:** I broke the code eight ways and each break was caught: view mode can create pages, can rename, can clear; previews show hidden collaborators; folders kept in a room; folder controls on in a room; no "Only you see this" note; no Pages button in view mode.
- **Full suite:** 174 of 175 files pass (3093 tests). The only failures are the same 3 Windows font-path snapshots.
- Typecheck, ESLint and Prettier are clean.

**Existing test changed:** none in this step. Only my own step 3 folder test was simplified, because creating a folder in a room is now blocked.
